definition_en: A named storage location in memory that holds a value
definition_tr: Bellekte bir deger tutan adlandirilmis depolama alani

example_sentences.en: Declare a variable to store the user's name.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanicinin adini saklamak icin bir degisken tanimla.

common_patterns: assign a value to a variable — degiskene deger atamak
scenario: Senior dev: 'Use a more descriptive variable name here.'
common_mistakes: Turkce'deki 'degisken' kelimesini direkt kullanmak yerine 'variable' demek gerekir Ingilizce ortamda.

definition_en: A reusable block of code that performs a specific task
definition_tr: Belirli bir gorevi yerine getiren yeniden kullanilabilir kod blogu

example_sentences.en: This function calculates the total price.
example_sentences.tr: Bu fonksiyon toplam fiyati hesaplar.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Can you extract this logic into a separate function?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler 'fonksiyon' yerine bazen 'metod' der, ikisi farkli seylerdir.

definition_en: A variable listed in a function's declaration that receives a value when the function is called
definition_tr: Fonksiyon cagrildiginda deger alan, fonksiyon bildirimindeki degisken

example_sentences.en: This function takes two parameters: width and height.
example_sentences.tr: Bu fonksiyon iki parametre alir: genislik ve yukseklik.

scenario: Lead dev: 'We should add a timeout parameter to this function.'
common_mistakes: Parameter ve argument farki bilinmez: parameter tanimda, argument cagirirken kullanilir.

definition_en: To send a value back from a function to the code that called it
definition_tr: Bir fonksiyondan cagiran koda deger gondermek

example_sentences.en: This function returns a boolean value.
example_sentences.tr: Bu fonksiyon boolean bir deger dondurur.

scenario: Reviewer: 'What does this function return if the input is null?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler 'return etmek' seklinde Turkce-Ingilizce karistirirlar.

definition_en: A control structure that repeats a block of code while a condition is true
definition_tr: Bir kosul dogru oldugu surece kod blogunu tekrarlayan kontrol yapisi

example_sentences.en: Use a for loop to iterate over the array.
example_sentences.tr: Dizi uzerinde gezmek icin for dongusu kullan.

common_patterns: break out of a loop — donguyu kirmak
scenario: Senior: 'This nested loop is O(n^2), can we optimize it?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler 'iterate' ve 'loop' kelimelerini karistirir.

definition_en: To find and fix errors in code
definition_tr: Koddaki hatalari bulmak ve duzetmek

example_sentences.en: I spent hours debugging this issue.
example_sentences.tr: Bu sorunu debug etmek icin saatler harcadim.

common_patterns: debug an issue — sorunu debug etmek
hard to debug — debug etmesi zor
scenario: Dev: 'Let me debug this locally and get back to you.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler 'debug etmek' der, 'hata ayiklamak' daha dogru Turkcesidir.

definition_en: An event that disrupts the normal flow of a program's execution
definition_tr: Programin normal akisini bozan olay

example_sentences.en: The code throws an exception when the file is not found.
example_sentences.tr: Dosya bulunamadiginda kod bir istisna firlatir.

common_patterns: handle an exception — istisna ele almak
scenario: Lead: 'Make sure you handle this exception gracefully.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler exception ve error'u ayni sey sanir, farklidir.

definition_en: A report showing the sequence of function calls that led to an error
definition_tr: Bir hataya yol acan fonksiyon cagrilarinin sirasini gosteren rapor

example_sentences.en: Check the stack trace to find where the error occurred.
example_sentences.tr: Hatanin nerede olustugunu bulmak icin stack trace'e bak.

common_patterns: read the stack trace — stack trace'i okumak
scenario: Senior: 'Can you paste the stack trace in the issue?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler stack trace okumakta zorlanir, asagidan yukariya okunmasi gerektigini bilmezler.

definition_en: A step-by-step procedure for solving a problem or accomplishing a task
definition_tr: Bir problemi cozmek icin adim adim prosedur

example_sentences.en: We need a more efficient algorithm for sorting.
example_sentences.tr: Siralama icin daha verimli bir algoritmaya ihtiyacimiz var.

common_patterns: optimize the algorithm — algoritmayi optimize etmek
scenario: Interviewer: 'What algorithm would you use to solve this?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler algoritma bilgisini pratikte kullanmakta zorlanir.

definition_en: A technique where a function calls itself to solve a problem
definition_tr: Bir fonksiyonun kendini cagirarak problemi cozdugu teknik

example_sentences.en: This problem can be solved elegantly with recursion.
example_sentences.tr: Bu problem recursion ile zarif bir sekilde cozulebilir.

usage_context: Agac yapilari ve bolup fethet problemlerinde
scenario: Interviewer: 'Can you solve this with recursion instead of iteration?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler base case eklemeyi unutarak sonsuz donguye girer.

definition_en: The ability of objects to take many forms and respond to the same method call differently
definition_tr: Nesnelerin ayni metod cagrisina farkli sekillerde yanit vermesi

example_sentences.en: Polymorphism allows us to write more flexible code.
example_sentences.tr: Polimorfizm daha esnek kod yazmamizi saglar.

common_patterns: achieve polymorphism through — polimorfizmi ... ile saglamak
scenario: Senior: 'We can use polymorphism instead of this switch statement.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler polimorfizmi sadece teorik bilir, pratikte uygulamakta zorlanir.

definition_en: A mechanism where a class acquires properties and behaviors of a parent class
definition_tr: Bir sinifin ust sinifin ozellik ve davranislarini aldigi mekanizma

example_sentences.en: The Button class inherits from the Component class.
example_sentences.tr: Button sinifi Component sinifindan kalitim alir.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Do we really need inheritance here, or would composition be better?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler inheritance'i gereginden fazla kullanir, composition tercih edilmeli.

definition_en: Bundling data and methods that operate on that data within a single unit
definition_tr: Veriyi ve o veri uzerinde calisan metodlari tek bir birimde gruplamak

example_sentences.en: Encapsulation helps us hide implementation details.
example_sentences.tr: Kapsulleme uygulama detaylarini gizlememize yardimci olur.

scenario: Lead: 'This breaks encapsulation by exposing internal state.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tum field'lari public yapar, kapsullemeyi ihmal eder.

definition_en: Hiding complex implementation details and showing only essential features
definition_tr: Karmasik uygulama detaylarini gizleyip sadece temel ozellikleri gostermek

example_sentences.en: Good abstraction makes the API easier to use.
example_sentences.tr: Iyi soyutlama API'yi kullanmayi kolaylastirir.

scenario: Architect: 'We need the right level of abstraction here.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler gereksiz soyutlama yapma egilimindedir (over-engineering).

definition_en: A contract that defines methods a class must implement without specifying how
definition_tr: Bir sinifin uygulamasi gereken metodlari nasil oldugunu belirtmeden tanimlayan sozlesme

example_sentences.en: Define an interface for the payment service.
example_sentences.tr: Odeme servisi icin bir arayuz tanimla.

common_patterns: expose an interface — arayuzu aciga cikarmak
scenario: Lead: 'Program to an interface, not an implementation.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler interface yerine concrete class kullanma egilimindedir.

definition_en: A blueprint for creating objects that defines properties and methods
definition_tr: Nesneler olusturmak icin ozellik ve metodlari tanimlayan sablon

example_sentences.en: Create a new class for the user model.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici modeli icin yeni bir sinif olustur.

common_patterns: instantiate a class — siniftan ornek olusturmak
scenario: Dev: 'Should this be a class or a plain object?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her sey icin class olusturur, bazen fonksiyonel yaklasim daha uygundur.

definition_en: A function that belongs to a class or object
definition_tr: Bir sinifa veya nesneye ait fonksiyon

example_sentences.en: Call the save method to persist the data.
example_sentences.tr: Veriyi kaydetmek icin save metodunu cagir.

scenario: Reviewer: 'This method is doing too many things, split it up.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler method ve function arasindaki farki bilmez.

definition_en: A special method called when an object is created from a class
definition_tr: Bir siniftan nesne olusturuldugunda cagirilan ozel metod

example_sentences.en: Initialize the database connection in the constructor.
example_sentences.tr: Veritabani baglantisini constructor'da baslat.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Don't put heavy logic in the constructor.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler constructor'da cok fazla is yapar, bu anti-pattern'dir.

definition_en: The region of code where a variable is accessible
definition_tr: Bir degiskenin erisilebilir oldugu kod bolgesi

example_sentences.en: This variable is only accessible within the local scope.
example_sentences.tr: Bu degisken sadece yerel kapsamda erisilebilir.

scenario: Senior: 'Be careful with scope, this variable leaks into the global scope.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler JavaScript'teki var/let/const scope farklarini karistirir.

definition_en: A function that remembers variables from its outer scope even after the outer function has returned
definition_tr: Dis fonksiyon dondukten sonra bile dis kapsamdaki degiskenleri hatirlayan fonksiyon

example_sentences.en: We use closures to create private variables in JavaScript.
example_sentences.tr: JavaScript'te ozel degiskenler olusturmak icin closure kullaniriz.

scenario: Interviewer: 'Can you explain how closures work?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler closure kavrami soyut oldugu icin anlamakta zorlanir.

definition_en: A function passed as an argument to another function to be called later
definition_tr: Daha sonra cagrilmak uzere baska bir fonksiyona arguman olarak gecirilen fonksiyon

example_sentences.en: Pass a callback function to handle the response.
example_sentences.tr: Yaniti islemek icin bir callback fonksiyonu gecir.

scenario: Senior: 'Avoid callback hell by using promises instead.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler callback hell'e dusmekten kacinamazlar, promise/async-await kullanmalilar.

definition_en: An object representing the eventual completion or failure of an asynchronous operation
definition_tr: Asenkron bir islemin nihai tamamlanmasini veya basarisizligini temsil eden nesne

example_sentences.en: This API call returns a promise.
example_sentences.tr: Bu API cagrisi bir promise dondurur.

scenario: Lead: 'Make sure you handle the rejected promise.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler promise'i catch etmeyi unutur, unhandled rejection hatalari olusur.

definition_en: A programming pattern where operations run without blocking the main thread
definition_tr: Islemlerin ana is parcacigini engellemeden calistigi programlama kalibi

example_sentences.en: Use async/await for cleaner asynchronous code.
example_sentences.tr: Daha temiz asenkron kod icin async/await kullan.

scenario: Reviewer: 'This should be an async function.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler async islemlerin sirasini kontrol etmekte zorlanir.

definition_en: A keyword that pauses execution until a promise is resolved
definition_tr: Bir promise cozulene kadar calismayi duraklatan anahtar kelime

example_sentences.en: Await the database query before processing results.
example_sentences.tr: Sonuclari islemeden once veritabani sorgusunu bekle.

scenario: Senior: 'Don't forget to await this call, otherwise you'll get a pending promise.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler await eklemeyi unutur ve beklenmeyen davranislarla karsilasir.

definition_en: A unit of execution that runs concurrently within a process
definition_tr: Bir proses icinde esanli calisan yurutme birimi

example_sentences.en: The application spawns a new thread for each request.
example_sentences.tr: Uygulama her istek icin yeni bir thread olusturur.

scenario: Architect: 'Is this code thread-safe?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler thread safety konusunda deneyimsizdir, race condition hatalari yapar.

definition_en: A synchronization mechanism that ensures only one thread accesses a resource at a time
definition_tr: Ayni anda sadece bir is parcaciginin bir kaynaga erismesini saglayan senkronizasyon mekanizmasi

example_sentences.en: Use a mutex to prevent race conditions.
example_sentences.tr: Race condition'lari onlemek icin mutex kullan.

common_patterns: release a mutex — mutex serbest birakmak
scenario: Senior: 'We need a mutex here to avoid data corruption.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler mutex kavramini teorik bilir ama pratikte uygulamada zorlanir.

definition_en: Automatic memory management that frees memory no longer in use
definition_tr: Artik kullanilmayan bellegi serbest birakan otomatik bellek yonetimi

example_sentences.en: The garbage collector runs periodically to free unused memory.
example_sentences.tr: Garbage collector kullanilmayan bellegi serbest birakmak icin periyodik olarak calisir.

common_patterns: trigger garbage collection — garbage collection'i tetiklemek
scenario: Senior: 'This object won't be garbage collected because there's still a reference to it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler garbage collection'a guvenip memory leak'e neden olabilir.

definition_en: A situation where a program fails to release memory that is no longer needed
definition_tr: Programin artik ihtiyac duyulmayan bellegi serbest birakamadigi durum

example_sentences.en: This event listener causes a memory leak.
example_sentences.tr: Bu event listener bir bellek sizintisina neden oluyor.

common_patterns: fix a memory leak — bellek sizintisini duzetmek
detect a memory leak — bellek sizintisi tespit etmek
scenario: Lead: 'We have a memory leak in production, the app's memory usage keeps growing.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler event listener temizlemeyi ve subscription iptal etmeyi unutur.

definition_en: A function that always returns the same output for the same input and has no side effects
definition_tr: Ayni girdi icin her zaman ayni ciktiyi veren ve yan etkisi olmayan fonksiyon

example_sentences.en: Pure functions are easier to test.
example_sentences.tr: Saf fonksiyonlari test etmek daha kolaydir.

common_patterns: write pure functions — saf fonksiyonlar yazmak
scenario: Reviewer: 'This should be a pure function, remove the side effect.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler fonksiyonlarin icinde global state degistirmeye meyillidir.

definition_en: Any observable change caused by a function other than returning a value
definition_tr: Fonksiyonun deger dondurme disinda neden oldugu gozlemlenebilir degisiklik

example_sentences.en: Logging is a side effect of this function.
example_sentences.tr: Loglama bu fonksiyonun bir yan etkisidir.

common_patterns: cause a side effect — yan etkiye neden olmak
scenario: Reviewer: 'Move this side effect out of the render function.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler side effect'leri kontrol altina almakta zorlanir.

definition_en: A small anonymous function defined without a name
definition_tr: Isimsiz olarak tanimlanan kucuk fonksiyon

example_sentences.en: Use a lambda to filter the list.
example_sentences.tr: Listeyi filtrelemek icin bir lambda kullan.

scenario: Dev: 'Just use a lambda here, no need for a named function.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler lambda syntax'ini ezberlemekte zorlanir.

definition_en: An operator that expands an iterable into individual elements
definition_tr: Bir yinelenebilir yapiyi tek tek elemanlara genisleten operator

example_sentences.en: Use the spread operator to merge these two arrays.
example_sentences.tr: Bu iki diziyi birlestirmek icin spread operator kullan.

scenario: Dev: 'You can use spread to clone this object.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler spread'in shallow copy yaptigini bilmez, deep clone sanir.

definition_en: A syntax that unpacks values from arrays or properties from objects into distinct variables
definition_tr: Dizilerden veya nesnelerden degerleri ayri degiskenlere cikaran sozdizimi

example_sentences.en: Use destructuring to extract the name and email from the user object.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici nesnesinden isim ve e-postayi cikarmak icin destructuring kullan.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Use destructuring here for cleaner code.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler nested destructuring'de kayboluyor.

definition_en: Automatic conversion of a value from one data type to another
definition_tr: Bir degerin bir veri tipinden digerine otomatik donusturulmesi

example_sentences.en: JavaScript's type coercion can lead to unexpected results.
example_sentences.tr: JavaScript'in tip donusumu beklenmedik sonuclara yol acabilir.

scenario: Senior: 'Always use strict equality to avoid type coercion bugs.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler == ve === farkini bilmez, type coercion hatalarina neden olur.

definition_en: Converting a data structure into a format that can be stored or transmitted
definition_tr: Veri yapisini saklanabilir veya iletilebilir bir formata donusturme

example_sentences.en: We need to serialize this object to JSON before sending it.
example_sentences.tr: Gondermeden once bu nesneyi JSON'a serillestirmemiz gerekiyor.

scenario: Dev: 'Make sure the date is properly serialized.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler circular reference iceren nesneleri serialize etmeye calisir ve hata alir.

definition_en: A way of organizing and storing data for efficient access and modification
definition_tr: Verileri verimli erisim ve degisiklik icin duzenleme ve saklama yolu

example_sentences.en: Choose the right data structure for your use case.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanim durumunuz icin dogru veri yapisini secin.

common_patterns: implement a data structure — veri yapisi uygulamak
scenario: Interviewer: 'What data structure would you use here?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her yerde array kullanir, Map veya Set dusunmez.

definition_en: An ordered collection of elements accessible by index
definition_tr: Indeks ile erisilebilen sirali eleman koleksiyonu

example_sentences.en: Add the new item to the end of the array.
example_sentences.tr: Yeni ogesi dizinin sonuna ekle.

common_patterns: iterate over an array — dizi uzerinde donmek
scenario: Dev: 'This array might get very large, consider pagination.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler array ve object arasindaki performans farkini bilmez.

definition_en: A data structure that maps keys to values for efficient lookup
definition_tr: Verimli arama icin anahtarlari degerlere eslestiren veri yapisi

example_sentences.en: Use a hash map for O(1) lookups.
example_sentences.tr: O(1) arama icin hash map kullan.

common_patterns: hash map lookup — hash map'te arama
scenario: Interviewer: 'Why would you choose a hash map over an array here?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler JavaScript'te Map ve object farklarini bilmez.

definition_en: A data structure where elements are stored in nodes linked together
definition_tr: Elemanlarin birbirine bagli dugumler icinde saklandigi veri yapisi

example_sentences.en: A linked list allows efficient insertion at any position.
example_sentences.tr: Bagli liste herhangi bir pozisyonda verimli eklemeye izin verir.

common_patterns: traverse a linked list — bagli listeyi dolasmak
singly linked list — tek yonlu bagli liste
scenario: Interviewer: 'Reverse this linked list.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler linked list'i pratikte nerede kullanacaklarini bilmez.

definition_en: A hierarchical data structure with a root node and child nodes
definition_tr: Bir kok dugum ve cocuk dugumlerden olusan hiyerarsik veri yapisi

example_sentences.en: The DOM is structured as a tree.
example_sentences.tr: DOM bir agac olarak yapilandirilmistir.

scenario: Interviewer: 'How would you traverse this tree?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tree traversal algoritmalarini (BFS, DFS) karistirir.

definition_en: A data type with only two possible values: true or false
definition_tr: Sadece iki olasi degeri olan veri tipi: true veya false

example_sentences.en: The function returns a boolean indicating success.
example_sentences.tr: Fonksiyon basariyi gosteren bir boolean dondurur.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Use a more descriptive name for this boolean.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler boolean degiskenlere 'is' veya 'has' on eki eklemeyi unutur.

definition_en: A sequence of characters used to represent text
definition_tr: Metni temsil etmek icin kullanilan karakter dizisi

example_sentences.en: Concatenate the first name and last name strings.
example_sentences.tr: Ad ve soyad stringlerini birlestir.

scenario: Dev: 'Use template literals instead of string concatenation.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler string encoding sorunlariyla karsilasir (UTF-8, Turkce karakterler).

definition_en: A whole number without a decimal point
definition_tr: Ondalik noktasi olmayan tam sayi

example_sentences.en: The function expects an integer, not a float.
example_sentences.tr: Fonksiyon float degil integer bekliyor.

scenario: Senior: 'Be careful with integer overflow for large numbers.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler JavaScript'te Number tipinin integer ve float ayrimini bilmez.

definition_en: A special value representing the intentional absence of any value
definition_tr: Herhangi bir degerin kasitli yoklugunu temsil eden ozel deger

example_sentences.en: Check if the value is null before accessing its properties.
example_sentences.tr: Ozelliklerine erismeden once degerin null olup olmadigini kontrol et.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Add a null check here to prevent a crash.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler null ve undefined farkini bilmez JavaScript'te.

definition_en: A value automatically assigned to variables that have been declared but not initialized
definition_tr: Tanimlanmis ama deger atanmamis degiskenlere otomatik atanan deger

example_sentences.en: The function returns undefined because there is no return statement.
example_sentences.tr: Return ifadesi olmadigi icin fonksiyon undefined donduruyor.

common_patterns: check for undefined — undefined kontrolu yapmak
scenario: Dev: 'This is undefined because the property doesn't exist.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler null ve undefined'i birbirinin yerine kullanir.

definition_en: Unable to be changed after creation
definition_tr: Olusturulduktan sonra degistirilemeyen

example_sentences.en: Use immutable data structures to avoid unexpected mutations.
example_sentences.tr: Beklenmedik mutasyonlari onlemek icin degistirilemez veri yapilari kullan.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Keep this state immutable, use spread to create a new object.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler React state'i direkt mutate eder, immutable tutmaz.

definition_en: Able to be changed after creation
definition_tr: Olusturulduktan sonra degistirilebilen

example_sentences.en: Mutable state can lead to hard-to-track bugs.
example_sentences.tr: Degistirilebilir state izlenmesi zor hatalara yol acabilir.

scenario: Lead: 'Minimize mutable state in your components.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler mutability'nin ne kadar tehlikeli olabilecegini hafife alir.

definition_en: To repeat a process for each item in a collection
definition_tr: Bir koleksiyondaki her oge icin bir islemi tekrarlamak

example_sentences.en: Iterate over the list and print each item.
example_sentences.tr: Liste uzerinde yinele ve her ogeyi yazdir.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Use map instead of manually iterating.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler for dongusu yerine higher-order fonksiyonlari (map, filter) tercih etmeli.

definition_en: To transform source code into machine code or bytecode
definition_tr: Kaynak kodu makine kodu veya bytecode'a donusturmek

example_sentences.en: The code won't compile because of a syntax error.
example_sentences.tr: Sozdizimi hatasi nedeniyle kod derlenmeyecek.

scenario: Dev: 'It compiles locally but fails in CI.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler compile-time ve runtime hata farkini karistirir.

definition_en: The period during which a program is executing
definition_tr: Programin calistigi sure/ortam

example_sentences.en: This error only occurs at runtime.
example_sentences.tr: Bu hata sadece calisma zamaninda olusur.

scenario: Senior: 'This is a runtime issue, not a compile-time one.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler runtime ve compile-time farklarini netlestirememistir.

definition_en: An external library or module that a project requires to function
definition_tr: Bir projenin calismasi icin ihtiyac duydugu harici kutuphane veya modul

example_sentences.en: Update the project dependencies to fix the vulnerability.
example_sentences.tr: Guvenlik acigini gidermek icin proje bagimliklarini guncelle.

scenario: Lead: 'We have too many dependencies, let's audit them.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler gereksiz dependency ekleyerek bundle size'i sigirir.

definition_en: A self-contained unit of code that can be imported and used in other files
definition_tr: Diger dosyalara aktarilip kullanilabilen bagimsiz kod birimi

example_sentences.en: Import the authentication module.
example_sentences.tr: Kimlik dogrulama modulunu iceri aktar.

common_patterns: import a module — modul iceri aktarmak
export a module — modul disa aktarmak
scenario: Reviewer: 'Split this into separate modules for better organization.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler CommonJS ve ES Module farklarini karistirir.

definition_en: A bundle of code distributed and managed by a package manager
definition_tr: Paket yoneticisi tarafindan dagitilan ve yonetilen kod paketi

example_sentences.en: Install the lodash package for utility functions.
example_sentences.tr: Yardimci fonksiyonlar icin lodash paketini kur.

scenario: Dev: 'Which package should we use for date formatting?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler paketlerin lisanslarini kontrol etmez.

definition_en: A set of rules and protocols for building and interacting with software applications
definition_tr: Yazilim uygulamalari olusturmak ve etkilesim kurmak icin kurallar ve protokoller kumesi

example_sentences.en: The API returns user data in JSON format.
example_sentences.tr: API, kullanici verilerini JSON formatinda dondurur.

scenario: Lead: 'Let's design the API before starting implementation.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler API tasariminda RESTful prensiplere uymaz.

definition_en: A data type consisting of a set of named constants
definition_tr: Adlandirilmis sabitler kumesinden olusan veri tipi

example_sentences.en: Use an enum for the order status values.
example_sentences.tr: Siparis durumu degerleri icin enum kullan.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Use an enum instead of magic strings here.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler string literal yerine enum kullanmayi dusunmez.

definition_en: A feature that allows writing code that works with multiple types while maintaining type safety
definition_tr: Tip guvenligini korurken birden fazla tip ile calisan kod yazmayi saglayan ozellik

example_sentences.en: Use generics to make this function work with any type.
example_sentences.tr: Bu fonksiyonun herhangi bir tip ile calismasi icin generics kullan.

scenario: Senior: 'Add a generic constraint to ensure type safety.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler generics'i karisik bulur ve any tipini kullanarak atlatir.

definition_en: A design pattern that adds behavior to objects or functions without modifying them
definition_tr: Nesnelere veya fonksiyonlara onlari degistirmeden davranis ekleyen tasarim kalbi

example_sentences.en: Use a decorator to add logging to this method.
example_sentences.tr: Bu metoda loglama eklemek icin dekorator kullan.

scenario: Senior: 'We can use a decorator for authentication middleware.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler decorator pattern'i sadece framework'lerde kullanir, kendi decorator'larini yazmaz.

definition_en: Explicit declaration of the type of a variable, parameter, or return value
definition_tr: Bir degisken, parametre veya donus degerinin tipinin acik bildirimi

example_sentences.en: Add type annotations to improve code readability.
example_sentences.tr: Kod okunurlugunu artirmak icin tip aciklamalari ekle.

common_patterns: add type annotations — tip aciklamalari eklemek
scenario: Reviewer: 'Please add type annotations to these function parameters.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler TypeScript'te any tipi kullanarak type annotation'dan kacinir.

definition_en: To restructure existing code without changing its external behavior
definition_tr: Kodun disaridan gorunen davranisini degistirmeden ic yapisini iyilestirmek

example_sentences.en: We should refactor this function before adding new features.
example_sentences.tr: Yeni ozellikler eklemeden once bu fonksiyonu refactor etmeliyiz.

common_patterns: refactor X into Y — X'i Y'ye donusturmek
scenario: Reviewer: 'Could you refactor this into smaller functions?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler refactor ile rewrite'i karistirir. Refactor davranisi degistirmez.

definition_en: A design pattern that restricts a class to a single instance
definition_tr: Bir sinifi tek bir ornek ile kisitlayan tasarim kalbi

example_sentences.en: The database connection uses the singleton pattern.
example_sentences.tr: Veritabani baglantisi singleton kalibini kullanir.

scenario: Senior: 'Use a singleton for the configuration manager.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler singleton'u her yerde kullanir, test edilebilirlik sorunlari yaratir.

definition_en: Software that acts as a bridge between an operating system or database and applications
definition_tr: Isletim sistemi veya veritabani ile uygulamalar arasinda kopru gorevi goren yazilim

example_sentences.en: Add authentication middleware to protect the routes.
example_sentences.tr: Route'lari korumak icin kimlik dogrulama middleware'i ekle.

scenario: Lead: 'We need a rate limiting middleware.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler middleware sirasinin onemini kavramaz, yanlisleri zor debug edilir.

definition_en: A technique that maps objects to database tables
definition_tr: Nesneleri veritabani tablolarina eslestiren teknik

example_sentences.en: We use Prisma as our ORM.
example_sentences.tr: ORM olarak Prisma kullaniyoruz.

scenario: Senior: 'The ORM generates inefficient queries, we need raw SQL here.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ORM'in olusturdugu SQL'i kontrol etmez, performans sorunlari yasar.

definition_en: A variable set outside the application that configures its behavior
definition_tr: Uygulamanin davranisini yapilandiran, uygulama disinda ayarlanan degisken

example_sentences.en: Store the API key in an environment variable.
example_sentences.tr: API anahtarini ortam degiskeninde sakla.

common_patterns: set an environment variable — ortam degiskeni ayarlamak
scenario: Lead: 'Never hardcode secrets, use environment variables.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler .env dosyasini git'e commitler, guvenlik acigi olusur.

definition_en: A storage location for a project's code, history, and configuration
definition_tr: Projenin kodu, gecmisi ve yapilandirmasi icin depolama alani

example_sentences.en: Clone the repository to your local machine.
example_sentences.tr: Depoyu yerel makinenize klonlayin.

scenario: Lead: 'Create a new repository for this microservice.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler repo ve repository kisaltmasini karistirir, ikisi aynidir.

definition_en: A snapshot of changes saved to the repository's history
definition_tr: Deponun gecmisine kaydedilen degisiklik anlik goruntusu

example_sentences.en: Make small, focused commits with clear messages.
example_sentences.tr: Acik mesajlarla kucuk, odakli commitler yap.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Break this into smaller commits.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler dev commitler yapar, atomik commit prensibine uymaz.

definition_en: An independent line of development that diverges from the main codebase
definition_tr: Ana kod tabanindan ayrilan bagimsiz gelistirme hatti

example_sentences.en: Create a new branch for the feature.
example_sentences.tr: Ozellik icin yeni bir dal olustur.

common_patterns: switch branches — dallar arasinda gecis yapmak
scenario: Lead: 'Always create a feature branch, never commit directly to main.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler main branch'e direkt commit yapar.

definition_en: To combine changes from one branch into another
definition_tr: Bir daldaki degisiklikleri baska bir dalla birlestirmek

example_sentences.en: Merge the feature branch into the main branch.
example_sentences.tr: Feature branch'i main branch'e birlestir.

scenario: Dev: 'Can you merge main into your branch to resolve conflicts?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler merge conflict cozumunde panige kapilir.

definition_en: A request to merge changes from one branch into another with review
definition_tr: Bir daldaki degisiklikleri inceleme ile baska bir dala birlestirme istegi

example_sentences.en: Open a pull request when your feature is ready for review.
example_sentences.tr: Ozelliginiz incelemeye hazir oldugundan bir PR acin.

scenario: Lead: 'Your PR is too large, can you split it?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler buyuk PR'lar acar, kucuk ve odakli PR'lar acmalidir.

definition_en: The difference between two versions of a file or set of files
definition_tr: Bir dosyanin veya dosya kumesinin iki surumu arasindaki fark

example_sentences.en: Review the diff before committing your changes.
example_sentences.tr: Degisikliklerinizi commitlemeden once diff'i inceleyin.

scenario: Reviewer: 'I see some unintended changes in the diff.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler diff okumakta zorlanir, + ve - isaretlerini karistirir.

definition_en: To create a local copy of a remote repository
definition_tr: Uzak bir deponun yerel kopyasini olusturmak

example_sentences.en: Clone the repository using SSH.
example_sentences.tr: SSH kullanarak depoyu klonla.

scenario: Senior: 'Clone the repo and run pnpm install to get started.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler HTTPS yerine SSH clone'u ayarlamakta zorlanir.

definition_en: To create a personal copy of another user's repository on your account
definition_tr: Baska bir kullanicinin deposunun kendi hesabinizda kopyasini olusturmak

example_sentences.en: Fork the repository and submit a pull request.
example_sentences.tr: Depoyu catalla ve bir pull request gonder.

scenario: Maintainer: 'Fork the repo and submit a PR with your fix.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler fork ve clone farkini bilmez.

definition_en: To download changes from a remote repository without merging them
definition_tr: Uzak depodan degisiklikleri birlestirmeden indirmek

example_sentences.en: Fetch the latest changes before starting your work.
example_sentences.tr: Ise baslamadan once son degisiklikleri getir.

common_patterns: fetch from remote — uzak depodan getirmek
fetch and merge — getirmek ve birlestirmek
scenario: Senior: 'Do a fetch first to see if there are any new changes.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler fetch ve pull farkini bilmez. Fetch sadece indirir, pull birlestir de.

definition_en: To upload local commits to a remote repository
definition_tr: Yerel commitleri uzak depoya yuklemek

example_sentences.en: Push your changes to the remote branch.
example_sentences.tr: Degisikliklerinizi uzak dala push edin.

common_patterns: push to remote — uzak depoya itmek
scenario: Dev: 'I pushed the fix, can you review it?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler force push'un tehlikelerini bilmez.

definition_en: To temporarily save uncommitted changes without committing them
definition_tr: Commitlenmemis degisiklikleri commitlemeden gecici olarak kaydetmek

example_sentences.en: Stash your changes before switching branches.
example_sentences.tr: Dal degistirmeden once degisikliklerinizi stash'e alin.

common_patterns: pop the stash — stash'den geri almak
scenario: Dev: 'Let me stash my changes and check your branch.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler stash'i unutup calismasini kaybeder.

definition_en: To reapply commits on top of another base branch
definition_tr: Commitleri baska bir temel dal uzerine yeniden uygulamak

example_sentences.en: Rebase your branch on top of main.
example_sentences.tr: Branch'inizi main uzerine rebase edin.

scenario: Lead: 'Please rebase instead of merging to keep a clean history.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler rebase'in commitleri yeniden yazdigini ve tehlikeli olabilecegini bilmez.

definition_en: To apply specific commits from one branch to another
definition_tr: Bir daldan belirli commitleri baska bir dala uygulamak

example_sentences.en: Cherry-pick the bugfix commit into the release branch.
example_sentences.tr: Hata duzeltme commitini release branch'ine cherry-pick et.

common_patterns: cherry-pick a commit — commiti secmeli almak
scenario: Lead: 'Cherry-pick just the fix, not the whole feature.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler cherry-pick sonrasi ayni degisikligin iki yerde gorunmesini karistirabilir.

definition_en: To combine multiple commits into a single commit
definition_tr: Birden fazla commiti tek bir commit haline getirmek

example_sentences.en: Squash your commits before merging the PR.
example_sentences.tr: PR'i birlestirmeden once commitlerinizi squash edin.

common_patterns: squash and merge — sikiistir ve birlestir
scenario: Reviewer: 'Please squash your WIP commits into one.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler squash yapmaz, WIP commitleri gecmiste birakir.

definition_en: A pointer to the current commit or branch you are working on
definition_tr: Uzerinde calistiginiz mevcut commit veya dala isaret eden gosterici

example_sentences.en: HEAD points to the latest commit on the current branch.
example_sentences.tr: HEAD, mevcut daldaki en son commiti isaret eder.

scenario: Senior: 'You're in a detached HEAD state, you need to checkout a branch.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler detached HEAD durumunda panige kapilir.

definition_en: An intermediate area where changes are prepared before committing
definition_tr: Degisikliklerin commitlenmeden once hazirlandigi ara alan

example_sentences.en: Add the file to the staging area before committing.
example_sentences.tr: Commitlemeden once dosyayi staging area'ya ekle.

scenario: Dev: 'I forgot to stage this file before committing.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler git add . ile her seyi stage eder, secici olmalidirlar.

definition_en: A version of the repository hosted on a server
definition_tr: Sunucuda barindirilan deponun surumu

example_sentences.en: Add a new remote for the upstream repository.
example_sentences.tr: Upstream depo icin yeni bir remote ekle.

scenario: Dev: 'What remote is your branch tracking?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler birden fazla remote yonetimini bilmez.

definition_en: The default name for the remote repository that a project was cloned from
definition_tr: Projenin klonlandigi uzak depo icin varsayilan isim

example_sentences.en: Push your changes to origin.
example_sentences.tr: Degisikliklerinizi origin'e push edin.

scenario: Dev: 'Make sure origin is pointing to the right URL.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler origin ve upstream farkini bilmez.

definition_en: A reference that points to a specific commit, typically used for releases
definition_tr: Belirli bir commiti isaret eden referans, genellikle release'ler icin kullanilir

example_sentences.en: Create a tag for the v2.0.0 release.
example_sentences.tr: v2.0.0 release'i icin bir tag olustur.

scenario: Lead: 'Tag this commit as v1.5.0 for the release.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tag'leri kullanmaz, surum yonetimini atlar.

definition_en: A file that specifies which files and directories Git should ignore
definition_tr: Git'in hangi dosya ve dizinleri yok saymasi gerektigini belirten dosya

example_sentences.en: Add node_modules to the gitignore file.
example_sentences.tr: node_modules'u gitignore dosyasina ekle.

scenario: Reviewer: 'This file should be in .gitignore, not in the repo.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler .env dosyasini gitignore'a eklemeyi unutur.

definition_en: A script that runs automatically at certain points in the Git workflow
definition_tr: Git is akisinda belirli noktalarda otomatik calisan betik

example_sentences.en: Set up a pre-commit hook to run linting.
example_sentences.tr: Lint calistirmak icin pre-commit hook'u ayarla.

scenario: Lead: 'We use husky for managing Git hooks.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler hook'lari devre disi birakma egilimindedir.

definition_en: A commit message format that follows a specific convention for clarity
definition_tr: Netlik icin belirli bir kurali takip eden commit mesaji formati

example_sentences.en: Use conventional commits: feat, fix, docs, chore.
example_sentences.tr: Geleneksel commit kullan: feat, fix, docs, chore.

scenario: Lead: 'We follow the conventional commit spec for our changelogs.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler commit mesajlarini Turkce yazar, Ingilizce yazmalidir.

definition_en: A versioning scheme using MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format
definition_tr: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH formatini kullanan surumleme semasi

example_sentences.en: Bump the minor version for backward-compatible features.
example_sentences.tr: Geriye uyumlu ozellikler icin minor surumu artir.

scenario: Lead: 'This is a breaking change, we need a major version bump.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler breaking change yapip minor version arttirir.

definition_en: A command that shows who last modified each line of a file
definition_tr: Bir dosyanin her satirini en son kimin degistirdigini gosteren komut

example_sentences.en: Use git blame to find out who wrote this code.
example_sentences.tr: Bu kodu kimin yazdigini bulmak icin git blame kullan.

scenario: Dev: 'Let me git blame this line to understand the context.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler blame'in suclama degil, gecmis arastirma araci oldugunu bilmez.

definition_en: A command that uses binary search to find the commit that introduced a bug
definition_tr: Bir hatayi tanitan commiti bulmak icin ikili arama kullanan komut

example_sentences.en: Use git bisect to find which commit introduced the regression.
example_sentences.tr: Regresyonu hangi commitin tanittigi bulmak icin git bisect kullan.

scenario: Senior: 'Try git bisect, it'll narrow down the breaking commit.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler bisect'i bilmez, commitleri teker teker kontrol eder.

definition_en: To switch to a different branch or restore files
definition_tr: Farkli bir dala gecis yapmak veya dosyalari geri yuklemek

example_sentences.en: Checkout the develop branch.
example_sentences.tr: Develop dalina gecis yap.

common_patterns: checkout a branch — dala gecis yapmak
checkout a file — dosyayi geri yuklemek
scenario: Dev: 'I need to checkout the feature branch to test it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler checkout'un iki farkli isi yaptigini karistirir (switch vs restore).

definition_en: A situation where competing changes to the same part of code must be resolved manually
definition_tr: Ayni kod parcasindaki rekabet eden degisikliklerin elle cozulmesi gereken durum

example_sentences.en: Resolve the merge conflict before continuing.
example_sentences.tr: Devam etmeden once merge catismasini coz.

scenario: Dev: 'I got a conflict in the same file you edited.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler conflict isaretlerini (<<<< ==== >>>>) temizlemeyi unutur.

definition_en: A merge type where the branch pointer simply moves forward without creating a merge commit
definition_tr: Dal gostericisinin merge commiti olusturmadan ileriye hareket ettigi birlestirme turu

example_sentences.en: This was a fast-forward merge, no merge commit was needed.
example_sentences.tr: Bu hizli ileri sarma birlestirmesiydi, merge commiti gerekmedi.

common_patterns: fast-forward merge — hizli ileri sarma birlestirmesi
scenario: Lead: 'We use no-ff merges to preserve branch history.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler fast-forward ve no-ff farkini bilmez.

definition_en: To overwrite the remote branch with local history, potentially losing commits
definition_tr: Yerel gecmisle uzak dali uzerine yazarak potansiyel olarak commit kaybetme

example_sentences.en: Never force push to the main branch.
example_sentences.tr: Main branch'e asla force push yapma.

common_patterns: force push with lease — kiralama ile zorla itmek
scenario: Lead: 'Only force push to your own feature branch, never to shared branches.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler force push ile baskalarinin calismasini kaybedebilir.

definition_en: The original repository that a fork was created from
definition_tr: Fork'un olusturuldugu orijinal depo

example_sentences.en: Sync your fork with the upstream repository.
example_sentences.tr: Fork'unuzu upstream depo ile senkronize edin.

scenario: Contributor: 'Pull the latest changes from upstream before pushing.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler upstream kavramini anlamakta zorlanir.

definition_en: To create a new commit that undoes the changes of a previous commit
definition_tr: Onceki bir commitin degisikliklerini geri alan yeni bir commit olusturmak

example_sentences.en: Revert the last commit because it introduced a bug.
example_sentences.tr: Son commiti geri al cunku bir hata tanitti.

common_patterns: revert a commit — commiti geri almak
scenario: Lead: 'Revert that commit in production, we'll fix it properly later.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler revert ve reset farkini bilmez. Revert yeni commit olusturur, reset gecmisi siler.

definition_en: To move the current branch pointer to a different commit, optionally modifying staging area and working directory
definition_tr: Mevcut dal gostericisini farkli bir commite tasimak

example_sentences.en: Reset the branch to the previous commit.
example_sentences.tr: Dali onceki commite sifirla.

scenario: Senior: 'Use a soft reset if you want to keep the changes staged.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler hard reset ile calismasini kalici olarak kaybedebilir.

definition_en: A command that shows the commit history of a repository
definition_tr: Deponun commit gecmisini gosteren komut

example_sentences.en: Check the git log to see recent changes.
example_sentences.tr: Son degisiklikleri gormek icin git log'a bak.

scenario: Dev: 'Check the log to see when this change was made.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler git log'un formatlama seceneklerini bilmez.

definition_en: A file containing changes that can be applied to code
definition_tr: Koda uygulanabilecek degisiklikleri iceren dosya

example_sentences.en: Generate a patch file for the bugfix.
example_sentences.tr: Hata duzeltmesi icin bir yama dosyasi olustur.

scenario: Senior: 'Send me a patch, I'll review it offline.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler patch dosyasi formatini anlamaz.

definition_en: A repository embedded inside another repository
definition_tr: Baska bir depo icine gomulmus depo

example_sentences.en: Update the submodule to the latest version.
example_sentences.tr: Alt modulu en son surume guncelle.

common_patterns: add a submodule — alt modul eklemek
scenario: Lead: 'Initialize the submodules after cloning.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler submodule init ve update yapmayı unutur.

definition_en: An additional working directory linked to the same repository
definition_tr: Ayni depoya bagli ek calisma dizini

example_sentences.en: Use a worktree to work on two branches simultaneously.
example_sentences.tr: Iki dalda ayni anda calismak icin worktree kullan.

scenario: Senior: 'Use worktrees instead of stashing when switching contexts.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler worktree ozelligini bilmez.

definition_en: A log of all reference updates in the local repository
definition_tr: Yerel depodaki tum referans guncellemelerinin kaydı

example_sentences.en: Use reflog to find the lost commit after a hard reset.
example_sentences.tr: Hard reset sonrasi kaybolan commiti bulmak icin reflog kullan.

scenario: Senior: 'Don't panic, check the reflog, your work is probably still there.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler reflog'un varligini bilmez, kayip commit sanir.

definition_en: A message sent by a client to a server asking for a resource or action
definition_tr: Bir istemcinin sunucuya kaynak veya eylem isteyen gonderdigi mesaj

example_sentences.en: The client sends a GET request to the server.
example_sentences.tr: Istemci sunucuya bir GET istegi gonderir.

scenario: Dev: 'Log the incoming request for debugging.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler request ve response'u karistirir.

definition_en: A message sent by a server back to the client after processing a request
definition_tr: Sunucunun bir istegi isledikten sonra istemciye gonderdigi mesaj

example_sentences.en: The server returns a JSON response.
example_sentences.tr: Sunucu bir JSON yaniti dondurur.

scenario: Dev: 'Check the response status code.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler response body'yi parse etmeyi unutur.

definition_en: A specific URL where an API can be accessed
definition_tr: Bir API'ye erisilebilen belirli URL

example_sentences.en: Create an endpoint for user registration.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici kaydi icin bir endpoint olustur.

common_patterns: hit an endpoint — endpoint'e istek atmak
scenario: Lead: 'What endpoints do we need for the user service?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler endpoint isimlendirmede RESTful kuralara uymaz.

definition_en: The address used to access a resource on the web
definition_tr: Web'de bir kaynaga erismek icin kullanilan adres

example_sentences.en: The API base URL is defined in the config.
example_sentences.tr: API temel URL'si config'de tanimli.

scenario: Dev: 'What's the URL for the staging environment?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler URL'de Turkce karakter kullanir, encoding sorunlari olusur.

definition_en: Key-value pairs appended to a URL to pass data to the server
definition_tr: Sunucuya veri gectirmek icin URL'e eklenen anahtar-deger ciftleri

example_sentences.en: Pass the page number as a query parameter.
example_sentences.tr: Sayfa numarasini sorgu parametresi olarak gecir.

common_patterns: add a query parameter — sorgu parametresi eklemek
parse query parameters — sorgu parametrelerini ayrismak
scenario: Dev: 'Use query parameters for filtering, not the request body.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler hassas verileri query parameter'da gonderir.

definition_en: Metadata sent along with HTTP requests and responses
definition_tr: HTTP istek ve yanitlariyla birlikte gonderilen ust veri

example_sentences.en: Set the Content-Type header to application/json.
example_sentences.tr: Content-Type basligini application/json olarak ayarla.

scenario: Dev: 'Pass the auth token in the Authorization header.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler header'lari dogru ayarlamamaktan dolayi CORS hatalari alir.

definition_en: The main data payload of an HTTP request or response
definition_tr: HTTP istek veya yanitinin ana veri yukü

example_sentences.en: Send the user data in the request body.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici verisini istek govdesinde gonder.

scenario: Dev: 'The user details should go in the POST body, not the URL.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler GET isteklerinde body gondermeye calisir.

definition_en: The actual data transmitted in a request or response
definition_tr: Istek veya yanitte iletilen gercek veri

example_sentences.en: The payload is too large, we need to paginate.
example_sentences.tr: Payload cok buyuk, sayfalama yapmamiz gerekiyor.

scenario: Lead: 'Minimize the payload size for mobile clients.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler gereksiz buyuk payload'lar gonderir.

definition_en: A three-digit number indicating the result of an HTTP request
definition_tr: HTTP isteginin sonucunu gosteren uc basamakli sayi

example_sentences.en: A 404 status code means the resource was not found.
example_sentences.tr: 404 durum kodu kaynag bulunamadi demektir.

common_patterns: return a status code — durum kodu dondurmek
scenario: Reviewer: 'Return 201 for created resources, not 200.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her sey icin 200 dondurur, dogru status code kullanmaz.

definition_en: An architectural style for designing networked applications using HTTP methods
definition_tr: HTTP metodlarini kullanan ag uygulamalari tasarlamak icin mimari yaklaşim

example_sentences.en: Design the API following REST principles.
example_sentences.tr: API'yi REST prensiplerine uygun tasarla.

scenario: Lead: 'Let's keep this RESTful — use proper HTTP methods.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler REST'in ne oldugunu bilir ama prensiplerini dogru uygulamaz.

definition_en: The four basic operations for persistent storage: Create, Read, Update, Delete
definition_tr: Kalici depolama icin dort temel islem: Olustur, Oku, Guncelle, Sil

example_sentences.en: Implement CRUD operations for the product entity.
example_sentences.tr: Urun varligi icin CRUD islemleri uygula.

scenario: Lead: 'Start with basic CRUD, we'll add complex logic later.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler CRUD disinda kalan islemlerin REST'te nasil ifade edilecegini bilmez.

definition_en: An HTTP method used to retrieve data from a server
definition_tr: Sunucudan veri almak icin kullanilan HTTP metodu

example_sentences.en: Use a GET request to fetch the user list.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici listesini almak icin GET istegi kullan.

scenario: Reviewer: 'This should be a GET, not a POST — it's just reading data.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler veri okuma icin POST kullanir.

definition_en: An HTTP method used to submit data to a server to create a resource
definition_tr: Kaynak olusturmak icin sunucuya veri gondermek icin kullanilan HTTP metodu

example_sentences.en: Send a POST request to create a new user.
example_sentences.tr: Yeni kullanici olusturmak icin POST istegi gonder.

scenario: Dev: 'Use POST for creating resources.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler POST ve PUT farkini karistirir.

definition_en: An HTTP method used to update or replace an existing resource
definition_tr: Mevcut bir kaynagi guncellemek veya degistirmek icin kullanilan HTTP metodu

example_sentences.en: Use PUT to update the entire user record.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici kaydinin tamamini guncellemek icin PUT kullan.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Use PATCH for partial updates, not PUT.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler PUT ve PATCH farkini bilmez.

definition_en: An HTTP method used to remove a resource from the server
definition_tr: Sunucudan bir kaynagi kaldirmak icin kullanilan HTTP metodu

example_sentences.en: Send a DELETE request to remove the user.
example_sentences.tr: Kullaniciyi silmek icin DELETE istegi gonder.

scenario: Lead: 'Implement soft delete instead of hard delete.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler hard delete yapar, soft delete dusunmez.

definition_en: Software that processes requests between the client and the server's request handler
definition_tr: Istemci ve sunucunun istek isleyicisi arasinda istekleri isleyen yazilim

example_sentences.en: Add CORS middleware to allow cross-origin requests.
example_sentences.tr: Cross-origin isteklere izin vermek icin CORS middleware'i ekle.

scenario: Dev: 'The auth middleware validates the JWT token.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler middleware sirasini yanlis yapilandirir.

definition_en: The process of mapping URLs to specific handlers or components
definition_tr: URL'leri belirli isleyicilere veya bilesenlere esleme sureci

example_sentences.en: Set up routing for the admin pages.
example_sentences.tr: Yonetici sayfalari icin yonlendirme ayarla.

scenario: Dev: 'We need dynamic routing for the product pages.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler client-side ve server-side routing farkini karistirir.

definition_en: An HTTP callback that sends data to a URL when a specific event occurs
definition_tr: Belirli bir olay gerceklestiginde bir URL'ye veri gonderen HTTP geri cagirimi

example_sentences.en: Set up a webhook to notify us when a payment is completed.
example_sentences.tr: Odeme tamamlandiginda bizi bilgilendirmek icin bir webhook ayarla.

scenario: Dev: 'Configure a webhook for Stripe payment events.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler webhook guvenligini (signature verification) ihmal eder.

definition_en: A protocol that enables full-duplex communication between client and server
definition_tr: Istemci ve sunucu arasinda tam cift yonlu iletisimi saglayan protokol

example_sentences.en: Use WebSockets for real-time chat functionality.
example_sentences.tr: Gercek zamanli sohbet islevi icin WebSocket kullan.

scenario: Lead: 'Use WebSockets instead of polling for live updates.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler WebSocket baglanti yonetimini (reconnection) dogru yapmaz.

definition_en: A security mechanism that controls how resources are shared across different origins
definition_tr: Kaynaklarin farkli kaynaklar arasinda nasil paylasildikini kontrol eden guvenlik mekanizmasi

example_sentences.en: Enable CORS to allow the frontend to call the API.
example_sentences.tr: Frontend'in API'yi cagirmasina izin vermek icin CORS'u etkinlestir.

scenario: Dev: 'I'm getting a CORS error when calling the API from localhost.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler CORS'u Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * ile cozer ki bu guvenlik acigi olusturur.

definition_en: The secure version of HTTP that encrypts data in transit
definition_tr: Aktarim sirasinda veriyi sifreleyen HTTP'nin guvenli surumu

example_sentences.en: Always use HTTPS in production.
example_sentences.tr: Production'da her zaman HTTPS kullan.

scenario: Lead: 'Make sure all API calls use HTTPS.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler development'ta HTTPS ayarlamayi atlar.

definition_en: A cryptographic protocol that provides security for communications over networks
definition_tr: Aglar uzerindeki iletisim icin guvenlik saglayan kriptografik protokol

example_sentences.en: Upgrade to TLS 1.3 for better security.
example_sentences.tr: Daha iyi guvenlik icin TLS 1.3'e yukselt.

scenario: Security engineer: 'We need to disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler TLS ve SSL'i ayni sey sanir.

definition_en: A system that translates domain names into IP addresses
definition_tr: Alan adlarini IP adreslerine ceviren sistem

example_sentences.en: The DNS propagation may take up to 48 hours.
example_sentences.tr: DNS yayilimi 48 saat surebilir.

scenario: DevOps: 'Update the DNS A record to point to the new server.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler DNS degisikliklerinin propagation suresini bilmez.

definition_en: A network of servers that delivers content to users based on their geographic location
definition_tr: Icerik kullanicilara cografi konumlarina gore dagitan sunucu agi

example_sentences.en: Serve static assets through a CDN for better performance.
example_sentences.tr: Daha iyi performans icin statik dosyalari CDN uzerinden sun.

scenario: Lead: 'Put our images and JS bundles behind a CDN.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler CDN cache invalidation'i dogru yapamazlar.

definition_en: A temporary storage that keeps frequently accessed data for faster retrieval
definition_tr: Sik erisilen verileri daha hizli erisim icin tutan gecici depolama

example_sentences.en: Clear the cache to see the latest changes.
example_sentences.tr: Son degisiklikleri gormek icin onbellegi temizle.

scenario: Senior: 'Cache invalidation is one of the hardest problems in CS.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler cache invalidation stratejisini dusunmez.

definition_en: Small piece of data stored in the browser by a website
definition_tr: Bir web sitesi tarafindan tarayicida saklanan kucuk veri parcasi

example_sentences.en: Store the session ID in an HTTP-only cookie.
example_sentences.tr: Oturum kimligini HTTP-only cerezde sakla.

scenario: Security engineer: 'Always use HTTP-only and Secure flags for cookies.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler cookie'leri guvenli bayraklar olmadan ayarlar.

definition_en: A period of interaction between a user and a server, maintaining state across requests
definition_tr: Kullanici ve sunucu arasindaki durum koruyan etkilesim sureci

example_sentences.en: Store user preferences in the session.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici tercihlerini oturumda sakla.

scenario: Lead: 'Use Redis for session storage in a distributed environment.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler session'lari sunucu belleginde tutar, olceklenmez.

definition_en: A compact token format for securely transmitting information between parties
definition_tr: Taraflar arasinda guvenli bilgi iletmek icin kompakt token formati

example_sentences.en: Verify the JWT before processing the request.
example_sentences.tr: Istegi islemeden once JWT'yi dogrula.

scenario: Security: 'Never store sensitive data in the JWT payload, it's not encrypted.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler JWT'yi localStorage'da saklar, XSS acigina neden olur.

definition_en: An authorization framework that allows third-party access without sharing credentials
definition_tr: Kimlik bilgilerini paylasmadan ucuncu taraf erisime izin veren yetkilendirme cercevesi

example_sentences.en: Implement OAuth 2.0 for social login.
example_sentences.tr: Sosyal giris icin OAuth 2.0 uygula.

scenario: Lead: 'Use OAuth for Google and GitHub login.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler OAuth flow'larini (authorization code, implicit) karistirir.

definition_en: Controlling the number of requests a client can make within a time period
definition_tr: Bir istemcinin belirli zaman diliminde yapabilecegi istek sayisini kontrol etme

example_sentences.en: Implement rate limiting to prevent API abuse.
example_sentences.tr: API kotu kullanimini onlemek icin hiz sinirlandirma uygula.

scenario: Lead: 'Add rate limiting before we get DDoS'd.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler rate limiting uygulamayi unutur, production'da sorun yasar.

definition_en: Dividing a large set of results into smaller pages for easier consumption
definition_tr: Buyuk sonuc kumesini daha kolay tuketim icin kucuk sayfalara bolme

example_sentences.en: Add pagination to the user list endpoint.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici listesi endpoint'ine sayfalama ekle.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Use cursor-based pagination instead of offset for better performance.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler offset-based pagination kullanir, buyuk veri setlerinde yavaslar.

definition_en: A query language for APIs that lets clients request exactly the data they need
definition_tr: Istemcilerin tam olarak ihtiyac duydukları veriyi istemesine izin veren API sorgu dili

example_sentences.en: With GraphQL, the client specifies which fields to return.
example_sentences.tr: GraphQL ile istemci hangi alanlarin donecegini belirtir.

scenario: Lead: 'Consider GraphQL if clients need different data shapes.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler GraphQL'i her projede kullanmaya calisir, REST yeterli olsa bile.

definition_en: The process of verifying the identity of a user or system
definition_tr: Bir kullanici veya sistemin kimligini dogrulama sureci

example_sentences.en: Implement two-factor authentication for added security.
example_sentences.tr: Ek guvenlik icin iki faktorlu kimlik dogrulama uygula.

scenario: Lead: 'We need to add multi-factor authentication.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler authentication ve authorization farkini bilmez.

definition_en: The process of determining what resources a user is allowed to access
definition_tr: Bir kullanicinin hangi kaynaklara erismesine izin verildigini belirleme sureci

example_sentences.en: Check authorization before allowing access to admin pages.
example_sentences.tr: Yonetici sayfalarina erisme izin vermeden once yetkilendirmeyi kontrol et.

scenario: Lead: 'Only admins should be authorized to delete users.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler authentication ve authorization'i karistirir: biri kim oldugunu, digeri ne yapabilecegini belirler.

definition_en: Rendering web pages on the server before sending them to the client
definition_tr: Web sayfalarini istemciye gondermeden once sunucuda render etme

example_sentences.en: Use SSR for better SEO and initial load performance.
example_sentences.tr: Daha iyi SEO ve ilk yukleme performansi icin SSR kullan.

common_patterns: SSR vs CSR — SSR ve CSR karsilastirmasi
scenario: Lead: 'We need SSR for the landing page for SEO.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler SSR'in ne zaman gerekli olduguna karar veremez.

definition_en: Rendering web pages in the browser using JavaScript
definition_tr: Web sayfalarini tarayicida JavaScript kullanarak render etme

example_sentences.en: CSR is suitable for interactive dashboards.
example_sentences.tr: CSR interaktif panolar icin uygundur.

scenario: Dev: 'CSR gives us faster page transitions.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her seyi CSR yapar, SSR'in gerekli oldugu durumlari kacirır.

definition_en: A web application that loads a single page and dynamically updates content
definition_tr: Tek bir sayfa yukleyen ve icerigi dinamik olarak guncelleyen web uygulamasi

example_sentences.en: Our app is a SPA built with React.
example_sentences.tr: Uygulamamiz React ile insa edilmis bir SPA.

common_patterns: single page application — tek sayfa uygulama
scenario: Lead: 'Building this as a SPA will give users a smoother experience.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler SPA'nin SEO sorunlarini goz ardi eder.

definition_en: Generating static HTML pages at build time instead of on each request
definition_tr: Her istekte degil, build zamaninda statik HTML sayfalari olusturma

example_sentences.en: Use SSG for the blog pages since the content rarely changes.
example_sentences.tr: Blog sayfalari icin SSG kullan cunku icerik nadiren degisir.

common_patterns: static site generation — statik site olusturma
scenario: Lead: 'SSG is perfect for documentation sites.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler SSG'yi sadece blog icin kullanir, daha genis kullanim alanlarini bilmez.

definition_en: An HTTP method used to apply partial modifications to a resource
definition_tr: Bir kaynaga kismi degisiklikler uygulamak icin kullanilan HTTP metodu

example_sentences.en: Use PATCH to update just the email field.
example_sentences.tr: Sadece e-posta alanini guncellemek icin PATCH kullan.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Use PATCH, not PUT, since you're only updating one field.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler PATCH yerine her zaman PUT kullanir.

definition_en: An operation that produces the same result regardless of how many times it is performed
definition_tr: Kac kez yapilirsa yapilsin ayni sonucu ureten islem

example_sentences.en: PUT requests should be idempotent.
example_sentences.tr: PUT istekleri idempotent olmalidir.

scenario: Lead: 'Make sure this endpoint is idempotent to handle retries safely.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler idempotency kavramini bilmez, retry mantikinda sorun yasar.

definition_en: The time delay between a request being sent and a response being received
definition_tr: Istegin gonderilmesi ile yanitin alinmasi arasindaki zaman gecikmesi

example_sentences.en: High latency causes a poor user experience.
example_sentences.tr: Yuksek gecikme kotu kullanici deneyimine neden olur.

scenario: Lead: 'We need to reduce the API latency to under 200ms.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler latency ve throughput farkini karistirir.

definition_en: Limiting the rate at which a function or request can be executed
definition_tr: Bir fonksiyon veya istegin calistirilabilecegi hizi sinirlandirma

example_sentences.en: Throttle the scroll event handler to improve performance.
example_sentences.tr: Performansi artirmak icin scroll event handler'ini throttle et.

scenario: Senior: 'Throttle this API call to once per second.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler throttle ve debounce farkini bilmez.

definition_en: Delaying execution until a pause in events
definition_tr: Olaylarda bir duraklama olana kadar calistirmayi geciktirme

example_sentences.en: Debounce the search input to avoid too many API calls.
example_sentences.tr: Cok fazla API cagrisi onlemek icin arama girdisini debounce et.

common_patterns: debounce the input — girdiyi debounce etmek
scenario: Reviewer: 'Add a debounce to this search field.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her tuslama icin API cagrisi yapar, debounce kullanmaz.

definition_en: A defect or flaw in software that causes it to behave unexpectedly
definition_tr: Yazilimda beklenmeyen davranisa neden olan kusur

example_sentences.en: I found a bug in the login flow.
example_sentences.tr: Giris akisinda bir hata buldum.

common_patterns: reproduce a bug — hatayi yeniden uretmek
scenario: QA: 'I found a critical bug in the checkout process.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler bug'i 'yeniden uretmek' (reproduce) yerine 'bulmak' der.

definition_en: An unexpected condition that prevents normal program execution
definition_tr: Normal program calistirmayi engelleyen beklenmeyen durum

example_sentences.en: Handle the error gracefully instead of crashing.
example_sentences.tr: Cokmek yerine hatayi zarifce ele al.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Add proper error handling here.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler hatalari catch edip sessizce yutar, loglama yapmaz.

definition_en: An error that occurs when a value is not of the expected type
definition_tr: Bir deger beklenen tipte olmadiginda olusan hata

example_sentences.en: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined.
example_sentences.tr: TypeError: undefined'in ozelliklerini okuyamaz.

common_patterns: fix a TypeError — tip hatasini duzetmek
scenario: Dev: 'I keep getting a TypeError on this line.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler null/undefined kontrolu yapmadan property'ye erisir.

definition_en: An error caused by incorrect syntax in the code
definition_tr: Koddaki yanlis sozdiziminden kaynaklanan hata

example_sentences.en: Fix the SyntaxError caused by the missing bracket.
example_sentences.tr: Eksik parantezin neden oldugu SyntaxError'u duzelt.

common_patterns: SyntaxError at line — satirda sozdizimi hatasi
scenario: Dev: 'There's a SyntaxError, check for missing semicolons.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler JSON syntax hatalarini bulmakta zorlanir.

definition_en: An error that occurs when trying to use a reference that points to null
definition_tr: Null'i isaret eden bir referansi kullanmaya calisirken olusan hata

example_sentences.en: Check for null before accessing the property to avoid a null pointer exception.
example_sentences.tr: Null pointer exception'dan kacinmak icin property'ye erismeden once null kontrolu yap.

common_patterns: null pointer exception — null gosterici istisnasi
scenario: Dev: 'We have a null pointer exception in production.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler optional chaining (?.) kullanmayi dusunmez.

definition_en: An error that occurs when an operation takes longer than the allowed time
definition_tr: Bir islem izin verilen sureden fazla surdiginde olusan hata

example_sentences.en: The API call timed out after 30 seconds.
example_sentences.tr: API cagrisi 30 saniye sonra zaman asimina ugradi.

common_patterns: set a timeout — zaman asimi ayarlamak
scenario: Dev: 'Increase the timeout for this slow query.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler timeout degerlerini cok yuksek ayarlar.

definition_en: A loop that never terminates because the exit condition is never met
definition_tr: Cikis kosulu hicbir zaman karsilanmadigi icin asla sonlanmayan dongu

example_sentences.en: The application froze due to an infinite loop.
example_sentences.tr: Uygulama sonsuz dongu nedeniyle dondu.

common_patterns: stuck in an infinite loop — sonsuz donguye takildik
scenario: Dev: 'I think we have an infinite loop — the browser tab crashed.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler while dongusunde cikis kosulunu guncellemeyi unutur.

definition_en: An error where a loop iterates one too many or too few times
definition_tr: Dongutun bir fazla veya bir eksik yineleme yaptigi hata

example_sentences.en: Watch out for off-by-one errors in array indexing.
example_sentences.tr: Dizi indekslemede off-by-one hatailarina dikkat et.

scenario: Reviewer: 'You have an off-by-one error, the last element is skipped.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler dizi sinirlarda 0-based indexing'i karistirir.

definition_en: A bug that causes previously working functionality to break
definition_tr: Daha once calisan islevselliin bozulmasina neden olan hata

example_sentences.en: This update caused a regression in the search feature.
example_sentences.tr: Bu guncelleme arama ozelliginde bir regresyona neden oldu.

scenario: QA: 'We found a regression after the last deploy.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler regression test yazmaz, ayni hata tekrar tekrar olusur.

definition_en: An urgent fix applied directly to the production environment
definition_tr: Dogrudan production ortamina uygulanan acil duzeltme

example_sentences.en: Deploy a hotfix for the critical payment bug.
example_sentences.tr: Kritik odeme hatasi icin bir hotfix deploy et.

scenario: Lead: 'We need a hotfix ASAP, payments are failing.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler hotfix'i test etmeden deploy eder.

definition_en: A marker in code that tells the debugger to pause execution at that point
definition_tr: Hata ayiklayiciya calistirmayi o noktada duraklatmasini soyleyen isaretleyici

example_sentences.en: Set a breakpoint on line 42 to inspect the variable.
example_sentences.tr: Degiskeni incelemek icin 42. satira breakpoint koy.

common_patterns: set a breakpoint — kesme noktasi koymak
hit a breakpoint — kesme noktasina ulasmak
scenario: Senior: 'Set a breakpoint there and check what value the variable has.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler console.log ile debug eder, breakpoint kullanmaz.

definition_en: A tool used to test and find bugs by stepping through code execution
definition_tr: Kod calistirilmasinda adim adim ilerleyerek hatalari test etmek ve bulmak icin kullanilan arac

example_sentences.en: Open the debugger to trace the execution flow.
example_sentences.tr: Calistirma akisini izlemek icin debugger'i ac.

common_patterns: step through in the debugger — debugger'da adim adim ilerlemek
scenario: Senior: 'Use the debugger instead of console.log for complex issues.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler IDE'nin debugger ozelliklerini kullanmaz.

definition_en: Recording events and data during program execution for debugging and monitoring
definition_tr: Hata ayiklama ve izleme icin program calistirilmasi sirasinda olaylari ve verileri kaydetme

example_sentences.en: Add logging to track the order processing flow.
example_sentences.tr: Siparis isleme akisini izlemek icin loglama ekle.

scenario: Lead: 'We need better logging in production for incident investigation.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler console.log birakir production'da, structured logging kullanmaz.

definition_en: A classification of log messages by severity: debug, info, warn, error
definition_tr: Kayit mesajlarinin ciddiyete gore siniflandirilmasi: debug, info, warn, error

example_sentences.en: Set the log level to warn in production.
example_sentences.tr: Production'da log seviyesini warn olarak ayarla.

common_patterns: set the log level — log seviyesini ayarlamak
scenario: DevOps: 'Change the log level to debug to investigate the issue.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her seyi error seviyesinde loglar.

definition_en: A statement that handles exceptions by trying a block of code and catching errors
definition_tr: Bir kod blogunu deneyerek ve hatalari yakalayarak istisna ele alan ifade

example_sentences.en: Wrap the API call in a try-catch block.
example_sentences.tr: API cagrisini try-catch bloguna sar.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Add a try-catch around this async operation.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler catch blogunu bos birakir, hatalari yutar.

definition_en: To generate an error or exception intentionally
definition_tr: Kasitli olarak bir hata veya istisna olusturmak

example_sentences.en: Throw an error if the input is invalid.
example_sentences.tr: Girdi gecersizse bir hata firlat.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Throw a specific error type, not a generic Error.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler string firlatir (throw 'error'), Error nesnesi kullanmalidir.

definition_en: A statement that checks whether a condition is true and throws an error if not
definition_tr: Bir kosulun dogru olup olmadigini kontrol eden, degilse hata firlatan ifade

example_sentences.en: Add assertions to validate function preconditions.
example_sentences.tr: Fonksiyon on kosullarini dogrulamak icin assertion ekle.

scenario: Senior: 'Use assertions for things that should never happen.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler assertion'lari test disinda kullanmaz.

definition_en: An error that occurs when the call stack exceeds its maximum size, typically due to infinite recursion
definition_tr: Cagri yigini maksimum boyutunu astiginda olusan hata, genellikle sonsuz ozyineleme nedeniyle

example_sentences.en: The recursive function caused a stack overflow.
example_sentences.tr: Ozyinelemeli fonksiyon yigin tasmasina neden oldu.

common_patterns: stack overflow error — yigin tasmasi hatasi
scenario: Dev: 'I'm getting a stack overflow — the recursion has no base case.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler base case'i dogru tanimlamaz.

definition_en: A bug that occurs when the outcome depends on the timing of concurrent operations
definition_tr: Sonucun esanli islemlerin zamanlamasina baglt oldugu hata

example_sentences.en: There's a race condition when two users update the same record.
example_sentences.tr: Iki kullanici ayni kaydi guncellediginde race condition olusuyor.

common_patterns: race condition bug — yaris durumu hatasi
avoid race conditions — yaris durumlarindan kacinmak
scenario: Senior: 'This looks like a race condition — it only fails under load.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler race condition'lari tespit etmekte zorlanir cunku tekrarlanmasi zordur.

definition_en: A situation where two or more processes are waiting for each other, and none can proceed
definition_tr: Iki veya daha fazla prosesin birbirini bekledigi ve hicbirinin ilerleyemedigi durum

example_sentences.en: The database transactions caused a deadlock.
example_sentences.tr: Veritabani islemleri bir kitlenmeye neden oldu.

scenario: DBA: 'We have a deadlock in the database, queries are hanging.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler deadlock'lari onleyici tasarim yapmaz.

definition_en: An error when a program tries to use more memory than available
definition_tr: Program mevcut bellekten fazlasini kullanmaya calistiginda olusan hata

example_sentences.en: Processing the large file caused a memory overflow.
example_sentences.tr: Buyuk dosyanin islenmesi bellek tasmasina neden oldu.

common_patterns: memory overflow error — bellek tasmasi hatasi
scenario: DevOps: 'The container ran out of memory and was killed.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler buyuk dosyalari streaming yerine bellege tamamen yukler.

definition_en: A promise rejection that is not caught by any error handler
definition_tr: Hicbir hata isleyicisi tarafindan yakalanmayan promise reddi

example_sentences.en: Fix the unhandled promise rejection warning.
example_sentences.tr: Islenmeyen promise rejection uyarisini duzelt.

common_patterns: unhandled promise rejection — islenmeyen promise reddi
