scenario: Dev: 'We have unhandled rejections in the logs, add catch blocks.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler async fonksiyonlarin hata yonetimini ihmal eder.

definition_en: Marking a feature or method as outdated and scheduled for removal
definition_tr: Bir ozellik veya metodu eskimis ve kaldirilmak uzere planlanmis olarak isaretleme

example_sentences.en: This method is deprecated, use the new API instead.
example_sentences.tr: Bu metod kullanim disi birakildi, bunun yerine yeni API'yi kullanin.

common_patterns: deprecated method — kullanim disi birakilmis metod
scenario: Lead: 'Update the deprecated calls before the next major version.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler deprecation uyarilarini gormezden gelir.

definition_en: An unusual scenario that occurs at the boundary of operating parameters
definition_tr: Calisma parametrelerinin sinirinda olusan olagan disi senaryo

example_sentences.en: Test the edge cases: empty input, very long strings, special characters.
example_sentences.tr: Sinir durumlarini test et: bos girdi, cok uzun stringler, ozel karakterler.

common_patterns: handle edge cases — sinir durumlarini ele almak
edge case testing — sinir durumu testi
scenario: Reviewer: 'What happens in the edge case where the list is empty?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler edge case'leri dusunmez, sadece happy path'i test eder.

definition_en: The default scenario where everything works as expected without any errors
definition_tr: Her seyin hatasiz beklenildigi gibi calistigi varsayilan senaryo

example_sentences.en: Don't just test the happy path, consider error scenarios too.
example_sentences.tr: Sadece happy path'i test etmeyin, hata senaryolarini da dusunun.

common_patterns: happy path testing — mutlu yol testi
scenario: Reviewer: 'This only covers the happy path. What about errors?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler sadece happy path'e odaklanir.

definition_en: The process of responding to and recovering from errors during program execution
definition_tr: Program calistirma sirasinda hatalara yanit verme ve hatalardan kurtulma sureci

example_sentences.en: Implement proper exception handling for all database operations.
example_sentences.tr: Tum veritabani islemleri icin uygun istisna yonetimi uygula.

common_patterns: global exception handler — genel istisna isleyicisi
scenario: Lead: 'We need a global exception handler for unhandled errors.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler exception handling'i sonraya birakir ve unutur.

definition_en: An alternative action or value used when the primary option fails
definition_tr: Birincil secenek basarisiz olduğunda kullanilan alternatif eylem veya deger

example_sentences.en: Provide a fallback value if the API call fails.
example_sentences.tr: API cagrisi basarisiz olursa yedek deger sagla.

scenario: Lead: 'What's the fallback if the payment gateway is down?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler fallback stratejisi tasarlamaz.

definition_en: The ability to continue operating at reduced functionality when part of the system fails
definition_tr: Sistemin bir bölümü basarisiz olduğunda azaltilmis islevsellikle calismaya devam etme yeteneği

example_sentences.en: Implement graceful degradation so the app still works without the recommendation engine.
example_sentences.tr: Oneri motoru olmadan uygulama hala calisssin diye graceful degradation uygula.

scenario: Architect: 'The app should degrade gracefully when third-party services are down.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ya tamamen calisir ya tamamen bozulur seklinde tasarim yapar.

definition_en: A component that catches JavaScript errors in its child component tree
definition_tr: Cocuk bilesen agacindaki JavaScript hatalarini yakalayan bilesen

example_sentences.en: Wrap the dashboard in an error boundary to prevent full-page crashes.
example_sentences.tr: Tam sayfa cokmeleri onlemek icin dashboard'u error boundary ile sar.

common_patterns: error boundary component — hata siniri bileseni
scenario: Senior: 'Add an error boundary around this section.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler error boundary kullanmaz, tek hata tum sayfayi cokertirir.

definition_en: An error that occurs when input data does not meet specified requirements
definition_tr: Girdi verileri belirtilen gereksinimleri karsilamadiginda olusan hata

example_sentences.en: Return a validation error if the email format is incorrect.
example_sentences.tr: E-posta formati yanlis ise dogrulama hatasi dondur.

common_patterns: validation error message — dogrulama hata mesaji
scenario: Reviewer: 'Add client-side validation before sending the request.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler sadece client-side validation yapar, server-side'i ihmal eder.

definition_en: Cleaning input data to prevent security vulnerabilities like XSS and SQL injection
definition_tr: XSS ve SQL injection gibi guvenlik aciklariini onlemek icin girdi verilerini temizleme

example_sentences.en: Sanitize user input before inserting it into the database.
example_sentences.tr: Veritabanina eklemeden once kullanici girdisini temizle.

scenario: Security: 'Always sanitize user input to prevent injection attacks.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kullanici girdisini dogrudan SQL sorgusuna koyar.

definition_en: A brief daily team meeting to share progress and blockers
definition_tr: Ilerleme ve engelleyicileri paylassmak icin kisa gunluk takim toplantisi

example_sentences.en: In today's standup, I'll share what I worked on yesterday.
example_sentences.tr: Bugunku standup'ta dun ne uzerinde calistigimi paylasacagim.

scenario: Scrum master: 'Keep the standup under 15 minutes.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler standup'ta cok detaya girer, kisa ve oz olmalidir.

definition_en: A fixed time period, usually 1-2 weeks, during which specific work must be completed
definition_tr: Belirli isin tamamlanmasi gereken, genellikle 1-2 haftalik sabit zaman dilimi

example_sentences.en: We'll complete the user authentication feature in this sprint.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici kimlik dogrulama ozelligini bu sprint'te tamamlayacagiz.

scenario: Scrum master: 'What can we commit to for this sprint?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler sprint icerisinde scope creep'e izin verir.

definition_en: A meeting where the team decides what work to do in the upcoming sprint
definition_tr: Takimin gelecek sprint'te ne yapacagini kararlastirdigi toplanti

example_sentences.en: Let's discuss the priorities in the planning meeting.
example_sentences.tr: Planlama toplantisinda oncelikleri tartisalim.

scenario: Lead: 'Come to planning with your estimates ready.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler planlama toplantilarina hazirliksiz gelir.

definition_en: A meeting held at the end of a sprint to reflect on what went well and what can be improved
definition_tr: Sprint sonunda neyin iyi gittigini ve neyin iyilestirilebilecegini degerlendirmek icin yapilan toplanti

example_sentences.en: In the retro, we identified communication as an area for improvement.
example_sentences.tr: Retro'da iletisimi iyilestirme alani olarak belirledik.

common_patterns: retro action items — retro eylem maddeleri
scenario: Scrum master: 'What should we start, stop, and continue doing?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler retro'da dusuncelerini paylassmaktan cekinir.

definition_en: A prioritized list of work items waiting to be done
definition_tr: Yapilmayi bekleyen onceliklendirilmis is maddeleri listesi

example_sentences.en: Add the new feature request to the backlog.
example_sentences.tr: Yeni ozellik talebini backlog'a ekle.

scenario: Product owner: 'Let's groom the backlog before the next sprint.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler backlog'u duzenli temizlemez, cok buyur.

definition_en: A description of a feature from the end user's perspective
definition_tr: Son kullanici perspektifinden bir ozelligin tanimi

example_sentences.en: Write a user story: As a user, I want to reset my password.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici hikayesi yaz: Kullanici olarak sifremi sifirlamak istiyorum.

common_patterns: write a user story — kullanici hikayesi yazmak
As a... I want... So that... — ...olarak ...istiyorum ...icin
scenario: PO: 'This user story needs clearer acceptance criteria.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler user story yerine teknik gorev yazar.

definition_en: Conditions that must be met for a user story to be considered complete
definition_tr: Bir kullanici hikayesinin tamamlanmis sayilmasi icin karsilanmasi gereken kosullar

example_sentences.en: Define clear acceptance criteria before starting development.
example_sentences.tr: Gelistirmeye baslamadan once net kabul kriterleri tanimla.

common_patterns: meet the acceptance criteria — kabul kriterlerini karsilamak
scenario: QA: 'This doesn't meet the acceptance criteria.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kabul kriterlerini belirsiz birakir.

definition_en: A large body of work that can be broken down into smaller user stories
definition_tr: Daha kucuk kullanici hikayelerine bolunebilen buyuk is birimii

example_sentences.en: The payment system is an epic containing 15 user stories.
example_sentences.tr: Odeme sistemi 15 kullanici hikayesi iceren bir epic.

common_patterns: break down an epic — epic'i parcalamak
scenario: PO: 'Let's break this epic into smaller, deliverable stories.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler epic'leri yeterince parcalamaz.

definition_en: An issue that prevents progress on a task
definition_tr: Bir gorevde ilerlemeyi engelleyen sorun

example_sentences.en: I have a blocker — I need access to the staging database.
example_sentences.tr: Bir engelleyicim var — staging veritabanina erisime ihtiyacim var.

scenario: Dev: 'This is a blocker, I can't proceed without the API key.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler blocker'lari zamaninda bildirmez, sessizce bekler.

definition_en: The amount of work a team can complete in a sprint, measured in story points
definition_tr: Takimin bir sprint'te tamamlayabilecegi is miktari, hikaye puanlariyla olculur

example_sentences.en: Our velocity last sprint was 42 story points.
example_sentences.tr: Gecen sprint'teki hizimiz 42 hikaye puaniydi.

scenario: Scrum master: 'Based on our velocity, we can take on 40 points this sprint.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler velocity'yi gercekci hesaplamaz.

definition_en: A visual workflow management method using boards and cards
definition_tr: Panolar ve kartlar kullanan gorsel is akisi yonetim yontemi

example_sentences.en: Move your card to the 'In Progress' column on the Kanban board.
example_sentences.tr: Kartinizi Kanban panosunda 'Devam Ediyor' sutununa tasiyin.

common_patterns: WIP limit — devam eden is siniri
scenario: Lead: 'Update your Kanban card when you start working on a task.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler Kanban kartlarini guncellemeyi unutur.

definition_en: A methodology that emphasizes iterative development and collaboration
definition_tr: Yinelemeli gelistirme ve is birligini vurgulayan metodoloji

example_sentences.en: We follow agile practices like daily standups and sprint reviews.
example_sentences.tr: Gunluk standup ve sprint inceleme gibi cevik pratikleri izliyoruz.

scenario: Manager: 'We're transitioning to agile next quarter.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler agile'i sadece standup yapmak sanir.

definition_en: An agile framework for managing work with defined roles, events, and artifacts
definition_tr: Tanimli roller, etkinlikler ve eserlerle isi yonetmek icin cevik cerceve

example_sentences.en: Our team uses Scrum with two-week sprints.
example_sentences.tr: Takimimiz iki haftalik sprint'lerle Scrum kullaniyor.

scenario: Manager: 'We need a certified Scrum Master for the team.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler Scrum seramonilerini gereksiz gorur.

definition_en: A person or group with interest or concern in a project
definition_tr: Projede cikari veya ilgisi olan kisi veya grup

example_sentences.en: Present the demo to the stakeholders at the end of the sprint.
example_sentences.tr: Sprint sonunda paydaislara demo sunun.

scenario: PO: 'The stakeholders want to see a demo of the new feature.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler stakeholder'larla iletisim kurmaktan kacinir.

definition_en: Two developers working together on the same code at one workstation
definition_tr: Iki gelistiricinin ayni is istasyonunda ayni kod uzerinde birlikte calismasi

example_sentences.en: Let's do pair programming to tackle this complex algorithm.
example_sentences.tr: Bu karmasik algoritmayi cozmek icin esli programlama yapalim.

common_patterns: driver and navigator — surucu ve navigatork
scenario: Senior: 'Let's pair on this, I can show you the patterns we use.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler pair programming'i zaman kaybi olarak gorur.

definition_en: The process of examining someone's code changes before they are merged
definition_tr: Birisinin kod degisikliklerini birlesmeden once inceleme sureci

example_sentences.en: Please submit your code for review before merging.
example_sentences.tr: Birlestirmeden once kodunuzu inceleme icin gonderin.

common_patterns: request a code review — kod inceleme istemek
code review feedback — kod inceleme geri bildirimi
scenario: Lead: 'No code goes to production without a code review.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler code review'da yeterli geri bildirim vermez.

definition_en: A private meeting between a manager and a team member
definition_tr: Yonetici ve takim uyesi arasindaki ozel toplanti

example_sentences.en: Let's discuss your career goals in our next 1:1.
example_sentences.tr: Kariyer hedeflerinizi bir sonraki 1:1'de tartisalim.

common_patterns: schedule a 1:1 — bire bir gorusme planlamak
scenario: Manager: 'I'd like to discuss your progress in our 1:1.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler 1:1'lerde sorunlarini dile getirmez.

definition_en: A meeting or communication to align on shared goals or progress
definition_tr: Ortak hedefler veya ilerleme konusunda hizalanmak icin toplanti veya iletisim

example_sentences.en: Let's have a quick sync about the API changes.
example_sentences.tr: API degisiklikleri hakkinda hizli bir sync yapalim.

scenario: Lead: 'Can we sync tomorrow morning about the deployment?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler gereksiz sync toplantilari yapar.

definition_en: Communication that does not require all parties to be present at the same time
definition_tr: Tum taraflarin ayni anda hazir bulunmasini gerektirmeyen iletisim

example_sentences.en: Use async communication for non-urgent questions.
example_sentences.tr: Acil olmayan sorular icin asenkron iletisim kullan.

scenario: Lead: 'Post it on Slack instead of scheduling a meeting — async is fine for this.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her sey icin toplanti ayarlar, async iletisimi tercih etmeli.

definition_en: The latest date or time by which a task must be completed
definition_tr: Bir gorevin tamamlanmasi gereken en son tarih veya zaman

example_sentences.en: The deadline for this feature is end of next week.
example_sentences.tr: Bu ozelligin son tarihi gelecek haftanin sonu.

common_patterns: meet the deadline — son tarihi karsilamak
extend the deadline — son tarihi uzatmak
scenario: Manager: 'Can we meet this deadline, or do we need to cut scope?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler deadline'i asmayı normallestirir.

definition_en: Estimated Time of Arrival - when something is expected to be completed
definition_tr: Tahmini Tamamlanma Zamani - bir seyin ne zaman tamamlanmasinin beklendigi

example_sentences.en: What's your ETA for the bugfix?
example_sentences.tr: Bugfix icin ETA'n ne?

scenario: Lead: 'Can you give me an ETA on the API integration?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler cok iyimser ETA verir.

definition_en: End of Day - by the end of the business day
definition_tr: Is gununun sonu

example_sentences.en: Can you finish this by EOD?
example_sentences.tr: Bunu gun sonuna kadar bitirebilir misin?

scenario: Manager: 'I need the report by EOD.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler EOD'un hangi saat dilimine gore oldugunu sormaz.

definition_en: As Soon As Possible - as quickly as can be done
definition_tr: Mumkun olan en kisa surede

example_sentences.en: We need this fix deployed ASAP.
example_sentences.tr: Bu duzeltmenin ASAP deploy edilmesi gerekiyor.

common_patterns: fix this ASAP — bunu en kisa surede duzelt
scenario: Manager: 'This is P0, fix it ASAP.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her seyi ASAP olarak isaretler, onceliklendirme yapmaz.

definition_en: For Your Information - sharing information without requiring action
definition_tr: Bilginize - eylem gerektirmeden bilgi paylasimi

example_sentences.en: FYI, the staging server will be down for maintenance tomorrow.
example_sentences.tr: FYI, staging sunucusu yarin bakim icin kapanacak.

scenario: DevOps: 'FYI, we're upgrading the database tonight.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler FYI mesajlarina yanit verme zorunlulugu hisseder.

definition_en: The boundaries and extent of work included in a project or feature
definition_tr: Projeye veya ozellige dahil edilen isin sinirlari ve boyutu

example_sentences.en: We need to define the scope before starting development.
example_sentences.tr: Gelistirmeye baslamadan once kapsami belirlememiz gerekiyor.

scenario: PO: 'That's out of scope for this sprint.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler scope creep'e hayir diyemez.

definition_en: The process of predicting how long a task will take to complete
definition_tr: Bir gorevin tamamlanmasinin ne kadar surecegini tahmin etme sureci

example_sentences.en: Story point estimation helps with sprint planning.
example_sentences.tr: Hikaye puani tahmini sprint planlamasina yardimci olur.

common_patterns: estimate the effort — efor tahmin etmek
scenario: Scrum master: 'Let's do a round of estimation for these stories.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tahminlerde cok iyimserdir, 2x kural uygulanmalidir.

definition_en: A unit of measure for expressing the overall effort required to complete a user story
definition_tr: Bir kullanici hikayesini tamamlamak icin gereken toplam eforu ifade eden olcu birimi

example_sentences.en: I'd estimate this task at 5 story points.
example_sentences.tr: Bu gorevi 5 hikaye puani olarak tahmin ederim.

common_patterns: assign story points — hikaye puani atamak
story point estimate — hikaye puani tahmini
scenario: Dev: 'This looks like an 8-pointer, it's complex.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler story point'i zaman birimi olarak algilar, karmasiklik olcusu olmalidir.

definition_en: The accumulated cost of shortcuts and suboptimal solutions in code
definition_tr: Koddaki kisayollar ve ideal altı cozumlerin biriken maliyeti

example_sentences.en: We need to allocate time to address our tech debt.
example_sentences.tr: Teknik borcumuzu ele almak icin zaman ayirmamiz gerekiyor.

common_patterns: pay off tech debt — teknik borcu odemek
accrue tech debt — teknik borc biriktirmek
scenario: Lead: 'We've been accumulating tech debt, let's dedicate a sprint to fixing it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tech debt'i gormezden gelir ta ki sistem cokene kadar.

definition_en: The process of integrating a new team member into the project and organization
definition_tr: Yeni bir takim uyesini projeye ve organizasyona entegre etme sureci

example_sentences.en: Update the onboarding guide for new developers.
example_sentences.tr: Yeni gelistiriciler icin ise alistirma rehberini guncelle.

common_patterns: onboard a new member — yeni uyeyi alistirmak
scenario: Lead: 'Can you help onboard the new developer this week?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler onboarding dokumantasyonunu guncel tutmaz.

definition_en: The transfer of responsibility for a task or project from one person to another
definition_tr: Bir gorev veya projenin sorumlulugunun bir kisiden digerine aktarilmasi

example_sentences.en: Document everything for a smooth handoff.
example_sentences.tr: Sorunsuz bir devir icin her seyi belgelendirin.

scenario: Lead: 'We need a proper handoff before you move to the other team.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler handoff yapmadan proje degistirir.

definition_en: To release software to a production or staging environment
definition_tr: Yazilimi production veya staging ortamina yayinlamak

example_sentences.en: We deploy every Friday afternoon.
example_sentences.tr: Her cuma oğleden sonra deploy ediyoruz.

common_patterns: deploy to production — production'a deploy etmek
scenario: Lead: 'Never deploy on a Friday afternoon.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler cuma gunleri deploy yapar ve hafta sonunu hata duzeltmeyle gecirir.

definition_en: Reverting a deployment to a previous stable version
definition_tr: Dagitimi onceki kararli surume geri dondurme

example_sentences.en: We need to rollback the latest deployment due to critical bugs.
example_sentences.tr: Kritik hatalar nedeniyle son dagitimi geri almamiz gerekiyor.

common_patterns: trigger a rollback — geri almayi tetiklemek
scenario: DevOps: 'Rollback to the previous version, this release is broken.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler rollback plani olmadan deploy eder.

definition_en: An unplanned event that disrupts the normal operation of a service
definition_tr: Bir hizmetin normal isleyisini bozan plansiz olay

example_sentences.en: We had a P1 incident that affected all users.
example_sentences.tr: Tum kullanicilari etkileyen bir P1 olay yasadik.

scenario: On-call: 'We have a P1 incident, the site is down.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler incident post-mortem yapmaz, ayni hatalar tekrarlanir.

definition_en: An analysis conducted after an incident to understand what went wrong and prevent recurrence
definition_tr: Neyin yanlis gittigini anlamak ve tekrari onlemek icin bir olay sonrasi yapilan analiz

example_sentences.en: Write a blameless postmortem for the outage.
example_sentences.tr: Kesinti icin suclamayan bir postmortem yaz.

scenario: Lead: 'Let's do a blameless postmortem to learn from this incident.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler postmortem'i suclama seansina cevirir.

definition_en: A developer responsible for responding to production issues outside regular hours
definition_tr: Mesai disi saatlerde production sorunlarina mudahale etmekten sorumlu gelistirici

example_sentences.en: I'm on-call this week, so I'll handle any alerts.
example_sentences.tr: Bu hafta nobetciyim, herhangi bir uyariyla ben ilgilenecegim.

scenario: Lead: 'Who's on-call this weekend?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler on-call surecini stresli bulur, iyi runbook'lar hazirlanmalidir.

definition_en: To officially agree that code changes are acceptable and can be merged
definition_tr: Kod degisikliklerinin kabul edilebilir oldugunu ve birlestirilebilecegini resmi olarak onaylamak

example_sentences.en: I'll approve the PR once you fix the test.
example_sentences.tr: Testi duzelttiginde PR'i onaylayacagim.

scenario: Reviewer: 'LGTM, approved.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler yeterince incelemeden onaylar.

definition_en: To ask the author to modify their code before it can be approved
definition_tr: Onaylanabilmesi icin yazardan kodunu degistirmesini istemek

example_sentences.en: I'm requesting changes — the error handling needs improvement.
example_sentences.tr: Degisiklik istiyorum — hata yonetimi iyilestirme gerektiriyor.

common_patterns: request changes on a PR — PR'da degisiklik istemek
scenario: Reviewer: 'Requesting changes: please add null checks.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler degisiklik istemekten cekinir, olumsuz karsilaniracagini dusunur.

definition_en: A minor suggestion or nitpick in a code review that is not critical
definition_tr: Kod incelemesinde kritik olmayan kucuk oneri veya elestiri

example_sentences.en: Nit: consider renaming this variable for clarity.
example_sentences.tr: Nit: netlik icin bu degiskeni yeniden adlandirmayi dusun.

common_patterns: just a nit — sadece ufak bir sey
scenario: Reviewer: 'Nit: add a space after the comma.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler nit-level geri bildirimleri kisisel alir.

definition_en: Looks Good To Me - an approval phrase used in code reviews
definition_tr: Bana iyi gorunuyor - kod incelemelerinde kullanilan onay ifadesi

example_sentences.en: LGTM! Feel free to merge.
example_sentences.tr: LGTM! Birlestirmekte ozgursun.

scenario: Reviewer: 'LGTM, ship it!'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler LGTM'nin acilimini bilmez.

definition_en: Don't Repeat Yourself - a principle to reduce code duplication
definition_tr: Kendini tekrarlama - kod tekrarini azaltma prensibi

example_sentences.en: This violates DRY — the same logic exists in three places.
example_sentences.tr: Bu DRY'i ihlal ediyor — ayni mantik uc yerde mevcut.

scenario: Reviewer: 'This isn't DRY, extract the common logic into a shared function.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler DRY'i abartir ve gereksiz soyutlama yapar (over-engineering).

definition_en: Five design principles for writing maintainable object-oriented code
definition_tr: Sudurulebilir nesne yonelimli kod yazmak icin bes tasarim prensibi

example_sentences.en: This class violates the Single Responsibility Principle from SOLID.
example_sentences.tr: Bu sinif SOLID'den Tek Sorumluluk Prensibini ihlal ediyor.

scenario: Senior: 'Review your design against SOLID principles.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler SOLID'i teorik bilir ama pratikte uygulamaz.

definition_en: A characteristic in code that indicates a potential deeper problem
definition_tr: Kodda daha derin bir potansiyel soruna isaret eden ozellik

example_sentences.en: Long methods are a common code smell.
example_sentences.tr: Uzun metodlar yaygin bir kod kokusudur.

common_patterns: identify a code smell — kod kokusu tespit etmek
scenario: Reviewer: 'This god class is a major code smell.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler code smell'leri gormezden gelir.

definition_en: The implied cost of rework caused by choosing an easy solution over a better approach
definition_tr: Daha iyi bir yaklasim yerine kolay bir cozum secmenin neden oldugu yeniden calisma maliyeti

example_sentences.en: We're accumulating technical debt with these workarounds.
example_sentences.tr: Bu gecici cozumlerle teknik borc biriktiriyoruz.

common_patterns: reduce technical debt — teknik borcu azaltmak
incur technical debt — teknik borc olusturmak
scenario: Lead: 'Let's track our technical debt and plan to address it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler technical debt kavramini yonetime aciklayamaz.

definition_en: A measure of how complicated code is to understand and maintain
definition_tr: Kodun anlasilmasi ve bakiminin ne kadar karmasik oldugunu olcen deger

example_sentences.en: The cyclomatic complexity of this function is too high.
example_sentences.tr: Bu fonksiyonun siklomatik karmasikligi cok yuksek.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Break this down, the complexity is too high.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler karmasik kodu akilli kod sanir.

definition_en: The degree to which one module depends on another
definition_tr: Bir modulun digerine ne kadar bagimli oldugu

example_sentences.en: Reduce coupling between the modules to improve testability.
example_sentences.tr: Test edilebilirliği artirmak icin moduller arasi baglasmimi azalt.

scenario: Architect: 'These modules are too tightly coupled.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tight coupling sorunlarini fark etmez.

definition_en: The degree to which elements within a module belong together
definition_tr: Bir modul icindeki elemanlarin birbirine ait olma derecesi

example_sentences.en: This class has low cohesion — it handles too many responsibilities.
example_sentences.tr: Bu sinifin uyumu dusuk — cok fazla sorumluluk ustleniyor.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Aim for high cohesion within each module.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler god class olusturur, cohesion'i dusunmez.

definition_en: A hardcoded number in code without explanation of its meaning
definition_tr: Anlaminin aciklanmasi olmadan kodda sabitlenmis sayi

example_sentences.en: Replace the magic number 86400 with a named constant SECONDS_PER_DAY.
example_sentences.tr: 86400 sihirli sayisini SECONDS_PER_DAY adli sabit ile degistir.

common_patterns: eliminate magic numbers — sihirli sayilari ortadan kaldirmak
scenario: Reviewer: 'What does 7 mean here? Extract it to a named constant.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler koda aciklama olmadan sayi goer.

definition_en: Code that is never executed or has no effect on the program
definition_tr: Asla calistirilmayan veya program uzerinde etkisi olmayan kod

example_sentences.en: Remove this dead code — it's never called anywhere.
example_sentences.tr: Bu olu kodu kaldir — hicbir yerden cagrilmiyor.

common_patterns: remove dead code — olu kodu kaldirmak
detect dead code — olu kodu tespit etmek
scenario: Reviewer: 'This function is dead code, no references to it anywhere.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler olu kodu 'belki lazim olur' diye birakir.

definition_en: A set of rules for choosing names for variables, functions, and other identifiers
definition_tr: Degiskenler, fonksiyonlar ve diger tanimlyicilar icin isim secme kuallari kumesi

example_sentences.en: Follow the camelCase naming convention for variables.
example_sentences.tr: Degiskenler icin camelCase adlandirma kuralini izle.

common_patterns: follow the naming convention — adlandirma kuralini izlemek
scenario: Reviewer: 'This doesn't follow our naming convention — use camelCase.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler degisken isimlerini Turkce yazar veya kisaltmalar kullanir (a, tmp, x).

definition_en: To analyze code for potential errors and style violations
definition_tr: Kodu potansiyel hatalar ve stil ihlalleri icin analiz etmek

example_sentences.en: Run the linter before submitting your PR.
example_sentences.tr: PR'inizi gondermeden once linter'i calistirin.

common_patterns: lint the code — kodu lint etmek
fix lint errors — lint hatalarini duzetmek
scenario: CI: 'Lint check failed — fix the formatting issues.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler lint kurallarini devre disi birakir.

definition_en: A tool that automatically formats code according to style rules
definition_tr: Kodu stil kurallarina gore otomatik bicimlendiren arac

example_sentences.en: Configure Prettier as the code formatter.
example_sentences.tr: Prettier'i kod bicimlendirici olarak yapilandir.

scenario: Lead: 'Use the formatter, don't manually fix whitespace.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler formatter ayarlarinda takim icinde anlasamaz.

definition_en: A method or technique that has consistently shown superior results
definition_tr: Surekli olarak ustun sonuclar gosteren yontem veya teknik

example_sentences.en: Following best practices for error handling prevents many bugs.
example_sentences.tr: Hata yonetimi icin en iyi uygulamalari izlemek bircok hatayi onler.

common_patterns: follow best practices — en iyi uygulamalari izlemek
scenario: Reviewer: 'This goes against best practices for state management.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler best practice'leri ezberler ama neden oldugunu sorgumaz.

definition_en: A common but ineffective or counterproductive coding practice
definition_tr: Yaygin ama etkisiz veya ters etki yapan kodlama pratigi

example_sentences.en: Using global variables is considered an anti-pattern.
example_sentences.tr: Global degisken kullanmak anti-pattern olarak kabul edilir.

common_patterns: identify an anti-pattern — anti-pattern tespit etmek
scenario: Reviewer: 'This is a known anti-pattern. Let me show you a better approach.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler anti-pattern'leri aliskanlik olarak sudrur.

definition_en: A reusable solution to a commonly occurring problem in software design
definition_tr: Yazilim tasariminda sik karsilasilan bir soruna yeniden kullanilabilir cozum

example_sentences.en: The Observer pattern is useful for event-driven systems.
example_sentences.tr: Observer kalbi olay odakli sistemler icin yararlidir.

common_patterns: apply a design pattern — tasarim kalbi uygulamak
scenario: Senior: 'This is a textbook case for the Strategy pattern.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler design pattern'leri gereksiz yere kullanir (over-engineering).

definition_en: How easily code can be read and understood by other developers
definition_tr: Kodun diger gelistiriciler tarafindan ne kadar kolay okunup anlasilabilecegi

example_sentences.en: Prioritize readability over cleverness.
example_sentences.tr: Akillilk yerine okunurlugu onceliklendir.

scenario: Reviewer: 'This is clever but not readable. Simplify it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kisa ve karmasik kodu iyi kod sanir.

definition_en: How easily code can be modified, extended, or fixed in the future
definition_tr: Kodun gelecekte ne kadar kolay degistirilebilecegi, genisletilebilecegi veya duzltilebilecegi

example_sentences.en: Write code with maintainability in mind.
example_sentences.tr: Bakım yapilabilirlik dusunulerek kod yazin.

scenario: Lead: 'Think about maintainability — we'll be working on this code for years.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kisa vadeli cozumler uretir, bakım yapılabilirliği dusunmez.

definition_en: The percentage of code that is tested by automated tests
definition_tr: Otomatik testler tarafindan test edilen kodun yuzdesi

example_sentences.en: Our code coverage dropped below 80% with the last PR.
example_sentences.tr: Son PR ile kod kapsam yuzdemiz 80%'in altina dustu.

common_patterns: increase code coverage — kod kapsamini artirmak
code coverage report — kod kapsam raporu
scenario: Lead: 'We need at least 80% code coverage for critical paths.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler %100 coverage hedefler ama anlamli test yazmaz.

definition_en: The degree to which a programming language prevents type errors
definition_tr: Bir programlama dilinin tip hatalarini ne olcude onledigi

example_sentences.en: TypeScript provides better type safety than plain JavaScript.
example_sentences.tr: TypeScript, duz JavaScript'ten daha iyi tip guvenligi saglar.

common_patterns: enforce type safety — tip guvenligini zorunlu kilmak
scenario: Lead: 'Migrate to TypeScript for better type safety.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler TypeScript'te 'any' tipini kullanarak tip guvenligini bypass eder.

definition_en: The process of improving the speed and efficiency of code
definition_tr: Kodun hiz ve verimlligini iyilestirme sureci

example_sentences.en: We need performance optimization on the search query.
example_sentences.tr: Arama sorgusu uzerinde performans optimizasyonu yapmamiz gerekiyor.

common_patterns: optimize for performance — performans icin optimize etmek
scenario: Senior: 'Don't do premature optimization. Measure first, then optimize.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler olcum yapmadan optimize etmeye calisir.

definition_en: Written material that explains how software works or how to use it
definition_tr: Yazilimin nasil calistigini veya nasil kullanilacagini aciklayan yazili materyal

example_sentences.en: Keep the documentation up to date with code changes.
example_sentences.tr: Dokumantasyonu kod degisiklikleriyle guncel tutun.

scenario: Lead: 'No feature is complete without documentation.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler dokumantasyon yazmaktan kacinir.

definition_en: A file that introduces and explains a project
definition_tr: Projeyi tanitan ve aciklayan dosya

example_sentences.en: Update the README with the new setup instructions.
example_sentences.tr: README'yi yeni kurulum talimatlariyla guncelle.

scenario: Lead: 'New contributors will read the README first, keep it clear.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler README'yi bos birakir veya guncellemez.

definition_en: A file that lists all notable changes made to a project in each version
definition_tr: Her surumde projeye yapilan tum onemli degisiklikleri listeleyen dosya

example_sentences.en: Add this feature to the changelog.
example_sentences.tr: Bu ozelligi changelog'a ekle.

scenario: Lead: 'Every PR should include a changelog entry.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler changelog tutmaz, neyin ne zaman degistigini bilmez.

definition_en: Comprehensive documentation of all available API endpoints and their usage
definition_tr: Mevcut tum API endpointlerinin ve kullanimlarinin kapsamli belgeleri

example_sentences.en: Check the API reference for the list of available parameters.
example_sentences.tr: Mevcut parametrelerin listesi icin API referansina bakin.

common_patterns: API reference docs — API referans belgeleri
scenario: Dev: 'Is there an API reference I can look at?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler API'lerini belgelemez, sifahi aciklama yapar.

definition_en: A markup language used to annotate JavaScript source code with documentation
definition_tr: JavaScript kaynak koduna dokumantasyon eklemek icin kullanilan isaret dili

example_sentences.en: Add JSDoc comments to all public functions.
example_sentences.tr: Tum public fonksiyonlara JSDoc yorumlari ekle.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Please add JSDoc to these exported functions.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler JSDoc yazmaz, fonksiyon parametrelerinin ne oldugu belirsiz kalir.

definition_en: A string literal used to document a module, function, class, or method
definition_tr: Bir modul, fonksiyon, sinif veya metodu belgelemek icin kullanilan dize sabiti

example_sentences.en: Write a docstring explaining what this function does.
example_sentences.tr: Bu fonksiyonun ne yaptigini aciklayan bir docstring yaz.

scenario: Reviewer: 'This function needs a docstring.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler docstring yazmaz veya yazsa bile guncellmez.

definition_en: Marked as outdated and scheduled for removal in a future version
definition_tr: Eskimis olarak isaretlenmis ve gelecek surumde kaldirilmak uzere planlanmis

example_sentences.en: This method is deprecated, use the new one instead.
example_sentences.tr: Bu metod kullanim disi birakildi, bunun yerine yenisini kullanin.

scenario: Warning: 'Method X is deprecated and will be removed in v3.0.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler deprecated uyarilarini gormezden gelir.

definition_en: The high-level structure and design decisions of a software system
definition_tr: Bir yazilim sisteminin ust duzey yapisi ve tasarim kararlari

example_sentences.en: Document the system architecture before starting development.
example_sentences.tr: Gelistirmeye baslamadan once sistem mimarisini belgeleyin.

scenario: Architect: 'Let's review the architecture before adding new services.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler mimari belgesi olusturmadan kodlamaya baslar.

definition_en: A visual representation of a system's structure or workflow
definition_tr: Bir sistemin yapisi veya is akisinin gorsel temsili

example_sentences.en: Create a sequence diagram for the payment flow.
example_sentences.tr: Odeme akisi icin bir sira diyagrami olustur.

scenario: Lead: 'Draw a diagram so the team can visualize the flow.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler diyagram cizip guncellemez, eski diyagramlar yanlilstir.

definition_en: A detailed description of the requirements and design of a system or feature
definition_tr: Bir sistem veya ozelliğin gereksinimlerinin ve tasarımının ayrıntılı aciklamasi

example_sentences.en: Write a technical specification before implementing the feature.
example_sentences.tr: Ozelliği uygulamadan once teknik sartname yazin.

scenario: Lead: 'I need a spec before you start coding.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler spec yazmadan kodlamaya baslar.

definition_en: Request for Comments - a document proposing a technical change for team discussion
definition_tr: Yorum Istegi - takim tartismasi icin teknik bir degisiklik oneren belge

example_sentences.en: I wrote an RFC for the new authentication system.
example_sentences.tr: Yeni kimlik dogrulama sistemi icin bir RFC yazdim.

scenario: Lead: 'This is a big change, let's write an RFC first.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler RFC sureci bilmez, buyuk degisiklikleri tartismadan yapar.

definition_en: Architecture Decision Record - a document that captures an important architectural decision
definition_tr: Onemli bir mimari karari kaydeden belge

example_sentences.en: Create an ADR for the decision to use PostgreSQL.
example_sentences.tr: PostgreSQL kullanma karari icin bir ADR olustur.

scenario: Architect: 'Let's document this decision as an ADR.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler mimari kararlari belgelemez, neden secildigini unutur.

definition_en: Documentation that helps users upgrade from one version to another
definition_tr: Kullaniciların bir surumden digerine yukseltmelerine yardimci olan dokumantasyon

example_sentences.en: Write a migration guide for the v2 to v3 upgrade.
example_sentences.tr: v2'den v3'e yukseltme icin bir goc rehberi yazin.

common_patterns: follow the migration guide — goc rehberini izlemek
scenario: Lead: 'We need a migration guide, the API changed significantly.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler breaking change yapar ama migration guide yazmaz.

definition_en: A summary of changes, fixes, and features included in a software release
definition_tr: Yazilim surumune dahil edilen degisikliklerin, duzeltmelerin ve ozelliklerin ozeti

example_sentences.en: Draft the release notes for v2.5.
example_sentences.tr: v2.5 icin surum notlarini hazirla.

common_patterns: write release notes — surum notlari yazmak
publish release notes — surum notlarini yayinlamak
scenario: PO: 'Make sure the release notes are user-friendly.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler teknik release notes yazar, kullanicinin anlayacagi sekilde yazmaz.

definition_en: The process of assigning version numbers to different releases of software
definition_tr: Yazilimin farkli surumlerine surum numaralari atama sureci

example_sentences.en: Follow semantic versioning for consistent release numbering.
example_sentences.tr: Tutarli surum numaralandirmasi icin anlamsal surumleme izle.

scenario: Lead: 'We need a proper versioning strategy.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler surum numaralarini rastgele arttirir.

definition_en: Text in code that is ignored by the compiler/interpreter, used for explanation
definition_tr: Derleyici/yorumlayici tarafindan goz ardi edilen, aciklama icin kullanilan metin

example_sentences.en: Add a comment explaining why this workaround is needed.
example_sentences.tr: Bu gecici cozumun neden gerekli oldugunu aciklayan bir yorum ekle.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Add a comment explaining the business logic here.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ya hic yorum yazmaz ya da gereksiz yorum yazar (// increment i by 1).

definition_en: A declaration that specifies the shape and type of data
definition_tr: Verinin seklini ve tipini belirten bildirim

example_sentences.en: Create type definitions for the API response.
example_sentences.tr: API yaniti icin tip tanimlari olustur.

common_patterns: type definition file — tip tanim dosyasi (.d.ts)
scenario: Reviewer: 'Add type definitions for these interfaces.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tip tanimlamadan any kullanir.

definition_en: A set of tools for designing, building, and documenting RESTful APIs
definition_tr: RESTful API'leri tasarlamak, olusturmak ve belgelemek icin araclar kumesi

example_sentences.en: Generate the API documentation using Swagger.
example_sentences.tr: Swagger kullanarak API dokumantasyonunu olusturun.

scenario: Lead: 'Set up Swagger so the frontend team can see our API docs.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler Swagger'i ayarlayip sonra guncellemez.

definition_en: A specification for describing RESTful APIs in a machine-readable format
definition_tr: RESTful API'leri makine tarafindan okunabilir formatta tanimlayan sartname

example_sentences.en: Define the API contract using the OpenAPI specification.
example_sentences.tr: OpenAPI sartnamesi kullanarak API sozlesmesini tanimla.

scenario: Lead: 'Start with the OpenAPI spec before implementing the endpoints.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler API-first yaklasim yerine code-first yapar.

definition_en: A common interview opener asking the candidate to introduce themselves
definition_tr: Adayin kendini tanitmasi istenen yaygin mulakat acilisi

example_sentences.en: Tell me about yourself and your experience with React.
example_sentences.tr: Kendinizden ve React deneyiminizden bahsedin.

common_patterns: tell me about yourself — kendinizden bahsedin
scenario: Interviewer: 'Let's start — tell me about yourself.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler bu soruya cok uzun ve dagnik cevap verir, 2 dakikada ozetlemeli.

definition_en: An interview prompt asking the candidate to explain a process step by step
definition_tr: Adayin bir sureci adim adim aciklamasini isteyen mulakat yonlendirmesi

example_sentences.en: Walk me through how you would design a URL shortener.
example_sentences.tr: Bir URL kisaltici nasil tasarlarsiniz, adim adim anlatin.

common_patterns: walk me through your approach — yaklasiminizi anlatm
walk me through the code — kodu aciklayin
scenario: Interviewer: 'Walk me through your solution.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler adim adim aciklamak yerine sonuca atlar.

definition_en: A compromise between two desirable but conflicting qualities
definition_tr: Iki arzu edilen ama catisan kalite arasindaki uzlasma

example_sentences.en: What are the trade-offs between SQL and NoSQL databases?
example_sentences.tr: SQL ve NoSQL veritabanlari arasindaki odunlesimler nelerdir?

common_patterns: there's a trade-off between — ...arasinda odunlesim var
scenario: Interviewer: 'What trade-offs did you consider?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler trade-off'lari dile getirmez, tek cozumu savunur.

definition_en: A measure of how the runtime of an algorithm increases with input size
definition_tr: Bir algoritmanin calisma suresinin girdi boyutuyla nasil arttigini olcen deger

example_sentences.en: The time complexity of this algorithm is O(n log n).
example_sentences.tr: Bu algoritmanin zaman karmasikligi O(n log n).

common_patterns: analyze time complexity — zaman karmasikligini analiz etmek
scenario: Interviewer: 'What's the time complexity of your solution?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler Big O analizini mulakat icin ezberler ama gunluk isle iliskilendiremez.

definition_en: A measure of how the memory usage of an algorithm increases with input size
definition_tr: Bir algoritmanin bellek kullaniminin girdi boyutuyla nasil arttigini olcen deger

example_sentences.en: The space complexity is O(n) because we store all elements.
example_sentences.tr: Tum elemanlari sakladigimiz icin alan karmasikligi O(n).

common_patterns: analyze space complexity — alan karmasikligini analiz etmek
scenario: Interviewer: 'Can you reduce the space complexity?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler space complexity'yi goz ardi eder, sadece time complexity'ye odaklanir.

definition_en: A notation that describes the upper bound of an algorithm's time or space complexity
definition_tr: Bir algoritmanin zaman veya alan karmasikliginin ust sinirini tanimlayan gosterim

example_sentences.en: The Big O of binary search is O(log n).
example_sentences.tr: Binary search'un Big O'su O(log n).

common_patterns: Big O notation — Big O gosterimi
scenario: Interviewer: 'What's the Big O of your solution?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler Big O'yu sadece mulakatlarda dusunur, gunluk kodlamada analiz yapmaz.

definition_en: The ability of a system to handle growth in users, data, or traffic
definition_tr: Bir sistemin kullanici, veri veya trafik artisini kaldirma yetenegi

example_sentences.en: Design the system with scalability in mind.
example_sentences.tr: Sistemi olceklenebilirlik dusunulerek tasarla.

scenario: Interviewer: 'How would you scale this system to handle 10x more traffic?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler olceklenebilirlik planlamasi yapmaz.

definition_en: The process of designing the architecture of a large-scale system
definition_tr: Buyuk olcekli bir sistemin mimarisini tasarlama sureci

example_sentences.en: In the system design interview, I was asked to design a chat application.
example_sentences.tr: Sistem tasarimi mulkatinda benden bir sohbet uygulamasi tasarlamamam istendi.

common_patterns: system design interview — sistem tasarimi mulakati
scenario: Interviewer: 'Design a system like Twitter that handles millions of tweets per day.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler sistem tasarimi sorularinda buyuk resmi goremez, detaylara takilir.

definition_en: An interview question about past experiences and how you handled situations
definition_tr: Gecmis deneyimler ve durumlari nasil ele aldiginiz hakkinda mulakat sorusu

example_sentences.en: Prepare for behavioral questions using the STAR method.
example_sentences.tr: STAR metodunu kullanarak davranissal sorulara hazirlanin.

common_patterns: tell me about a time when — bana ...bir zamani anlatin
scenario: Interviewer: 'Tell me about a time when you disagreed with a colleague.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler davranissal sorulara hazirlanmaz, teknik sorulara odaklanir.

definition_en: A structured way to answer behavioral questions: Situation, Task, Action, Result
definition_tr: Davranissal sorulari yapisal sekilde yanitlama yontemi: Durum, Gorev, Eylem, Sonuc

example_sentences.en: Use the STAR method to structure your answer.
example_sentences.tr: Cevabinizi yapilandirmak icin STAR yontemini kullanin.

scenario: Coach: 'Always use STAR when answering behavioral questions.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler yapilandirilmis cevap vermez, daginik anlatir.

definition_en: An area where you have room for improvement
definition_tr: Gelistirilmeye acik oldugunuz alan

example_sentences.en: When asked about your weakness, be honest but show how you're improving.
example_sentences.tr: Zayif yonunuz soruldugunda durust olun ama nasil gelistighnizi gosterin.

common_patterns: what is your weakness — zayif yonunuz nedir
scenario: Interviewer: 'What would you say is your biggest weakness?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler 'zayif yonum yok' der veya gercek bir zayiflik soylemeye korkar.

definition_en: A skill or quality that you excel at
definition_tr: Ustun oldugunuz beceri veya nitelik

example_sentences.en: Highlight your strengths with specific examples.
example_sentences.tr: Guclu yonlerinizi belirli orneklerle vurgulayin.

common_patterns: what are your strengths — guclu yonleriniz nelerdir
scenario: Interviewer: 'What are your greatest strengths as a developer?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler guclu yonlerini somut orneklerle desteklemez.

definition_en: How well a candidate's values and working style align with the company's culture
definition_tr: Adayin degerleri ve calisma tarzinin sirket kulturuyle ne kadar uyumlu oldugu

example_sentences.en: They assess culture fit through behavioral questions.
example_sentences.tr: Kultur uyumunu davranissal sorularla degerlendirirler.

common_patterns: culture fit interview — kultur uyumu mulakati
scenario: HR: 'We're looking for someone who's a good culture fit.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler culture fit'in ne oldugunu bilmez, sadece teknik beceriye odaklanir.

definition_en: The total payment and benefits offered for a job
definition_tr: Bir is icin sunulan toplam odeme ve yan haklar

example_sentences.en: What are your compensation expectations?
example_sentences.tr: Ucret beklentileriniz nedir?

scenario: HR: 'Let's discuss the compensation package.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ucret musakeresinde dusuk talepte bulunur.

definition_en: Working from a location other than the company office
definition_tr: Sirket ofisi disindaki bir konumdan calisma

example_sentences.en: Is this position fully remote or hybrid?
example_sentences.tr: Bu pozisyon tamamen uzaktan mi yoksa hibrit mi?

scenario: Candidate: 'I'm looking for a fully remote position.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler remote is icin gerekli iletisim becerilerini kucumser.

definition_en: The time between resigning and the last working day
definition_tr: Istifa ile son calisma gunu arasindaki sure

example_sentences.en: My notice period is two weeks.
example_sentences.tr: Ihbar srem iki haftadir.

common_patterns: serve the notice period — ihbar suresini doldurmak
negotiate notice period — ihbar suresini muzakere etmek
scenario: HR: 'What is your current notice period?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ihbar suresini bilmez veya yanlis bildirir.

definition_en: A formal document that extends a job offer to a candidate
definition_tr: Adaya is teklifi sunan resmi belge

example_sentences.en: I received an offer letter from the company.
example_sentences.tr: Sirketten bir teklif mektubu aldim.

common_patterns: accept the offer — teklifi kabul etmek
scenario: HR: 'We'd like to extend you an offer letter.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler offer letter'daki detaylari (equity, benefits) incelemeden kabul eder.

definition_en: The process of discussing terms to reach an agreement, especially regarding salary
definition_tr: Ozellikle maas konusunda bir anlasmaya varmak icin kosulari tartisma sureci

example_sentences.en: Don't be afraid to negotiate your salary offer.
example_sentences.tr: Maas teklifini muzakere etmekten korkmayin.

scenario: Mentor: 'Always negotiate — the first offer is rarely the best they can do.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler muzakere yapmaz, ilk teklifi kabul eder.

definition_en: An interview format where candidates solve problems on a whiteboard
definition_tr: Adaylarin problemleri beyaz tahtada cozdugu mulakat formati

example_sentences.en: Practice whiteboard coding before the onsite interview.
example_sentences.tr: Ofis ici mulakatten once beyaz tahtada kodlama pratigi yapin.

scenario: Interviewer: 'Let's use the whiteboard to work through this problem.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler whiteboard'da kod yazarken editor'deki gibi dusmamekte zorlanir.

definition_en: A programming task given to assess a candidate's technical skills
definition_tr: Adayin teknik becerilerini degerlendirmek icin verilen programlama gorevi

example_sentences.en: Complete the coding challenge within 60 minutes.
example_sentences.tr: Kodlama sinavini 60 dakika icinde tamamlayin.

common_patterns: take-home coding challenge — eve verilen kodlama sinavi
scenario: Recruiter: 'The next step is a coding challenge on HackerRank.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler coding challenge'larda zaman yonetimini yapamaz.

definition_en: An interview format where the candidate codes alongside an interviewer
definition_tr: Adayin mulakatci ile birlikte kodladigi mulakat formati

example_sentences.en: In the pair programming interview, communicate your thought process.
example_sentences.tr: Esli programlama mulakatinda dusunce sureccnizi paylasin.

common_patterns: pair programming round — esli programlama turu
scenario: Interviewer: 'Let's pair on this problem together.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler esli mulakatta sessiz kalir, dusuncelerini paylassmalidir.

definition_en: Non-technical interpersonal skills like communication, teamwork, and leadership
definition_tr: Iletisim, takim calismasi ve liderlik gibi teknik olmayan kisilerarasi beceriler

example_sentences.en: Soft skills are just as important as technical skills.
example_sentences.tr: Yumusak beceriler teknik beceriler kadar onemlidir.

common_patterns: develop soft skills — yumusak beceriler gelistirmek
scenario: Manager: 'We value soft skills highly in our team.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler yumusak becerileri onemsmez, sadece teknik bilgiye odaklanir.

definition_en: A brief, persuasive summary of who you are and what you do
definition_tr: Kim oldugunuzun ve ne yaptiginizin kisa, ikna edici ozeti

example_sentences.en: Prepare a 30-second elevator pitch about your experience.
example_sentences.tr: Deneyiminiz hakkinda 30 saniyelik bir asansor konusmasi hazirlayin.

common_patterns: give an elevator pitch — asansor konusmasi yapmak
scenario: Coach: 'Have your elevator pitch ready for networking events.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kendilerini kisa ve etkili tanitamaz.

definition_en: An interview that assesses a candidate's technical knowledge and problem-solving skills
definition_tr: Adayin teknik bilgisini ve problem cozme becerilerini degerlendiren mulakat

example_sentences.en: I have a technical interview with the engineering team next week.
example_sentences.tr: Gelecek hafta muhendislik takimiyla teknik mulakatim var.

common_patterns: pass the technical interview — teknik mulakati gecmek
technical interview prep — teknik mulakat hazirligi
scenario: Recruiter: 'The second round will be a technical interview.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler teknik mulakatlara algoritmik hazirlik yapar ama sistem tasarimi ihmal eder.

definition_en: A document summarizing your professional experience, education, and skills
definition_tr: Profesyonel deneyiminizi, egitiminizi ve becerilerinizi ozetleyen belge

example_sentences.en: Tailor your resume for each job application.
example_sentences.tr: Her is basvurusu icin ozgecmisinizi uyarlayin.

scenario: Mentor: 'Highlight your impact with numbers on your resume.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ozgecmislerinde sorumluluklari yazar, etki ve sonuclari yazmaz.

definition_en: A collection of projects and work samples that demonstrate your skills
definition_tr: Becerilerinizi gosteren proje ve is ornekleri koleksiyonu

example_sentences.en: Include your open source contributions in your portfolio.
example_sentences.tr: Acik kaynak katkilarinizi portfolyonuza ekleyin.

scenario: Mentor: 'A strong portfolio is better than a certificate.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler portfolyo olusturmaz, sadece CV gonderir.

definition_en: To contact someone after an initial interaction to continue the conversation
definition_tr: Ilk etkilesimden sonra konusmaya devam etmek icin biriyle iletisime gecmek

example_sentences.en: Send a follow-up email after the interview.
example_sentences.tr: Mulakatten sonra bir takip e-postasi gonderin.

common_patterns: follow up with — ile takip etmek
scenario: Coach: 'Always send a thank-you follow-up within 24 hours.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler mulakat sonrasi takip yapmaz.

definition_en: A recommendation from someone inside a company to help a candidate get hired
definition_tr: Bir adayin ise alinmasina yardimci olmak icin sirket icinden birinin tavsiyesi

example_sentences.en: I got a referral from a friend who works there.
example_sentences.tr: Orada calisan bir arkadasimdan tavsiye aldim.

scenario: Mentor: 'Referrals have a much higher success rate than cold applications.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler referral istemeye cekinir.

definition_en: An interview conducted at the company's physical location
definition_tr: Sirketin fiziksel konumunda yapilan mulakat

example_sentences.en: The onsite interview consists of four technical rounds.
example_sentences.tr: Yerinde mulakat dort teknik turdan olusuyor.

scenario: Recruiter: 'We'd like to invite you for an onsite interview.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler onsite mulakatta stres yonetiminde zorlanir.

definition_en: Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment - automating build, test, and deployment
definition_tr: Surekli Entegrasyon ve Surekli Dagitim - build, test ve dagitimi otomatiklestirme

example_sentences.en: Set up a CI/CD pipeline to automate deployments.
example_sentences.tr: Dagitimi otomatiklestirmek icin CI/CD hatti kurun.

scenario: Interviewer: 'Describe your experience with CI/CD.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler CI/CD pipeline kurmamistir, sadece kullanmistir.

definition_en: An architectural style where an application is composed of small, independent services
definition_tr: Uygulamanin kucuk, bagimsiz servislerden olustugu mimari tarz

example_sentences.en: We migrated from a monolith to microservices.
example_sentences.tr: Monolitten mikro servislere gecis yaptik.

common_patterns: break into microservices — mikro servislere bolmek
scenario: Interviewer: 'When would you choose microservices over a monolith?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler micro services'i her projede kullanmaya calisir, monolith yeterli olsa bile.

definition_en: A device or software that distributes network traffic across multiple servers
definition_tr: Ag trafigini birden fazla sunucu arasinda dagitan cihaz veya yazilim

example_sentences.en: Put a load balancer in front of the API servers.
example_sentences.tr: API sunucularinin onune bir yuk dengeleyici koyun.

common_patterns: configure a load balancer — yuk dengeleyici yapilandirmak
round-robin load balancing — siralı yuk dengeleme
scenario: Interviewer: 'How would you handle traffic distribution?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler load balancer yapilandirma deneyimi yetersizdir.

definition_en: Packaging an application with its dependencies into a container for consistent deployment
definition_tr: Uygulamayi bagimliliklariyla birlikte tutarli dagitim icin bir kapsayiciya paketleme

example_sentences.en: We use Docker for containerization.
example_sentences.tr: Kapsayicilastirma icin Docker kullaniyoruz.

scenario: Interviewer: 'Tell me about your experience with containerization.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler Docker kullanir ama container orkestrasyon (Kubernetes) bilmez.

definition_en: A plan for how and when to store data in cache for optimal performance
definition_tr: Optimal performans icin verilerin nasil ve ne zaman onbellege saklanacaginin plani

example_sentences.en: What caching strategy would you use for this high-traffic API?
example_sentences.tr: Bu yuksek trafikli API icin hangi onbellek stratejisini kullanirdiniz?

common_patterns: implement a caching strategy — onbellek stratejisi uygulamak
scenario: Interviewer: 'What caching strategy would you use here?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler cache stratejisi dusunmez, her seyi cache'e atar.

definition_en: Creating indexes on database columns to speed up query performance
definition_tr: Sorgu performansini hizlandirmak icin veritabani sutunlarinda indeks olusturma

example_sentences.en: Add an index on the email column to speed up lookups.
example_sentences.tr: Aramalari hizlandirmak icin e-posta sutununa indeks ekle.

scenario: Interviewer: 'When would you add a database index?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler gereksiz indeks ekler veya hic indeks eklemez.

definition_en: A system that enables asynchronous communication between services
definition_tr: Servisler arasi asenkron iletisimi saglayan sistem

example_sentences.en: Use a message queue for processing orders asynchronously.
example_sentences.tr: Siparisleri asenkron islemek icin mesaj kuyrugu kullanin.

common_patterns: message queue system — mesaj kuyrugu sistemi
publish to a queue — kuyruga yayinlamak
scenario: Interviewer: 'Where would you use a message queue in this design?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler mesaj kuyrugu ne zaman kullanilacagini bilmez.

definition_en: A comparison between two API design approaches
definition_tr: Iki API tasarim yaklasimi arasindaki karsilastirma

example_sentences.en: In the interview, I explained the trade-offs between REST and GraphQL.
example_sentences.tr: Mulakatta REST ve GraphQL arasindaki odunlesimleri ackladim.

common_patterns: REST vs GraphQL — REST ve GraphQL karsilastirmasi
scenario: Interviewer: 'When would you choose GraphQL over REST?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler birini her zaman diger uzerinde tercih eder, duruma gore secim yapmaz.

definition_en: A test that verifies the behavior of a small, isolated piece of code
definition_tr: Kucuk, izole bir kod parcasinin davranisini dogrulayan test

example_sentences.en: Write unit tests for all business logic functions.
example_sentences.tr: Tum is mantigi fonksiyonlari icin birim testleri yazin.

common_patterns: write a unit test — birim testi yazmak
run unit tests — birim testlerini calistirmak
scenario: Interviewer: 'How do you approach unit testing?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler test yazmayı zaman kaybi olarak gorur.

definition_en: A test that verifies the interaction between multiple components or services
definition_tr: Birden fazla bilesen veya servis arasindaki etkilesimi dogrulayan test

example_sentences.en: Write integration tests for the API endpoints.
example_sentences.tr: API endpointleri icin entegrasyon testleri yaz.

scenario: Lead: 'We need more integration tests for the critical paths.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler unit test ve integration test arasindaki farki karistirir.

definition_en: Test-Driven Development - writing tests before writing the code
definition_tr: Test Odakli Gelistirme - kodu yazmadan once testleri yazmak

example_sentences.en: With TDD, you write the failing test first.
example_sentences.tr: TDD ile once basarisiz testi yazarsiniz.

scenario: Interviewer: 'Do you practice TDD? Tell me about your experience.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler TDD'yi teorik bilir ama pratikte uygulamaz.

definition_en: A simulated object that mimics the behavior of a real object in tests
definition_tr: Testlerde gercek bir nesnenin davranisini taklit eden simulasyon nesnesi

example_sentences.en: Mock the API response in the unit test.
example_sentences.tr: Birim testinde API yanitini mock'la.

scenario: Dev: 'Mock the database call so the test runs faster.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler mock kullanmaz, testlerin gercek servislere bagimli olmasina neden olur.

definition_en: A platform for building, shipping, and running applications in containers
definition_tr: Uygulamalari kapsayicilarda olusturmak, gondermek ve calistirmak icin platform

example_sentences.en: Create a Dockerfile for the Node.js application.
example_sentences.tr: Node.js uygulamasi icin bir Dockerfile olusturun.

scenario: Interviewer: 'How do you use Docker in your development workflow?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler Docker image boyutunu optimize etmez.

definition_en: An orchestration platform for managing containerized applications at scale
definition_tr: Kapsayicilandirilmis uygulamalari olcekte yonetmek icin orkestrasyon platformu

example_sentences.en: We use Kubernetes to manage our microservices.
example_sentences.tr: Mikro servislerimizi yonetmek icin Kubernetes kullaniyoruz.

scenario: Interviewer: 'Tell me about your experience with Kubernetes.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler Kubernetes kavramlarini (pod, service, ingress) karistirir.

definition_en: Data that represents the current condition of an application or component
definition_tr: Uygulamanin veya bilesenin mevcut durumunu temsil eden veri

example_sentences.en: Manage the component state with useState.
example_sentences.tr: Bilesen durumunu useState ile yonetin.

scenario: Senior: 'Lift the state up to the parent component.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler state'i gereksiz yere global yapar.

definition_en: Properties passed from a parent component to a child component
definition_tr: Ust bilesenden alt bilesene gecirilen ozellikler

example_sentences.en: Pass the user data as props to the child component.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici verisini alt bilesene props olarak gecir.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Avoid prop drilling, use context instead.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler prop drilling yapar, context veya state management kullanmaz.

definition_en: A reusable, self-contained piece of UI
definition_tr: Yeniden kullanilabilir, bagimsiz UI parcasi

example_sentences.en: Create a reusable Button component.
example_sentences.tr: Yeniden kullanilabilir bir Button bileseni olustur.

scenario: Reviewer: 'This component does too much, split it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler dev bilesenler olusturur, kucuk ve odakli olmali.

definition_en: To generate and display the visual output of a component
definition_tr: Bir bilesenin gorsel ciktisini olusturmak ve goruntulemek

example_sentences.en: The component re-renders when the state changes.
example_sentences.tr: Durum degistiginde bilesen yeniden render edilir.

scenario: Senior: 'This component renders too many times, add memoization.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler gereksiz re-render'lari fark etmez.

definition_en: A function that responds to user interactions like clicks or key presses
definition_tr: Tiklamalar veya tus basmalari gibi kullanici etkilesimlerine yanit veren fonksiyon

example_sentences.en: Attach an event handler to the button click.
example_sentences.tr: Dugme tiklamasina bir olay isleyici bagla.

scenario: Dev: 'The event handler isn't firing, check the binding.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler event handler'lari temizlemeyi unutur (memory leak).

definition_en: A pre-built structure that provides a foundation for building applications
definition_tr: Uygulama olusturmak icin temel saglayan onceden insa edilmis yapi

example_sentences.en: React is a popular frontend framework.
example_sentences.tr: React populer bir frontend cercevesidir.

common_patterns: framework vs library — cerceve vs kutuphane
scenario: Lead: 'Which framework should we use for this project?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler framework ve library farkini bilmez.

definition_en: A collection of pre-written code that can be used in your projects
definition_tr: Projelerinizde kullanilabilecek onceden yazilmis kod koleksiyonu

example_sentences.en: Import the date-fns library for date formatting.
example_sentences.tr: Tarih formatlama icin date-fns kutuphanesini iceri aktar.

scenario: Dev: 'Do we have a library for CSV parsing?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her is icin yeni kutuphane ekler, bundle size sisar.

definition_en: Software Development Kit - tools and libraries for building applications for a specific platform
definition_tr: Belirli bir platform icin uygulama gelistirme arac ve kutuphaneleri

example_sentences.en: Install the AWS SDK to interact with S3.
example_sentences.tr: S3 ile etkilesim icin AWS SDK'sini yukleyin.

scenario: Dev: 'Check the SDK docs for the authentication method.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler SDK versiyonlarini guncel tutmaz.

definition_en: Command Line Interface - a text-based interface for interacting with software
definition_tr: Yazilimla etkilesim icin metin tabanli arayuz

example_sentences.en: Use the CLI to generate a new project.
example_sentences.tr: Yeni bir proje olusturmak icin CLI'yi kullanin.

scenario: Dev: 'Run the CLI command to scaffold the project.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler GUI tercih eder, CLI'yi ogrenmeye direnir.

definition_en: Regular Expression - a pattern used to match character combinations in strings
definition_tr: Dizgelerdeki karakter kombinasyonlarini esltirmek icin kullanilan kalip

example_sentences.en: Use a regex to validate email addresses.
example_sentences.tr: E-posta adreslerini dogrulamak icin regex kullanin.

scenario: Dev: 'Write a regex for phone number validation.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler regex yazarken cok karisik ifadeler olusturur, okunmaz hale gelir.

definition_en: A data structure that follows First-In-First-Out (FIFO) ordering
definition_tr: Ilk Giren Ilk Cikar (FIFO) sirasini izleyen veri yapisi

example_sentences.en: Use a queue to process tasks in order.
example_sentences.tr: Gorevleri sirayla islemek icin kuyruk kullanin.

scenario: Interviewer: 'When would you use a queue vs a stack?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler queue ve stack kullanim alanlarini karistirir.

definition_en: A data structure that follows Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) ordering
definition_tr: Son Giren Ilk Cikar (LIFO) sirasini izleyen veri yapisi

example_sentences.en: The call stack tracks function execution order.
example_sentences.tr: Cagri yigini fonksiyon calistirma sirasini izler.

common_patterns: push onto the stack — yigina itmek
pop from the stack — yigindan cikarmak
scenario: Interviewer: 'Implement a stack using two queues.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler call stack'in nasil calistigini anlamaz.

definition_en: A data structure consisting of nodes connected by edges
definition_tr: Kenarlarla birbirine bagli dugumlerden olusan veri yapisi

example_sentences.en: Model the social network as a graph.
example_sentences.tr: Sosyal agi bir graf olarak modelleyin.

scenario: Interviewer: 'How would you traverse this graph?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler graf algoritmalarini (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra) pratikte uygulamakta zorlanir.

definition_en: An efficient algorithm that finds an item in a sorted list by repeatedly dividing the search space
definition_tr: Arama alanini tekrar tekrar bolerek siralj listede ogeyi bulan verimli algoritma

example_sentences.en: Use binary search for O(log n) lookup in a sorted array.
example_sentences.tr: Siralanmis dizide O(log n) arama icin ikili arama kullanin.

common_patterns: binary search algorithm — ikili arama algoritmasi
scenario: Interviewer: 'Implement binary search recursively.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler binary search icin dizinin siralanmis olmasi gerektigini unutur.

definition_en: Arranging elements in a specific order
definition_tr: Elemanlari belirli bir sirada duzenleme

example_sentences.en: Use a sorting algorithm to order the results by date.
example_sentences.tr: Sonuclari tarihe gore siralamak icin siralama algoritmasi kullanin.

common_patterns: sort in ascending order — artan sirada siralamak
scenario: Interviewer: 'What sorting algorithm would you choose and why?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her zaman Array.sort() kullanir, karsilastirici fonksiyon eklemeyi unutur.

definition_en: The process of removing or updating stale data in the cache
definition_tr: Onbellekteki eski verileri kaldirma veya guncelleme sureci

example_sentences.en: Cache invalidation is one of the two hardest problems in computer science.
example_sentences.tr: Onbellek gecersiz kilma bilgisayar biliminin en zor iki probleminden biridir.

common_patterns: invalidate the cache — onbellegi gecersiz kilmak
TTL-based invalidation — TTL tabanli gecersiz kilma
scenario: Architect: 'How will we handle cache invalidation when data changes?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler cache invalidation stratejisi dusunmez.

definition_en: An architecture where the flow is determined by events
definition_tr: Akisin olaylar tarafindan belirlendigi mimari

example_sentences.en: We use an event-driven architecture for real-time updates.
example_sentences.tr: Gercek zamanli guncellemeler icin olay odakli mimari kullaniyoruz.

scenario: Architect: 'An event-driven approach would decouple these services.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler event-driven mimarinin karmasikligini kucumser.

definition_en: The ability to handle multiple tasks at the same time
definition_tr: Ayni anda birden fazla gorevi ele alma yetenegi

example_sentences.en: Go handles concurrency with goroutines.
example_sentences.tr: Go, esanlilik icin goroutine kullanir.

scenario: Senior: 'We need to think about concurrency here.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler concurrency ve parallelism farkini bilmez.

definition_en: The property of an operation that produces the same result regardless of how many times it is performed
definition_tr: Kac kez yapilirsa yapilsin ayni sonucu ureten islem ozelligi

example_sentences.en: Ensure idempotency for retry-safe API endpoints.
example_sentences.tr: Yeniden denemeye guvenli API endpointleri icin idempotency saglayin.

scenario: Lead: 'Add an idempotency key to prevent duplicate charges.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler idempotency saglamadan payment endpoint'leri olusturur.

definition_en: A branching model that defines a strict branching structure for releases
definition_tr: Surumler icin katı dal yapisi tanimlayan dallanma modeli

example_sentences.en: We follow Git Flow with develop and release branches.
example_sentences.tr: Develop ve release dallariyla Git Flow izliyoruz.

common_patterns: Git Flow branching — Git Flow dallanmasi
scenario: Lead: 'We're adopting Git Flow for better release management.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler Git Flow'u gereksiz karmasik bulup atlar.

definition_en: A branch created specifically for developing a new feature
definition_tr: Yeni bir ozellik gelistirmek icin ozel olarak olusturulan dal

example_sentences.en: Create a feature branch for the shopping cart implementation.
example_sentences.tr: Alisveris sepeti uygulamasi icin bir ozellik dali olustur.

common_patterns: feature branch workflow — ozellik dali is akisi
scenario: Lead: 'Always create a feature branch from main.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler feature branch acmadan main'e direkt commit yapar.

definition_en: A branch used to prepare for a production release
definition_tr: Uretim surumu hazirlamak icin kullanilan dal

example_sentences.en: Cut a release branch when the feature freeze begins.
example_sentences.tr: Ozellik dondurmasi basladiginda bir surum dali olustur.

common_patterns: create a release branch — surum dali olusturmak
scenario: Lead: 'Create a release branch and only allow bugfixes.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler release branch kullanmaz.

definition_en: To fetch and merge changes from a remote repository
definition_tr: Uzak depodan degisiklikleri indirmek ve birlestirmek

example_sentences.en: Pull the latest changes before pushing.
example_sentences.tr: Push yapmadan once son degisiklikleri cekin.

common_patterns: pull from remote — uzak depodan cekmek
scenario: Dev: 'Pull the latest from main before starting.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler pull yapmadan calisir, conflict'e neden olur.

definition_en: A command to initialize a new Git repository
definition_tr: Yeni bir Git deposu baslatmak icin komut

example_sentences.en: Run git init to create a new repository.
example_sentences.tr: Yeni bir depo olusturmak icin git init calistir.

scenario: Dev: 'Start by running git init in the project folder.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler .git klasorunu yanilskla siler.

definition_en: A command that shows the current state of the working directory and staging area
definition_tr: Calisma dizini ve hazirlama alaninin mevcut durumunu gosteren komut

example_sentences.en: Run git status to see which files have changed.
example_sentences.tr: Hangi dosyalarin degistigini gormek icin git status calistir.

common_patterns: check the status — durumu kontrol etmek
scenario: Dev: 'Always check git status before committing.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler git status kontrol etmeden add ve commit yapar.

definition_en: A command that adds file changes to the staging area
definition_tr: Dosya degisikliklerini hazirlama alanina ekleyen komut

example_sentences.en: Use git add to stage specific files.
example_sentences.tr: Belirli dosyalari stage etmek icin git add kullan.

scenario: Senior: 'Use git add -p to stage only relevant changes.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler git add . yaparak istenmeyen dosyalari ekler.

definition_en: A state where HEAD points to a specific commit instead of a branch
definition_tr: HEAD'in bir dal yerine belirli bir commiti isaretledigi durum

example_sentences.en: You're in detached HEAD state, create a branch to save your work.
example_sentences.tr: Ayrilmis HEAD durumundasiniz, calismanizi kaydetmek icin bir dal olusturun.

common_patterns: detached HEAD state — ayrilmis HEAD durumu
scenario: Senior: 'You checked out a commit directly, that's why you're in detached HEAD.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler detached HEAD'de commit yapar ve sonra kaybeder.

definition_en: A Git hook that runs before a commit is created
definition_tr: Commit olusturulmadan once calisan Git kancasi

example_sentences.en: Set up pre-commit hooks to run linting and tests.
example_sentences.tr: Lint ve testleri calistirmak icin pre-commit hook'lari ayarla.
