scenario: Lead: 'Pre-commit hooks will catch formatting issues before they reach the PR.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler pre-commit hook'lari skip eder (--no-verify).

definition_en: A rebase mode that lets you edit, reorder, squash, or drop commits
definition_tr: Commitleri duzenleme, yeniden siralama, sikistrima veya atmaniza izin veren rebase modu

example_sentences.en: Use interactive rebase to clean up your commit history.
example_sentences.tr: Commit gecmisinizi temizlemek icin interactive rebase kullanin.

scenario: Senior: 'Do an interactive rebase to squash those WIP commits.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler interactive rebase'den korkar, aslinda guclu bir aractir.

definition_en: To modify the most recent commit
definition_tr: En son commiti degistirmek

example_sentences.en: Amend the commit to include the forgotten file.
example_sentences.tr: Unutulan dosyayi dahil etmek icin commiti duzelt.

scenario: Dev: 'I forgot to add that file, let me amend the commit.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler amend'i push edilmis commit'lerde kullanir, sorun yaratir.

definition_en: An intermediary server that forwards requests between clients and servers
definition_tr: Istemciler ve sunucular arasinda istekleri ileten aracı sunucu

example_sentences.en: Set up a reverse proxy in front of the API server.
example_sentences.tr: API sunucusunun onune bir ters vekil sunucu kur.

scenario: DevOps: 'Use nginx as a reverse proxy.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler proxy yapilandirmasinda zorlanir.

definition_en: Secure Sockets Layer - a deprecated protocol for encrypting communications
definition_tr: Iletisimleri sifreleme icin kullanilan eski protokol (TLS ile degistirildi)

example_sentences.en: Renew the SSL certificate before it expires.
example_sentences.tr: SSL sertifikasini suresi dolmadan once yenileyin.

scenario: DevOps: 'The SSL cert is expiring next week, renew it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler SSL ve TLS'i ayni sey sanir, SSL artik eskimistir.

definition_en: A piece of data that represents identity or authorization
definition_tr: Kimlik veya yetkilendirmeyi temsil eden veri parcasi

example_sentences.en: Include the access token in the Authorization header.
example_sentences.tr: Erisim token'ini Authorization basligina ekleyin.

scenario: Dev: 'The token has expired, we need to refresh it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler token'i guvenli saklamaz (localStorage vs httpOnly cookie).

definition_en: A label indicating the format of a file transmitted over the internet
definition_tr: Internet uzerinden iletilen dosyanin formatini gosteren etiket

example_sentences.en: Set the correct MIME type for JSON responses.
example_sentences.tr: JSON yanitlari icin dogru MIME tipini ayarla.

common_patterns: MIME type header — MIME tipi basligi
scenario: Dev: 'The browser is not parsing the JSON because the MIME type is wrong.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler Content-Type header'ini ayarlamayi unutur.

definition_en: An OPTIONS request sent by browsers before certain cross-origin requests
definition_tr: Tarayicilarin belirli cross-origin isteklerden once gonderdigi OPTIONS istegi

example_sentences.en: The preflight request is failing because of missing CORS headers.
example_sentences.tr: CORS basliklari eksik oldugu icin preflight istegi basarisiz oluyor.

scenario: Dev: 'The preflight OPTIONS request is getting a 403.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler preflight isteginin ne oldugunu bilmez.

definition_en: The process of attaching JavaScript behavior to server-rendered HTML
definition_tr: Sunucuda render edilmis HTML'ye JavaScript davranisi ekleme sureci

example_sentences.en: Hydration errors occur when server and client HTML don't match.
example_sentences.tr: Sunucu ve istemci HTML'si uyusmadiginda hydration hatalari olusur.

scenario: Dev: 'We have a hydration mismatch, the server and client output differ.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler hydration hatalarinin nedenini anlayamaz.

definition_en: Files like images, CSS, and JavaScript that don't change dynamically
definition_tr: Dinamik olarak degismeyen resim, CSS ve JavaScript gibi dosyalar

example_sentences.en: Serve static assets from a CDN for better performance.
example_sentences.tr: Daha iyi performans icin statik dosyalari CDN'den sunun.

common_patterns: serve static assets — statik dosyalari sunmak
scenario: DevOps: 'Move all static assets to the CDN.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler statik dosyalari optimize etmez (compression, minification).

definition_en: Removing unnecessary characters from code to reduce file size
definition_tr: Dosya boyutunu azaltmak icin koddan gereksiz karakterleri kaldirma

example_sentences.en: Enable minification for production builds.
example_sentences.tr: Production build'leri icin kucultmeyi etkinlestir.

scenario: Lead: 'Make sure the production build has minification enabled.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler development build'i production'a deploy eder.

definition_en: A single file containing combined JavaScript or CSS modules
definition_tr: Birlestirilmis JavaScript veya CSS modullerini iceren tek dosya

example_sentences.en: The bundle size is too large, we need code splitting.
example_sentences.tr: Bundle boyutu cok buyuk, kod bolmeleme yapmamiz gerekiyor.

scenario: Lead: 'Analyze the bundle to find what's making it so large.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler bundle boyutunu izlemez.

definition_en: A configured setup where software runs, such as development, staging, or production
definition_tr: Yazilimin calistigi yapilandirilmis kurulum: gelistirme, staging veya production gibi

example_sentences.en: Test in the staging environment before deploying to production.
example_sentences.tr: Production'a deploy etmeden once staging ortaminda test edin.

scenario: Lead: 'Never test directly in production.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler production'da test yapar.

definition_en: An environment that mirrors production for testing before release
definition_tr: Surum oncesi test icin production'i yansitan ortam

example_sentences.en: Deploy to staging first and run smoke tests.
example_sentences.tr: Once staging'e deploy et ve smoke testleri calistir.

common_patterns: deploy to staging — staging'e deploy etmek
scenario: QA: 'The fix is on staging, please verify.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler staging ortami kurmaz, development'tan production'a atlar.

definition_en: The live environment where the application is available to end users
definition_tr: Uygulamanin son kullanicilara acik oldugu canli ortam

example_sentences.en: Be very careful with changes in production.
example_sentences.tr: Production'daki degisikliklerle cok dikkatli olun.

common_patterns: deploy to production — production'a deploy etmek
scenario: Lead: 'This is a production issue, handle it ASAP.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler production debugging yapar, test ortaminda yeniden uretmez.

definition_en: When a program stops working unexpectedly
definition_tr: Programin beklenmedik sekilde calismayı durdurmas

example_sentences.en: The app crashed due to an unhandled exception.
example_sentences.tr: Uygulama islenmeyen istisna nedeniyle coktu.

scenario: User: 'The app keeps crashing when I click submit.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler crash loglarini analiz etmez.

definition_en: When a program becomes unresponsive
definition_tr: Programin yanit vermez hale gelmesi

example_sentences.en: The UI freezes when processing large datasets.
example_sentences.tr: Buyuk veri setlerini islerken arayuz donuyor.

scenario: User: 'The page freezes for 5 seconds after clicking search.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler agir islemleri main thread'de calistirir.

definition_en: A point in a system that limits overall performance
definition_tr: Sistemin genel performansini sinrlayan nokta

example_sentences.en: The database query is the bottleneck in our API response time.
example_sentences.tr: Veritabani sorgusu API yanit suremizdeki darbodazdir.

common_patterns: identify the bottleneck — darboazi tespit etmek
scenario: Senior: 'Profile the code to find the bottleneck.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler darboazi bulmadan rastgele optimizasyon yapar.

definition_en: Analyzing a program to identify performance bottlenecks
definition_tr: Performans darbozlarini belirlemek icin programi analiz etme

example_sentences.en: Run a profiler to find which functions are slowest.
example_sentences.tr: Hangi fonksiyonlarin en yavas oldugunu bulmak icin profiler calistir.

common_patterns: profile the code — kodun profilini cikarmak
scenario: Senior: 'Don't guess, profile the code first.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler profiler kullanmaz, tahminle optimize eder.

definition_en: A test that sometimes passes and sometimes fails without code changes
definition_tr: Kod degisikligi olmadan bazen gecen bazen basarisiz olan test

example_sentences.en: This flaky test is blocking the CI pipeline.
example_sentences.tr: Bu dengesiz test CI hattini engelliyor.

common_patterns: fix flaky tests — dengesiz testleri duzeltmek
scenario: Dev: 'Just re-run CI, it's a flaky test.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler flaky testleri duzeltmek yerine tekrar tekrar CI calistirir.

definition_en: When code fails without any visible error message or notification
definition_tr: Kodun herhangi bir gorunur hata mesaji veya bildirim olmadan basarisiz olmasi

example_sentences.en: The function has a silent failure — it returns null instead of throwing an error.
example_sentences.tr: Fonksiyonda sessiz basarisizlik var — hata firlatmak yerine null donduruyor.

scenario: Senior: 'Never let errors fail silently, always log them.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler catch blogunuda sessizce hata yutar.

definition_en: Cross-Site Scripting - a security vulnerability where malicious scripts are injected into web pages
definition_tr: Zarali betiklerin web sayfalarina enjekte edildigi guvenlik acigi

example_sentences.en: Sanitize user input to prevent XSS attacks.
example_sentences.tr: XSS saldirilarin onlemek icin kullanici girdisini temizleyin.

scenario: Security: 'This input field is vulnerable to XSS.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kullanici girdisini escape etmez.

definition_en: A security vulnerability where malicious SQL is injected through user input
definition_tr: Kullanici girdisi yoluyla zararli SQL enjekte edilen guvenlik acigi

example_sentences.en: Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection.
example_sentences.tr: SQL enjeksiyonunu onlemek icin parametreli sorgular kullanin.

common_patterns: SQL injection attack — SQL enjeksiyon saldirisi
prevent SQL injection — SQL enjeksiyonunu onlemek
scenario: Security: 'This query is vulnerable to SQL injection.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler string interpolation ile SQL sorgusu olusturur.

definition_en: Uncontrolled growth of project scope beyond original boundaries
definition_tr: Proje kapsaminin orijinal sinirlarin otesinde kontrolsuz buyumesi

example_sentences.en: We need to push back on scope creep to meet the deadline.
example_sentences.tr: Son tarihi karsilamak icin kapsam kaymasina karsi koymamiz gerekiyor.

common_patterns: prevent scope creep — kapsam kaymasini onlemek
scenario: PO: 'This is scope creep, let's add it to the backlog for next sprint.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ek isteklere hayir diyemez, scope creep olusur.

definition_en: A presentation showing the functionality of completed work
definition_tr: Tamamlanan isin islevselligini gosteren sunum

example_sentences.en: Prepare a demo for the stakeholders.
example_sentences.tr: Paydaslar icin bir demo hazirla.

scenario: PO: 'Let's demo the new feature to the client.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler demo hazirligini son dakikaya birakir.

definition_en: A meeting at the end of a sprint where the team shows completed work
definition_tr: Sprint sonunda takimin tamamlanan isi gosterdigi toplanti

example_sentences.en: Present the completed features in the sprint review.
example_sentences.tr: Sprint incelemesinde tamamlanan ozellikleri sunun.

common_patterns: sprint review meeting — sprint inceleme toplantisi
scenario: Scrum master: 'Who's presenting at the sprint review?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler sprint review'da sadece teknik detay anlatir, is degerini aciklamaz.

definition_en: A significant point or achievement in a project timeline
definition_tr: Proje zaman cizelgesindeki onemli nokta veya basari

example_sentences.en: Reaching MVP is our first milestone.
example_sentences.tr: MVP'ye ulasmak ilk kilometre tasimiz.

common_patterns: reach a milestone — kilometre tasina ulasmak
scenario: Manager: 'The next milestone is the beta release.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler milestone'lari tanımlamaz, proje ilerlemesini olcemez.

definition_en: Minimum Viable Product - the simplest version of a product that delivers value
definition_tr: Deger sunan bir urunun en basit surumu

example_sentences.en: Let's focus on the MVP features first.
example_sentences.tr: Once MVP ozelliklerine odaklanalim.

scenario: PO: 'What's the MVP for this feature?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler MVP'yi mükemmel yapmaya calisir, amac hizli geri bildirim almak.

definition_en: The brief status report given during a daily standup meeting
definition_tr: Gunluk standup toplantisinda verilen kisa durum raporu

example_sentences.en: Share your standup update: what you did, what you'll do, any blockers.
example_sentences.tr: Standup guncellemenizi paylasin: ne yaptiniz, ne yapacaksiniz, engelleyiciler.

common_patterns: give a standup update — standup guncellemesi vermek
scenario: Scrum master: 'Keep your update short — 30 seconds max.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler standup'ta 5 dakika konusur, 30 saniye olmali.

definition_en: A specific task identified during a retrospective to improve the team's process
definition_tr: Takimin surecini iyilestirmek icin retrospektif sirasinda belirlenen belirli gorev

example_sentences.en: Follow up on the retrospective action items from last sprint.
example_sentences.tr: Gecen sprint'in retrospektif eylem maddelerini takip edin.

common_patterns: assign action items — eylem maddeleri atamak
scenario: Scrum master: 'Let's review if we completed last retro's action items.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler retro action item'larini takip etmez.

definition_en: The practice of sharing expertise and insights within a team
definition_tr: Uzmanlik ve içgoruleri takim icinde paylasma pratiğ

example_sentences.en: Schedule a knowledge sharing session about the new architecture.
example_sentences.tr: Yeni mimari hakkinda bir bilgi paylasim oturumu planla.

common_patterns: knowledge sharing session — bilgi paylasim oturumu
scenario: Lead: 'Let's do a knowledge sharing session on Kubernetes.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler bilgiyi kendine saklar, paylasmaz.

definition_en: Information about performance or suggestions for improvement
definition_tr: Performans hakkinda bilgi veya iyilestirme onerileri

example_sentences.en: Give constructive feedback during code reviews.
example_sentences.tr: Kod incelemelerinde yapici geri bildirim verin.

scenario: Manager: 'I'd like to give you some feedback from the sprint.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler geri bildirimi kisisel alginlar, yapici geri bildirim almak onemlidir.

definition_en: A chart showing the remaining work in a sprint over time
definition_tr: Sprint'te zaman icerisinde kalan isi gosteren grafik

example_sentences.en: The burndown chart shows we're behind schedule.
example_sentences.tr: Burndown chart programin gerisinde olduggumuzu gosteriyor.

scenario: Scrum master: 'Check the burndown chart, we might not finish everything.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler burndown chart'i takip etmez.

definition_en: The degree to which code meets standards for readability, reliability, and maintainability
definition_tr: Kodun okunurluk, guvenilirlik ve bakım yapılabilirlik standartlarini karsilama derecesi

example_sentences.en: Invest in code quality now to save time later.
example_sentences.tr: Daha sonra zaman kazanmak icin simdi kod kalitesine yatirim yapin.

common_patterns: improve code quality — kod kalitesini iyilestirmek
code quality metrics — kod kalitesi metrikleri
scenario: Lead: 'Code quality is everyone's responsibility.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kod kalitesini lüks olarak gorur.

definition_en: Code that is easy to read, understand, and maintain
definition_tr: Okunmasi, anlasilmasi ve bakimi kolay kod

example_sentences.en: Writing clean code is more important than writing clever code.
example_sentences.tr: Temiz kod yazmak akilli kod yazmaktan daha onemlidir.

common_patterns: write clean code — temiz kod yazmak
scenario: Reviewer: 'This code is not clean, there are too many responsibilities in one function.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler Clean Code kitabini okumamistir.

definition_en: A principle stating that a class or function should have only one reason to change
definition_tr: Bir sinif veya fonksiyonun sadece bir degisiklik nedeni olmasi gerektigini belirten prensip

example_sentences.en: This function violates single responsibility — split it.
example_sentences.tr: Bu fonksiyon tek sorumluluk prensibini ihlal ediyor — bol.

common_patterns: single responsibility principle — tek sorumluluk prensibi
scenario: Reviewer: 'This class has too many responsibilities.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler god class ve god function olusturur.

definition_en: A principle stating that software entities should be open for extension but closed for modification
definition_tr: Yazilim varliklarinin genislemeye acik ama degisiklige kapali olmasi gerektigini belirten prensip

example_sentences.en: Follow the open-closed principle to avoid modifying existing code.
example_sentences.tr: Mevcut kodu degistirmekten kacinmak icin acik-kapali prensibini izleyin.

scenario: Senior: 'This design violates OCP, we have to modify the base class for every new type.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler yeni ozellikler icin surekli mevcut kodu degistirir.

definition_en: A technique where dependencies are provided to an object rather than created by it
definition_tr: Bagimliliklarin nesne tarafindan olusturulmak yerine disaridan saglandigi teknik

example_sentences.en: Use dependency injection for better testability.
example_sentences.tr: Daha iyi test edilebilirlik icin bagimlilik enjeksiyonu kullanin.

scenario: Senior: 'Use DI so we can mock the database in tests.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler DI kullanmaz, hard-coded bagimlilklar olusturur.

definition_en: A design principle favoring object composition over class inheritance
definition_tr: Sinif kalitimi yerine nesne bilesimini tercih eden tasarim prensibi

example_sentences.en: Use composition over inheritance to avoid tight coupling.
example_sentences.tr: Siki baglasimdan kacinmak icin kalitim yerine bilesim kullanin.

scenario: Senior: 'Use composition here, inheritance creates too much coupling.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her iliski icin inheritance kullanir.

definition_en: A design principle where each module handles a distinct functionality
definition_tr: Her modulun ayri bir islevsellik ele aldigi tasarim prensibi

example_sentences.en: Separate business logic from UI code.
example_sentences.tr: Is mantgini UI kodundan ayirin.

common_patterns: maintain separation of concerns — kaygıların ayrımını korumak
scenario: Reviewer: 'Mix of business logic and UI code violates separation of concerns.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler is mantıgını UI katmanina goer.

definition_en: A testing strategy with many unit tests, fewer integration tests, and few end-to-end tests
definition_tr: Cok birim testi, daha az entegrasyon testi ve az uctan uca testten olusan test stratejisi

example_sentences.en: Follow the test pyramid — most tests should be unit tests.
example_sentences.tr: Test piramidini izleyin — testlerin cogu birim testi olmali.

scenario: Lead: 'Our test pyramid is inverted — too many E2E tests, not enough unit tests.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ters piramit yapar, sadece E2E test yazar.

definition_en: A comment written on the same line as code or just above it
definition_tr: Kodla ayni satirda veya hemen ustunde yazilan yorum

example_sentences.en: Add an inline comment explaining this regex.
example_sentences.tr: Bu regex'i aciklayan satir ici yorum ekleyin.

common_patterns: add an inline comment — satir ici yorum eklemek
scenario: Reviewer: 'Add a comment explaining why, not what.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ne yapildgini yazar (// i'yi artir), neden yapildigini yazmaz.

definition_en: A comment marking code that needs to be revisited or completed later
definition_tr: Daha sonra tekrar ziyaret edilmesi veya tamamlanmasi gereken kodu isaretleyen yorum

example_sentences.en: Don't leave TODO comments in production code.
example_sentences.tr: Production kodunda TODO yorumları birakmayin.

scenario: Reviewer: 'This TODO has been here for 6 months, fix it or remove it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler TODO yorumlarini birakir ve bir daha bakmaz.

definition_en: A set of documented procedures for handling operational tasks or incidents
definition_tr: Operasyonel gorevleri veya olaylari ele almak icin belgelenms prosedurler kumesi

example_sentences.en: Follow the runbook for database failover.
example_sentences.tr: Veritabani failover icin islem rehberini izleyin.

common_patterns: create a runbook — islem rehberi olusturmak
follow the runbook — islem rehberini izlemek
scenario: On-call: 'Check the runbook for the steps to restart the service.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler runbook yazmaz, her olayda sifirdan ne yapilacagini dusunur.

definition_en: A collaborative documentation platform for sharing team knowledge
definition_tr: Takim bilgisini paylassmak icin isbirlikci dokumantasyon platformu

example_sentences.en: Document the onboarding process in the team wiki.
example_sentences.tr: Ise alistirma surecini takim wikisinde belgeleyin.

scenario: Lead: 'Check the wiki before asking questions.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler wikiyi guncel tutmaz.

definition_en: A document defining coding standards and conventions for a team or project
definition_tr: Takim veya proje icin kodlama standartlari ve kurallarini tanimlayan belge

example_sentences.en: Follow the style guide for consistent code formatting.
example_sentences.tr: Tutarli kod formatlama icin stil rehberini izleyin.

common_patterns: coding style guide — kodlama stil rehberi
scenario: Lead: 'Review the style guide before submitting your first PR.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler stil rehberini okumaz.

definition_en: A formal description of the structure of data
definition_tr: Veri yapisinin resmi tanimi

example_sentences.en: Define the database schema before writing queries.
example_sentences.tr: Sorgulari yazmadan once veritabani semasini tanimlayin.

scenario: Lead: 'Review the schema changes before running the migration.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler sema degisikliklerini belgelemez.

definition_en: Entity-Relationship Diagram - a visual representation of database entities and their relationships
definition_tr: Veritabani varliklarinin ve iliskilerinin gorsel temsili

example_sentences.en: Create an ERD before designing the database.
example_sentences.tr: Veritabanini tasarlamadan once bir ERD olusturun.

scenario: Lead: 'Start with an ERD so we can review the data model.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ERD cizmeden veritabani olusturur.

definition_en: Unified Modeling Language - a standard for visualizing software system designs
definition_tr: Yazilim sistem tasarimlarini gorselestirmek icin standart

example_sentences.en: Draw a UML class diagram for the payment module.
example_sentences.tr: Odeme modulu icin bir UML sinif diyagrami cizin.

common_patterns: UML class diagram — UML sinif diyagrami
scenario: Architect: 'Let me draw a UML sequence diagram for the flow.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler UML'i gereksiz bulur ama buyuk projelerde iletisimi kolaylastirir.

definition_en: An abstract representation of how data is organized and related
definition_tr: Verilerin nasil organize edildiginin ve ilisklendirildiginin soyut temsili

example_sentences.en: Review the data model before implementing the database.
example_sentences.tr: Veritabanini uygulamadan once veri modelini inceleyin.

common_patterns: define the data model — veri modelini tanimlamak
scenario: Lead: 'Let's agree on the data model first.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler veri modelini dusunmeden kodlamaya baslar.

definition_en: An interview round focused on solving algorithmic problems
definition_tr: Algoritma problemleri cozmeye odaklanan mulakat turu

example_sentences.en: Practice LeetCode problems for the algorithm interview.
example_sentences.tr: Algoritma mulakati icin LeetCode problemleri calis.

scenario: Recruiter: 'The second round is an algorithm interview.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler LeetCode'a son hafta baslar, en az 3 ay onceden hazirlanmali.

definition_en: A coding task given to candidates to complete at home within a deadline
definition_tr: Adaylara bir son tarih icinde evde tamamlamalari icin verilen kodlama gorevi

example_sentences.en: Submit your take-home assignment by Friday.
example_sentences.tr: Eve verilen odevinizi cumaya kadar gonderin.

common_patterns: complete the take-home — eve verilen odevi tamamlamak
scenario: Recruiter: 'We'll send you a take-home assignment, you have 5 days.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler take-home'u son gun yapar, erken teslim etmek etki birakir.

definition_en: Writing code in real-time during an interview while being observed
definition_tr: Mulakatci tarafindan izlenirken gercek zamanli kod yazma

example_sentences.en: During the live coding session, explain your thought process.
example_sentences.tr: Canli kodlama oturumunda dusunce surcinizi aciklayin.

common_patterns: live coding interview — canli kodlama mulakati
scenario: Interviewer: 'Let's do a live coding exercise — share your screen.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler canli kodlamada sessiz kalir, sesli dusunmek (think aloud) onemli.

definition_en: The person responsible for making the final hiring decision
definition_tr: Nihai ise alim kararini vermekten sorumlu kisi

example_sentences.en: The hiring manager wants to meet you for the final round.
example_sentences.tr: Ise alim yoneticisi son tur icin sizinle gorusmek istiyor.

common_patterns: hiring manager round — ise alim yoneticisi turu
scenario: Recruiter: 'The next step is a meeting with the hiring manager.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler hiring manager turuna hazirlanmaz, sadece teknik hazirlik yapar.

definition_en: A person responsible for finding and screening candidates for job positions
definition_tr: Is pozisyonlari icin aday bulmak ve elemekten sorumlu kisi

example_sentences.en: The recruiter reached out to me on LinkedIn.
example_sentences.tr: Ise alim uzmani bana LinkedIn'den ulasti.

common_patterns: talk to the recruiter — ise alim uzmaniyla konusmak
scenario: Recruiter: 'I'd like to discuss a frontend developer position with you.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler recruiter mesajlarina profesyonelce yanit vermez.

definition_en: A response to a job offer proposing different terms
definition_tr: Farkli kosullar oneren is teklifine yanit

example_sentences.en: I made a counteroffer asking for a higher salary.
example_sentences.tr: Daha yuksek maas isteyen bir karsi teklif yaptim.

common_patterns: make a counteroffer — karsi teklif yapmak
scenario: Mentor: 'It's okay to make a counteroffer, companies expect it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler karsi teklif yapmaya cesaret edemez.

definition_en: A trial period at the start of employment to evaluate the new hire
definition_tr: Yeni ise alimyi degerlendirmek icin istihdamin basindaki deneme sureci

example_sentences.en: The probation period is 3 months.
example_sentences.tr: Deneme suresi 3 aydir.

scenario: HR: 'Your probation period will be 90 days.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler deneme suresi haklarini bilmez.

definition_en: Ownership shares in a company, often offered as part of compensation
definition_tr: Genellikle ucret paketinin parcasi olarak sunulan sirket hisseleri

example_sentences.en: The offer includes equity in the form of stock options.
example_sentences.tr: Teklif, hisse senedi opsiyonlari seklinde hisse iceriyor.

scenario: HR: 'The equity vests over 4 years with a 1-year cliff.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler equity degerini hesaplamakta zorlanir.

definition_en: Non-salary perks provided by an employer, such as health insurance and PTO
definition_tr: Saglik sigortasi ve izin gibi isveren tarafindan saglanan maas disi avantajlar

example_sentences.en: The benefits package includes health insurance and gym membership.
example_sentences.tr: Yan haklar paketi saglik sigortasi ve spor salonu uyeligini kapsiyor.

scenario: HR: 'Let me walk you through our benefits package.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler sadece maasa odaklanir, yan haklari degerlendirmez.

definition_en: Paid Time Off - vacation and sick days provided by employer
definition_tr: Isveren tarafindan saglanan ucretli tatil ve hastalik izinleri

example_sentences.en: The company offers 20 days of PTO per year.
example_sentences.tr: Sirket yilda 20 gun ucretli izin sunuyor.

scenario: HR: 'We have a flexible PTO policy.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler PTO hakklarini kullanmaz.

definition_en: The progression and development of one's professional career
definition_tr: Kisinin profesyonel kariyerinin ilerlemesi ve gelisimi

example_sentences.en: What career growth opportunities does the company offer?
example_sentences.tr: Sirket hangi kariyer gelisim firsatlari sunuyor?

common_patterns: career growth path — kariyer gelisim yolu
scenario: Candidate: 'I'm looking for opportunities for career growth.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kariyer planlama yapmaz, gelen is teklifine gore hareket eder.

definition_en: To convert source code from one language to another at a similar level of abstraction
definition_tr: Kaynak kodu benzer soyutlama seviyesinde bir dilden digerine donusturmek

example_sentences.en: TypeScript transpiles to JavaScript.
example_sentences.tr: TypeScript, JavaScript'e transpile edilir.

scenario: Dev: 'The transpiler converts our ES6 code to ES5.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler transpile ve compile farkini bilmez.

definition_en: Code that provides modern functionality on older browsers that lack native support
definition_tr: Yerel destegi olmayan eski tarayicilarda modern islevsellik saglayan kod

example_sentences.en: Add a polyfill for Promise in older browsers.
example_sentences.tr: Eski tarayicilarda Promise icin polyfill ekle.

scenario: Dev: 'We need a polyfill for Array.includes in IE11.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler polyfill ihtiyacini analiz etmez.

definition_en: Caching the results of expensive function calls to avoid redundant computation
definition_tr: Gereksiz hesaplamayi onlemek icin pahali fonksiyon cagrilarinin sonuclarini onbellege alma

example_sentences.en: Use memoization to optimize the recursive Fibonacci function.
example_sentences.tr: Ozyinelemeli Fibonacci fonksiyonunu optimize etmek icin memoization kullan.

scenario: Senior: 'Memoize this component to prevent unnecessary re-renders.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler React.memo ve useMemo'yu gereksiz yere kullanir veya hic kullanmaz.

definition_en: A function that takes another function as an argument or returns a function
definition_tr: Baska bir fonksiyonu arguman olarak alan veya fonksiyon donduren fonksiyon

example_sentences.en: Map is a higher-order function that transforms each element.
example_sentences.tr: Map, her elemani donusturen ust duzey bir fonksiyondur.

scenario: Senior: 'Use higher-order functions like map, filter, and reduce.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler for dongusu yerine HOF kullanmayi dusunmez.

definition_en: A design pattern where objects subscribe to and receive notifications from a subject
definition_tr: Nesnelerin bir konuya abone olup ondan bildirim aldigi tasarim kalbi

example_sentences.en: Use the observer pattern for the event notification system.
example_sentences.tr: Olay bildirim sistemi icin gozlemci kalbini kullanin.

common_patterns: subscribe to events — olaylara abone olmak
scenario: Senior: 'The observer pattern is ideal for this pub/sub scenario.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler observer pattern'i kendileri yazmaz, sadece framework icinde kullanir.

definition_en: A design pattern that creates objects without specifying their exact class
definition_tr: Nesneleri tam siniflarini belirtmeden olusturan tasarim kalbi

example_sentences.en: Use the factory pattern to create different payment processors.
example_sentences.tr: Farkli odeme islemcileri olusturmak icin fabrika kalbini kullan.

scenario: Senior: 'A factory would be cleaner here than multiple if-else blocks.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler factory yerine if-else zincirleri kullanir.

definition_en: A design pattern that enables selecting an algorithm at runtime
definition_tr: Calisma zamaninda algoritma secmeyi saglayan tasarim kalbi

example_sentences.en: Use the strategy pattern for different sorting algorithms.
example_sentences.tr: Farkli siralama algoritmalari icin strateji kalbini kullanin.

scenario: Senior: 'Replace the switch statement with a strategy pattern.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler buyuk switch/if-else bloklari yazar, strategy pattern dusunmez.

definition_en: A pattern that abstracts data access behind a collection-like interface
definition_tr: Veri erisimini koleksiyon benzeri bir arayuzun arkasinda soyutlayan kalip

example_sentences.en: Use the repository pattern to decouple business logic from data access.
example_sentences.tr: Is mantikini veri erisiminden ayirmak icin depo kalbini kullanin.

scenario: Senior: 'The repository pattern makes switching databases easier.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler veri erisim kodunu dogrudan is mantigi icine yazar.

definition_en: A mechanism that continuously checks for and processes events in the event queue
definition_tr: Olay kuyragundaki olaylari surekli kontrol eden ve isleyen mekanizma

example_sentences.en: Understanding the event loop is crucial for Node.js development.
example_sentences.tr: Olay dongusunu anlamak Node.js gelistirmesi icin cok onemlidir.

common_patterns: event loop cycle — olay dongusu donusu
scenario: Interviewer: 'Can you explain how the JavaScript event loop works?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler event loop'un nasil calistigini anlamaz, async hatalara neden olur.

definition_en: Metadata added to code to provide additional information to tools or frameworks
definition_tr: Araclara veya framework'lere ek bilgi saglamak icin koda eklenen ust veri

example_sentences.en: Add the @Override annotation to indicate method overriding.
example_sentences.tr: Metod ezmelerini belirtmek icin @Override notasyonu ekleyin.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Use the @Deprecated annotation for this old method.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler annotation ve decorator farkini bilmez.

definition_en: A scheduled task that runs automatically at specified time intervals
definition_tr: Belirtilen zaman araklinda otomatik calisan zamanlanmis gorev

example_sentences.en: Set up a cron job to clean up temp files every night.
example_sentences.tr: Her gece gecici dosyalari temizlemek icin cron job ayarla.

common_patterns: schedule a cron job — cron job zamanlamak
scenario: DevOps: 'Add a cron job to run the backup at midnight.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler cron expression syntaxini ezberlemez.

definition_en: Processing a large volume of data in groups rather than individually
definition_tr: Buyuk hacimli verileri tek tek yerine gruplar halinde isleme

example_sentences.en: Use batch processing for the data migration.
example_sentences.tr: Veri goc icin toplu isleme kullanin.

common_patterns: process in batches — partiler halinde islemek
scenario: Senior: 'Process these records in batches of 1000 to avoid memory issues.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tum verileri tek seferde islemeye calisir.

definition_en: Processing data continuously as it arrives rather than loading it all at once
definition_tr: Verileri toptan yuklemek yerine geldikce surekli isleme

example_sentences.en: Use streaming to handle large file uploads.
example_sentences.tr: Buyuk dosya yuklemelrini ele almak icin streaming kullanin.

scenario: Senior: 'Stream the file instead of loading it all into memory.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler buyuk dosyalari tamamen bellege alir.

definition_en: The method used to combine changes from different branches
definition_tr: Farkli dallardan gelen degisiklikleri birlestirmek icin kullanilan yontem

example_sentences.en: We use a squash merge strategy for feature branches.
example_sentences.tr: Feature branch'ler icin squash merge stratejisi kullaniyoruz.

scenario: Lead: 'Let's standardize our merge strategy across all repos.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler merge stratejisini standartlastirmaz.

definition_en: A repository that contains multiple projects or packages in a single repository
definition_tr: Birden fazla proje veya paketi tek bir depoda barindiran depo

example_sentences.en: We manage all our microservices in a monorepo.
example_sentences.tr: Tum mikro servislerimizi bir monorepo'da yonetiyoruz.

scenario: Lead: 'We're moving to a monorepo for better code sharing.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler monorepo yonetim araclari (Nx, Turborepo) bilmez.

definition_en: A person or team designated as responsible for reviewing changes to specific files or directories
definition_tr: Belirli dosya veya dizinlerdeki degisiklikleri incelemekten sorumlu olarak atanan kisi veya takim

example_sentences.en: The CODEOWNERS file defines who reviews changes to each module.
example_sentences.tr: CODEOWNERS dosyasi her moduldeki degisiklikleri kimin inceledigini tanimlar.

scenario: Lead: 'Set up CODEOWNERS to auto-assign reviewers.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler CODEOWNERS dosyasi olusturmaz.

definition_en: A technology allowing servers to push updates to the client over HTTP
definition_tr: Sunucularin HTTP uzerinden istemciye guncelleme gondermesine izin veren teknoloji

example_sentences.en: Use server-sent events for live notifications.
example_sentences.tr: Canli bildirimler icin server-sent events kullanin.

scenario: Dev: 'SSE is simpler than WebSockets for one-way updates.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler SSE'yi bilmez, her sey icin WebSocket kullanir.

definition_en: A script that runs in the background to enable features like offline support and push notifications
definition_tr: Cevrimdisi destek ve push bildirimleri gibi ozellikleri etkinlestirmek icin arka planda calisan betik

example_sentences.en: Register a service worker for offline caching.
example_sentences.tr: Cevrimdisi onbellek icin servis iscisi kaydet.

common_patterns: register a service worker — servis iscisi kaydetmek
scenario: Dev: 'The service worker caches pages for offline access.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler service worker yasam dongusunu anlamaz.

definition_en: A JavaScript running in the background thread to avoid blocking the UI
definition_tr: UI'yi engellememek icin arka plan is parcaciginda calisan JavaScript

example_sentences.en: Offload heavy computation to a web worker.
example_sentences.tr: Agir hesaplamayi web worker'a devret.

common_patterns: create a web worker — web worker olusturmak
scenario: Senior: 'Move this CPU-intensive work to a web worker.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler web worker'lari bilmez, her seyi main thread'de calistirir.

definition_en: Loading resources only when they are needed rather than upfront
definition_tr: Kaynaklari onceden degil yalnizca ihtiyac duyuldugundan yukleme

example_sentences.en: Implement lazy loading for images below the fold.
example_sentences.tr: Ekranin altindaki resimler icin tembel yukleme uygula.

common_patterns: lazy load images — resimleri tembel yukle
lazy load components — bilesenleri tembel yukle
scenario: Lead: 'Lazy load the heavy components to improve initial load time.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her seyi basta yukler, lazy loading dusunmez.

definition_en: Dividing code into smaller chunks that can be loaded on demand
definition_tr: Kodu talep uzerine yuklenebilecek daha kucuk parcalara bolme

example_sentences.en: Use code splitting to reduce the initial bundle size.
example_sentences.tr: Ilk bundle boyutunu azaltmak icin kod bolmeleme kullanin.

scenario: Lead: 'Code split the admin panel since not everyone needs it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tek buyuk bundle gonderir.

definition_en: Search Engine Optimization - techniques to improve a website's ranking in search results
definition_tr: Bir web sitesinin arama sonuclarindaki siralamasini iyilestirme teknikleri

example_sentences.en: Implement SSR for better SEO.
example_sentences.tr: Daha iyi SEO icin SSR uygulayin.

scenario: PO: 'We need SEO-friendly pages for the marketing content.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler SEO'yu sadece pazarlamanin isi sanir.

definition_en: Designing products usable by people with disabilities
definition_tr: Urunleri engelli kisiler tarafindan kullanilabilir olacak sekilde tasarlama

example_sentences.en: Add alt text to images for better accessibility.
example_sentences.tr: Daha iyi erisilebilirlik icin resimlere alt metin ekleyin.

scenario: Reviewer: 'This form lacks accessibility — add ARIA labels.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler accessibility'yi tamamen goz ardi eder.

definition_en: An approach where web design adapts to different screen sizes
definition_tr: Web tasariminin farkli ekran boyutlarina uyum sagladigi yaklasim

example_sentences.en: Use responsive design to support mobile and desktop users.
example_sentences.tr: Mobil ve masaustu kullanicilarini desteklemek icin duyarli tasarim kullanin.

scenario: Lead: 'Make sure the design is responsive for all screen sizes.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler sadece masaustu icin tasarim yapar.

definition_en: A server that acts as a single entry point for a group of microservices
definition_tr: Bir grup mikro servis icin tek giris noktasi gorevi goren sunucu

example_sentences.en: Route all API requests through the API gateway.
example_sentences.tr: Tum API isteklerini API gecidi uzerinden yonlendirin.

common_patterns: API gateway pattern — API gecidi kalbi
scenario: Architect: 'The API gateway handles authentication and rate limiting.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler API gateway'in islevlerini bilmez.

definition_en: A cache of database connections maintained for reuse
definition_tr: Yeniden kullanim icin tutulan veritabani baglantilari onbellegi

example_sentences.en: Configure the connection pool size based on expected traffic.
example_sentences.tr: Baglanti havuzu boyutunu beklenen trafige gore yapilandirin.

common_patterns: connection pool size — baglanti havuzu boyutu
scenario: DBA: 'Increase the connection pool size to handle more concurrent queries.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler connection pool ayarlarini varsayilan birakir.

definition_en: The fundamental reason behind a problem or failure
definition_tr: Bir problem veya basarisizligin temel nedeni

example_sentences.en: We need to find the root cause, not just fix the symptom.
example_sentences.tr: Sadece belirtiyi degil kok nedeni bulmamiz gerekiyor.

common_patterns: root cause analysis — kok neden analizi
find the root cause — kok nedeni bulmak
scenario: Lead: 'What's the root cause? Fixing the symptom won't prevent recurrence.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler belirtiyi duzeltir ama kok nedeni arastirmaz.

definition_en: Continuously observing system performance and health metrics
definition_tr: Sistem performansini ve saglik metriklerini surekli gozlemleme

example_sentences.en: Set up monitoring to detect issues before users report them.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanicilar bildirmeden once sorunlari tespit etmek icin izleme ayarla.

scenario: DevOps: 'We need better monitoring — the last outage went undetected for hours.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler monitoring kurmaz, kullanicilardan hata ogrenrir.

definition_en: Automatically notifying teams when system metrics exceed thresholds
definition_tr: Sistem metrikleri esikleri astiginda takimlari otomatik bilgilendirme

example_sentences.en: Configure alerting for CPU usage above 90%.
example_sentences.tr: CPU kullanimi %90'in uzerinde oldugunda uyari yapilandir.

scenario: DevOps: 'We need alerts for error rate spikes.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler uyari esiklerini yanlis ayarlar, ya cok fazla ya hic uyari gelir.

definition_en: A period when a system or service is unavailable
definition_tr: Sistem veya hizmetin kullanilamaz oldugu sure

example_sentences.en: The database outage lasted for 2 hours.
example_sentences.tr: Veritabani kesintisi 2 saat surdu.

scenario: On-call: 'We have a full outage, all services are down.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler outage sirasinda panige kapilir, runbook izlemeli.

definition_en: Service Level Agreement - a commitment for uptime and performance standards
definition_tr: Calisma suresi ve performans standartlari icin taahhut

example_sentences.en: Our SLA guarantees 99.9% uptime.
example_sentences.tr: SLA'miz %99.9 calisma suresi garanti eder.

scenario: Manager: 'We breached our SLA last month due to the outage.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler SLA kavramini bilmez.

definition_en: The percentage of time a system is operational and available
definition_tr: Sistemin calisir ve erisilebilir oldugu zaman yuzdesi

example_sentences.en: We target 99.99% uptime for our core services.
example_sentences.tr: Temel hizmetlerimiz icin %99.99 calisma suresi hedefliyoruz.

scenario: DevOps: 'Our uptime was 99.95% last quarter.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler uptime hesaplamasi yapamaz.

definition_en: Reporting an obstacle during the daily standup meeting
definition_tr: Gunluk standup toplantisinda bir engel bildirme

example_sentences.en: I'm blocked on the API integration — waiting for access.
example_sentences.tr: API entegrasyonunda engelleniyorum — erisim bekliyorum.

scenario: Dev: 'I'm blocked on this task, I need help from the DevOps team.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler blocker'larini soylemez, sessizce bekler.

definition_en: A meeting or conversation focused on solving technical problems
definition_tr: Teknik problemleri cozmeye odaklanan toplanti veya konusma

example_sentences.en: Let's have a technical discussion about the database migration approach.
example_sentences.tr: Veritabani goc yaklasimi hakkinda teknik bir tartisma yapalim.

common_patterns: schedule a technical discussion — teknik tartisma planlamak
scenario: Lead: 'We need a technical discussion before choosing the architecture.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler teknik tartismayi Ingilizce yurutmekte zorlanir.

definition_en: A brief report on the current progress of a task or project
definition_tr: Gorev veya projenin mevcut ilerlemesi hakkinda kisa rapor

example_sentences.en: Send a status update to the team before the end of the day.
example_sentences.tr: Gun sonundan once takima durum guncellemesi gonderin.

common_patterns: provide a status update — durum guncellemesi saglamak
scenario: Manager: 'Can you send me a status update on the migration?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler durum guncellmesi vermez, sorulmasi beklenir.

definition_en: A period when no new code changes are allowed, typically before a release
definition_tr: Genellikle surum oncesinde yeni kod degisikliklerine izin verilmeyen donem

example_sentences.en: We're entering code freeze, only critical fixes are allowed.
example_sentences.tr: Kod dondurma donemeine giriyoruz, sadece kritik duzeltmelere izin veriliyor.

common_patterns: code freeze period — kod dondurma donemi
scenario: Lead: 'Code freeze starts tomorrow, get your PRs merged today.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler code freeze kuralina uymaz, son dakika degisiklikleri yapar.

definition_en: A technique to enable or disable features without deploying new code
definition_tr: Yeni kod deploy etmeden ozellikleri etkinlestirme veya devre disi birakma teknigi

example_sentences.en: Use a feature flag to gradually roll out the new UI.
example_sentences.tr: Yeni arayuzu kademeli olarak yaymak icin ozellik bayragi kullanin.

common_patterns: toggle a feature flag — ozellik bayragini acip kapatmak
scenario: Lead: 'Put this behind a feature flag so we can toggle it off if needed.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler feature flag kullanmaz, ya hep ya hic deploy eder.

definition_en: The text accompanying a pull request that explains the changes and their purpose
definition_tr: Degisiklikleri ve amaclarini aciklayan, pull request'e eslik eden metin

example_sentences.en: Write a clear PR description so reviewers understand the context.
example_sentences.tr: Inceleyicilerin baglami anlamasi icin net bir PR aciklamasi yazin.

scenario: Reviewer: 'The PR description is too vague, what does this change?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler PR aciklamasini bos birakir veya tek satirlik yapar.

definition_en: A change that causes existing functionality to stop working as expected
definition_tr: Mevcut islevselliin beklenildigi gibi calismayı durdurmasina neden olan degisiklik

example_sentences.en: This API change is a breaking change — update the consumers.
example_sentences.tr: Bu API degisikligi uyumsuz bir degisiklik — tuketicileri guncelleyin.

common_patterns: introduce a breaking change — uyumsuz degisiklik tanimtmak
scenario: Lead: 'This is a breaking change, bump the major version.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler breaking change'i duyurmadan yapar.

definition_en: A standardized list of items to verify during code review
definition_tr: Kod inceleme sirasinda dogrulanacak ogelerin standartlastirilmis listesi

example_sentences.en: Use the PR review checklist to ensure nothing is missed.
example_sentences.tr: Hicbir seyin atlanmadigindan emin olmak icin PR inceleme kontrol listesini kullanin.

scenario: Lead: 'Follow the review checklist for consistent reviews.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler checklist kullanmaz, rastgele inceleme yapar.

definition_en: Having the same or very similar code in multiple places
definition_tr: Ayni veya cok benzer kodun birden fazla yerde bulunmasi

example_sentences.en: Remove code duplication by extracting a shared utility function.
example_sentences.tr: Ortak yardimci fonksiyon cikararak kod tekrarini kaldirin.

scenario: Reviewer: 'I see duplicated code in three files, extract it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kod kopyala-yapistir yaprak tekrar olusturur.

definition_en: Values written directly in code rather than being configurable
definition_tr: Yapilandrilabilir olmak yerine dogrudan koda yazilmis degerler

example_sentences.en: Don't hardcode the API URL, use an environment variable.
example_sentences.tr: API URL'sini sabit kodlama, ortam degiskeni kullan.

scenario: Reviewer: 'This URL is hardcoded, move it to config.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her seyi hardcode eder: URL, port, timeout degerleri.

definition_en: An anti-pattern where a single class handles too many responsibilities
definition_tr: Tek bir sinifin cok fazla sorumluluk ustlendigi anti-kalip

example_sentences.en: This UserService is a god class — split it into smaller services.
example_sentences.tr: Bu UserService bir tanri sinifi — kucuk servislere bol.

common_patterns: avoid god classes — tanri siniflarindan kacinmak
scenario: Reviewer: 'This class is 2000 lines, it's a god class.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tek sinifa cok fazla sorumluluk yuker.

definition_en: A formal agreement defining the expected inputs and outputs of an API
definition_tr: API'nin beklenen girdilerini ve ciktilarini tanimlayan resmi anlasma

example_sentences.en: Define the API contract before frontend and backend start work.
example_sentences.tr: Frontend ve backend ise baslamadan once API sozlesmesini tanimlayin.

scenario: Lead: 'Let's agree on the API contract first.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler API sozlesmesi olmadan paralel gelistirme yapar.

definition_en: Documentation that helps new team members get started with the project
definition_tr: Yeni takim uyelerinin projeye baslamasina yardimci olan dokumantasyon

example_sentences.en: Keep the onboarding docs up to date for new hires.
example_sentences.tr: Yeni isler icin ise alistirma belgelerini guncel tutun.

common_patterns: update onboarding docs — ise alistirma belgelerini guncellemek
scenario: Lead: 'The new dev wasted a day because our onboarding docs are outdated.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler onboarding dokumantasyonunu guncellmez.

definition_en: Drawing and explaining system architecture on a whiteboard during an interview
definition_tr: Mulakat sirasinda beyaz tahtada sistem mimarisini cizme ve aciklama

example_sentences.en: Practice whiteboard design for system design interviews.
example_sentences.tr: Sistem tasarimi mulakatlari icin beyaz tahta tasarimi pratiği yapin.

common_patterns: whiteboard design session — beyaz tahta tasarim oturumu
scenario: Interviewer: 'Come up to the whiteboard and design a chat system.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler beyaz tahtada tasarim yaparken yapiyi aciklamaz.

definition_en: A practice interview session to prepare for the real one
definition_tr: Gercek mulakat icin hazirlanmak amacikla yapilan pratik mulakat oturumu

example_sentences.en: Do mock interviews with friends to build confidence.
example_sentences.tr: Guven olusturmak icin arkadaslarinizla deneme mulakatlari yapin.

common_patterns: do a mock interview — deneme mulakati yapmak
scenario: Mentor: 'Let's do a mock interview to practice your answers.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler mock interview yapmaz, dogrudan mulata gider.

definition_en: Data Structures and Algorithms - foundational CS knowledge tested in interviews
definition_tr: Mulakatlarda test edilen temel CS bilgisi: veri yapilari ve algoritmalar

example_sentences.en: Brush up on DSA before the technical interview.
example_sentences.tr: Teknik mulakatten once DSA bilgilerini tazele.

scenario: Mentor: 'Start with basic DSA, then move to system design.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler DSA'yi sadece mulakat icin calisir, temelden ogrenimez.

definition_en: An interview round assessing alignment with company values and work style
definition_tr: Sirket degerleri ve calisma tarziyla uyumu degerlendiren mulakat turu

example_sentences.en: Prepare examples of teamwork for the culture interview.
example_sentences.tr: Kultur mulakati icin takim calismasi ornekleri hazirlayin.

common_patterns: culture interview round — kultur mulakati turu
scenario: Recruiter: 'The final round is a culture interview with the team.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kultur mulakatina hazirlanmaz.

definition_en: The minimum and maximum pay offered for a position
definition_tr: Bir pozisyon icin sunulan minimum ve maksimum ucret

example_sentences.en: What's the salary range for this position?
example_sentences.tr: Bu pozisyon icin maas araligi nedir?

scenario: Recruiter: 'The salary range for this role is between 80k and 120k.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler maas araligini sormaktan cekinir.

definition_en: A professional networking platform widely used for job searching and recruitment
definition_tr: Is arama ve ise alim icin yaygin kullanilan profesyonel ag kurma platformu

example_sentences.en: Keep your LinkedIn profile updated with your latest projects.
example_sentences.tr: LinkedIn profilinizi en son projelerinizle guncel tutun.

common_patterns: optimize your LinkedIn — LinkedIn'inizi optimize edin
scenario: Mentor: 'A strong LinkedIn profile attracts recruiters.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler LinkedIn profilini Ingilizce ve guncel tutmaz.

definition_en: Software whose source code is publicly available for anyone to use and contribute to
definition_tr: Kaynak kodu herkesin kullanmasi ve katkida bulunmasi icin halka acik olan yazilim

example_sentences.en: Contributing to open source projects improves your skills and resume.
example_sentences.tr: Acik kaynak projelere katkida bulunmak becerilerinizi ve ozgecmisinizi gelistirir.

common_patterns: open source contribution — acik kaynak katkisi
open source project — acik kaynak proje
scenario: Mentor: 'Start contributing to open source to build your portfolio.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler acik kaynaga katkida bulunmaz, sadece tuketir.

definition_en: A platform for hosting Git repositories and collaborating on code
definition_tr: Git depolarini barindirmak ve kod uzerinde isbirligi yapmak icin platform

example_sentences.en: Share your GitHub profile with the recruiter.
example_sentences.tr: GitHub profilinizi ise alim uzmaniyla paylasin.

scenario: Recruiter: 'Do you have a GitHub profile I can look at?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler GitHub profilini bos birakir.

definition_en: An early model of a product built to test concepts
definition_tr: Kavramlari test etmek icin olusturulan urunun erken modeli

example_sentences.en: Build a prototype to validate the idea before full development.
example_sentences.tr: Tam gelistirmeden once fikri dogrulamak icin bir prototip olusturun.

scenario: PO: 'Let's prototype this first before committing to the full feature.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler prototip yerine dogrudan son urunlu kodlamaya baslar.

definition_en: A detailed document describing the technical requirements and design of a system
definition_tr: Bir sistemin teknik gereksinimlerini ve tasarimini aciklayan ayrintili belge

example_sentences.en: Write a technical specification before implementation.
example_sentences.tr: Uygulamadan once teknik ozellik belgesi yazin.

common_patterns: write a tech spec — teknik spec yazmak
scenario: Lead: 'We need a tech spec for this project before coding.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler spec yazmadan kodlamaya baslar.

definition_en: A message displayed when an error occurs, explaining what went wrong
definition_tr: Hata olustugunda neyin yanlis gittigini aciklayan gorutunen mesaj

example_sentences.en: Write clear error messages that help users fix the problem.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanicilarin sorunu cozmesine yardimci olan net hata mesajlari yazin.

common_patterns: display an error message — hata mesaji gostermek
user-friendly error message — kullanici dostu hata mesaji
scenario: Reviewer: 'This error message is too technical for end users.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler teknik hata mesajlarini dogrudan kullaniciya gosterir.

definition_en: A temporary value or text used as a substitute until the real content is available
definition_tr: Gercek icerik mevcut olana kadar yedek olarak kullanilan gecici deger veya metin

example_sentences.en: Replace the placeholder text with actual content.
example_sentences.tr: Yer tutucu metni gercek icerikle degistirin.

scenario: Dev: 'This is just placeholder data, we'll connect the API later.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler placeholder verileri production'da birakir.

definition_en: Checking that incoming data meets expected format and constraints
definition_tr: Gelen verinin beklenen format ve kisitlamalari karsiladigini kontrol etme

example_sentences.en: Add payload validation to prevent malformed requests.
example_sentences.tr: Hatalio istekleri onlemek icin yuk dogrulama ekleyin.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Add schema validation for the request payload.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler gelen veriyi dogrulamadan isler.

definition_en: A description attached to a commit explaining the changes made
definition_tr: Yapilan degisiklikleri aciklayan, commite eklenmis aciklama

example_sentences.en: Write meaningful commit messages that describe the why, not the what.
example_sentences.tr: Ne'yi degil neden'i aciklayan anlamli commit mesajlari yazin.

common_patterns: descriptive commit message — aciklayici commit mesaji
scenario: Reviewer: 'Your commit message should explain why you made this change.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler 'fix', 'update' gibi anlamsiz commit mesajlari yazar.

definition_en: The convention for naming branches in a repository
definition_tr: Depoda dallari adlandirma kurali

example_sentences.en: Follow the branch naming convention: feature/ticket-id-description.
example_sentences.tr: Dal adlandirma kuralini izleyin: feature/bilet-id-aciklama.

common_patterns: branch naming convention — dal adlandirma kurali
scenario: Lead: 'Name your branches as feature/JIRA-123-add-login.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler dallari 'test', 'fix', 'new' gibi belirsiz adlar verir.

definition_en: Examining the differences between code versions during review
definition_tr: Inceleme sirasinda kod versyonlari arasindaki farklari inceleme

example_sentences.en: Review the diff carefully before approving.
example_sentences.tr: Onaylamadan once farki dikkatlice inceleyin.

scenario: Reviewer: 'I found an issue while reviewing the diff.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler diff'i satir satir incelemez.

definition_en: An API that follows REST architectural principles
definition_tr: REST mimari prensiplerini izleyen API

example_sentences.en: Build a REST API for the mobile application.
example_sentences.tr: Mobil uygulama icin bir REST API olusturun.

common_patterns: design a REST API — REST API tasarlamak
scenario: Lead: 'Design the REST API with proper resource naming.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler REST API tasariminda katman isimlerini yanlss kullanir.

definition_en: The practice of managing different versions of an API
definition_tr: Bir API'nin farkli surumlerini yonetme pratigi

example_sentences.en: Use URL path versioning: /api/v1/users.
example_sentences.tr: URL yolu surumleme kullanin: /api/v1/users.

scenario: Lead: 'Version the API so we don't break existing clients.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler API surumleme yapmaz, mevcut istemcileri bozar.

definition_en: A verb that indicates the desired action to perform on a resource
definition_tr: Kaynak uzerinde gerceklestirilmek istenen eylemi gosteren fiil

example_sentences.en: Choose the correct HTTP method for each endpoint.
example_sentences.tr: Her endpoint icin dogru HTTP metodunu secin.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Use DELETE method for removing resources, not POST.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her sey icin POST kullanir.

definition_en: Accessible Rich Internet Applications - attributes that improve web accessibility
definition_tr: Web erisilebilirligini iyilestiren HTML nitelikleri

example_sentences.en: Add ARIA labels to interactive elements.
example_sentences.tr: Etkilesimli elemanlara ARIA etiketleri ekleyin.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Add ARIA labels for screen reader users.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ARIA niteliklerini hic kullanmaz.

definition_en: HTML tags that provide metadata about a web page
definition_tr: Web sayfasi hakkinda ust veri saglayan HTML etiketleri

example_sentences.en: Set proper meta tags for SEO.
example_sentences.tr: SEO icin uygun meta etiketleri ayarlayin.

scenario: Dev: 'Add Open Graph meta tags for social sharing.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler meta etiketlerini goz ardi eder.

definition_en: A string format used to define scheduled time intervals
definition_tr: Zamanlanmis zaman arakllarini tanimlamak icin kullanilan dize formati

example_sentences.en: The cron expression '0 9 * * 1' means every Monday at 9 AM.
example_sentences.tr: '0 9 * * 1' cron ifadesi her Pazartesi saat 9'da demektir.

common_patterns: write a cron expression — cron ifadesi yazmak
scenario: DevOps: 'Set the cron expression for the nightly backup.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler cron ifadesini her seferinde internetten bakar.

definition_en: A numeric or alphanumeric identifier for a specific type of error
definition_tr: Belirli bir hata turunun sayisal veya alfasayisal tanimlayicisi

example_sentences.en: Return a specific error code so the client knows how to handle it.
example_sentences.tr: Istemcinin nasil ele alacagini bilmesi icin belirli bir hata kodu dondur.

common_patterns: custom error code — ozel hata kodu
scenario: Lead: 'Define custom error codes for different failure scenarios.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler genel hata kodlari kullanir, spesifik hata kodlari tanimlamaz.

definition_en: Code that automatically retries a failed operation
definition_tr: Basarisiz bir islemi otomatik olarak yeniden deneyen kod

example_sentences.en: Add retry logic with exponential backoff.
example_sentences.tr: Ustel geri cekilme ile yeniden deneme mantigi ekle.

common_patterns: retry with backoff — geri cekilme ile yeniden denemek
scenario: Senior: 'Add retry logic for transient network errors.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler sonsuz retry yapar, backoff stratejisi uygulamaz.

definition_en: A pattern that prevents repeated calls to a failing service
definition_tr: Basarisiz bir servise tekrarlanan cagrilari onleyen kalip

example_sentences.en: Implement a circuit breaker to stop cascading failures.
example_sentences.tr: Zincirleme basarisizliklari durdurmak icin devre kesici uygulayin.

common_patterns: circuit breaker pattern — devre kesici kalbi
scenario: Architect: 'The circuit breaker will prevent the whole system from going down.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler circuit breaker pattern'i bilmez.

definition_en: Verifying that a value is not null before using it
definition_tr: Kullanmadan once bir degerin null olmadigini dogrulama

example_sentences.en: Always do a null check before accessing properties.
example_sentences.tr: Ozelliklere erismeden once her zaman null kontrolu yapin.

common_patterns: add a null check — null kontrolu eklemek
scenario: Reviewer: 'Add a null check here to prevent a crash.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler null check yapmaz, NullPointerException alir.

definition_en: A syntax that allows reading properties of nested objects without checking each level
definition_tr: Her seviyeyi kontrol etmeden ic ice nesnelerin ozelliklerini okumaya izin veren sozdizimi

example_sentences.en: Use optional chaining: user?.address?.city.
example_sentences.tr: Opsiyonel zincirleme kullanin: user?.address?.city.

scenario: Dev: 'Use optional chaining instead of nested if statements.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ic ice if kontrolleri yapar, optional chaining bilmez.

definition_en: A concise statement of what the team aims to achieve during the sprint
definition_tr: Takimin sprint sirasinda neyi basarmayi hedefediginin ozlu ifadesi

example_sentences.en: Define a clear sprint goal that aligns with the product vision.
example_sentences.tr: Urun vizyonuyla uyumlu net bir sprint hedefi belirleyin.

common_patterns: define the sprint goal — sprint hedefini belirlemek
scenario: Scrum master: 'What's our sprint goal this iteration?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler sprint hedefi belirlemez, rastgele gorevler alir.

definition_en: Agreed criteria that must be met for a task to be considered complete
definition_tr: Bir gorevin tamamlanmis kabul edilmesi icin karsilanmasi gereken uzlasılmis kriterler

example_sentences.en: According to our definition of done, all PRs need tests.
example_sentences.tr: Tamamlanma tanimifiza gore, tum PR'larin testleri olmalidir.

common_patterns: meet the definition of done — tamamlanma tanimini karsilamak
scenario: Scrum master: 'This doesn't meet our definition of done — where are the tests?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler DoD'u belirsiz birakir.

definition_en: Constructive input shared during a retrospective meeting
definition_tr: Retrospektif toplantisi sirasinda paylailan yapici girdi

example_sentences.en: Share honest retrospective feedback to help the team improve.
example_sentences.tr: Takimin gelismesine yardimci olmak icin durust retrospektif geri bildirimi paylasin.

common_patterns: provide retro feedback — retro geri bildirimi saglamak
scenario: Scrum master: 'What worked well and what didn't?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler retro'da elestiri yapmaktan cekinir.

definition_en: The total amount of work a team can handle in a sprint
definition_tr: Takimin bir sprint'te ele alabilecegi toplam is miktari

example_sentences.en: Adjust the sprint scope based on team capacity.
example_sentences.tr: Sprint kapsamini takim kapasitesine gore ayarlayin.

scenario: Scrum master: 'We have less capacity this sprint due to holidays.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kapasiteyi gercekci hesaplamaz, fazla is alir.

definition_en: The structured format for sharing updates: yesterday, today, blockers
definition_tr: Guncelleme paylasimi icin yapilandirilmis format: dun, bugun, engelleyiciler

example_sentences.en: Follow the standup format: what I did, what I'll do, any blockers.
example_sentences.tr: Standup formatini izleyin: ne yaptim, ne yapacagim, engelleyiciler.

scenario: Scrum master: 'Stick to the format and keep it under 2 minutes per person.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler standup'ta format izlemez, hikaye anlatir.

definition_en: An imported module or variable that is not used anywhere in the file
definition_tr: Dosyada hicbir yerde kullanilmayan ice aktarilmis modul veya degisken

example_sentences.en: Remove unused imports to keep the code clean.
example_sentences.tr: Kodu temiz tutmak icin kullanilmayan importlari kaldirin.

common_patterns: remove unused imports — kullanilmayan importlari kaldirmak
scenario: Reviewer: 'There are 5 unused imports in this file.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kullanilmayan importlari birakir.

definition_en: Optimizing code before it's necessary, often adding complexity without measurable benefit
definition_tr: Gerekli olmadan kodu optimize etme, genellikle olculebilir fayda olmadan karmasiklik ekleme

example_sentences.en: Don't do premature optimization — measure first.
example_sentences.tr: Erken optimizasyon yapmayin — once olcun.

common_patterns: avoid premature optimization — erken optimizasyondan kacinmak
scenario: Senior: 'That's premature optimization, profile it first.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler olcum yapmadan optimize etmeye calisir.

definition_en: Standardized code that is repeated across projects with little modification
definition_tr: Projeler arasinda az degisiklikle tekrarlanan standartlastirilmis kod

example_sentences.en: Use a generator to reduce boilerplate code.
example_sentences.tr: Sablon kodu azaltmak icin generator kullanin.

scenario: Dev: 'This framework has too much boilerplate.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler boilerplate'i kopyala-yapistir yapar, genertor kullanmaz.

definition_en: Explanatory text embedded in source code for human readers
definition_tr: Insan okuyucular icin kaynak koda gomulen aciklayici metin

example_sentences.en: Write comments that explain why, not what the code does.
example_sentences.tr: Kodun ne yaptigini degil neden yaptigini aciklayan yorumlar yazin.

common_patterns: add a code comment — kod yorumu eklemek
scenario: Reviewer: 'This comment is outdated, update or remove it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler yorumlari Turkce yazar, Ingilizce yazmalidir.

definition_en: The practice of writing clear and concise technical documentation
definition_tr: Acik ve ozlu teknik dokumantasyon yazma pratigi

example_sentences.en: Good technical writing makes complex topics understandable.
example_sentences.tr: Iyi teknik yazim karmasik konulari anlasilir kilar.

common_patterns: technical writing skills — teknik yazim becerileri
scenario: Lead: 'Improve your technical writing — your docs are hard to follow.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler teknik yazim becerisi gelistirmez.

definition_en: Documentation that helps diagnose and fix common problems
definition_tr: Yaygin sorunlari teshis etmeye ve duzeltmeye yardimci olan dokumantasyon

example_sentences.en: Add this error to the troubleshooting guide.
example_sentences.tr: Bu hatayi sorun giderme rehberine ekleyin.

common_patterns: follow the troubleshooting guide — sorun giderme rehberini izlemek
scenario: Lead: 'Document this fix in the troubleshooting guide for future reference.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler bilinen sorunlari belgelemez.

definition_en: Building professional relationships for career opportunities
definition_tr: Kariyer firsatlari icin profesyonel iliskiler kurma

example_sentences.en: Networking at tech meetups can lead to job opportunities.
example_sentences.tr: Teknoloji bulusmalarinda ag kurma is firsatlarina yol acabilir.

scenario: Mentor: 'Most jobs are found through networking, not job boards.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler networking yapmaz, sadece is ilanlarinda basvuru yapar.

definition_en: A letter accompanying a resume that explains your interest in the position
definition_tr: Pozisyona olan ilginizi aciklayan, ozgecmise eslik eden mektup

example_sentences.en: Write a personalized cover letter for each application.
example_sentences.tr: Her basvuru icin kisisellestirilmis bir on yazi yazin.

common_patterns: write a cover letter — on yazi yazmak
scenario: Mentor: 'A good cover letter sets you apart from other candidates.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler on yazi yazmaz veya genel sablon kullanir.

definition_en: The standard resignation notice period in many companies
definition_tr: Bircok sirkette standart istifa bildirim suresi

example_sentences.en: I gave my two-week notice yesterday.
example_sentences.tr: Dun iki haftalik bildirimimi verdim.

common_patterns: give a two-week notice — iki haftalik bildirim vermek
scenario: Dev: 'I'm giving my two-week notice, my last day will be the 15th.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ihbar suresini dogru hesaplamaz.

definition_en: An intensive training program that teaches programming skills in a short time
definition_tr: Kisa surede programlama becerileri ogreten yogun egitim programi

example_sentences.en: Many developers transition into tech through coding bootcamps.
example_sentences.tr: Bircok gelistirici kodlama kamplari araciligiyla teknolojiye gecis yapar.

scenario: Recruiter: 'Did you attend a bootcamp or are you self-taught?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler bootcamp seciminde dikkatli olmalidir.

definition_en: The equilibrium between professional work and personal life
definition_tr: Profesyonel is ve kisisel yasam arasindaki denge

example_sentences.en: Does the company value work-life balance?
example_sentences.tr: Sirket is-yasam dengesine deger veriyor mu?

common_patterns: maintain work-life balance — is-yasam dengesini korumak
scenario: Candidate: 'Work-life balance is important to me.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler is-yasam dengesini sormaktan cekinir.

definition_en: The rank or experience level of a developer: junior, mid, senior, lead
definition_tr: Bir gelistiricinin seviyesi: junior, mid, senior, lead

example_sentences.en: This position requires a senior-level engineer.
example_sentences.tr: Bu pozisyon senior seviye muhendis gerektiriyor.

scenario: Recruiter: 'What seniority level are you targeting?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler seniority seviyelerinin beklentilerini bilmez.

definition_en: The feeling of being a fraud despite evidence of competence
definition_tr: Yetkinlik kanitlarina ragmen sahtekkar oldugunu hissetme

example_sentences.en: Many developers experience imposter syndrome, especially early in their career.
example_sentences.tr: Bircok gelistirici, ozellikle kariyerlerinin basinda sahtekkar sendromu yasar.

common_patterns: overcome imposter syndrome — sahtekkar sendromunu yenmek
scenario: Mentor: 'Imposter syndrome is normal, even senior devs feel it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler kendilerini yeterli hissetmez, basarilarini kucumser.

definition_en: A class that cannot be instantiated and serves as a base for other classes
definition_tr: Orneklenemeyen ve diger siniflar icin temel goevi goren sinif

example_sentences.en: Extend the abstract class and implement the required methods.
example_sentences.tr: Soyut sinifi genisletin ve gerekli metodlari uygulayinj.

common_patterns: extend an abstract class — soyut sinifi genisletmek
scenario: Senior: 'Use an abstract class when you want to share code between subclasses.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler abstract class ve interface farkini bilmez.

definition_en: A method that belongs to a class rather than an instance
definition_tr: Bir ornege degil sinifin kendisine ait metod

example_sentences.en: Use a static method for utility functions that don't need instance state.
example_sentences.tr: Ornek durumuna ihtiyac duymayan yardimci fonksiyonlar icin statik metod kullanin.

common_patterns: call a static method — statik metod cagirmak
scenario: Reviewer: 'This should be a static method since it doesn't use this.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler gereksiz yere instance metod yapar.

definition_en: Providing a new implementation for a method inherited from a parent class
definition_tr: Ust siniftan miras alinan bir metod icin yeni uygulama saglamak

example_sentences.en: Override the toString method for custom string representation.
example_sentences.tr: Ozel dize temsili icin toString metodunu ezin.

scenario: Dev: 'Override this method in the subclass to change the behavior.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler overriding ve overloading farkini karistirir.

definition_en: Defining multiple methods with the same name but different parameters
definition_tr: Ayni isimde ama farkli parametrelere sahip birden fazla metod tanimlama

example_sentences.en: Method overloading allows different parameter types.
example_sentences.tr: Metod asiri yukleme farkli parametre tiplerine izin verir.

scenario: Dev: 'TypeScript doesn't support true overloading, use union types.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler overloading ve overriding'i karistirir.

definition_en: A specific URL path in a REST API that handles a particular resource
definition_tr: Belirli bir kaynagi yoneten REST API'deki belirli URL yolu

example_sentences.en: Create REST endpoints for user CRUD operations.
example_sentences.tr: Kullanici CRUD islemleri icin REST endpointleri olusturun.

common_patterns: define REST endpoints — REST endpointleri tanimlamak
scenario: Lead: 'Follow RESTful naming conventions for endpoints.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler endpoint'leri fiil ile adlandirir (/getUsers yerine /users olmali).

definition_en: The server-side part of an application that handles logic, database, and APIs
definition_tr: Mantik, veritabani ve API'leri yoneten uygulamanin sunucu tarafi

example_sentences.en: The backend is built with Node.js and Express.
example_sentences.tr: Backend Node.js ve Express ile insa edildi.

scenario: Lead: 'The backend team will build the API endpoints.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler frontend ve backend sorumluluk sinirlarini karistirir.

definition_en: The client-side part of an application that users directly interact with
definition_tr: Kullanicilarin dogrudan etkilesime girdigi uygulamanin istemci tarafi

example_sentences.en: The frontend is built with React and TypeScript.
example_sentences.tr: Frontend React ve TypeScript ile insa edildi.

scenario: Lead: 'The frontend team needs the API contract to start work.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler frontend'i sadece HTML/CSS sanir.

definition_en: A developer who works on both frontend and backend
definition_tr: Hem frontend hem backend uzerinde calisan gelistirici

example_sentences.en: We're looking for a full-stack developer.
