example_sentences.tr: Tam yigin gelistirici ariyoruz.

scenario: Recruiter: 'This role requires full-stack experience.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler full-stack oldugunu iddia eder ama bir tarafta daha zayiftir.

definition_en: A set of practices combining development and operations for faster delivery
definition_tr: Daha hizli teslimat icin gelistirme ve operasyonlari birlestiren pratikler kumesi

example_sentences.en: Our DevOps team manages the CI/CD pipeline.
example_sentences.tr: DevOps takimimiz CI/CD hattini yonetiyor.

scenario: Lead: 'Work with DevOps to set up the deployment pipeline.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler DevOps'u sadece deployment yapan kisi sanir.

definition_en: The underlying systems and resources that support an application
definition_tr: Bir uygulamayi destekleyen temel sistemler ve kaynaklar

example_sentences.en: The infrastructure is hosted on AWS.
example_sentences.tr: Altyapi AWS'de barindiriliyor.

common_patterns: infrastructure as code — kod olarak altyapi
scenario: DevOps: 'We need to upgrade our infrastructure to handle the load.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler altyapi yonetimini bilmez.

definition_en: A test that validates the entire application flow from start to finish
definition_tr: Uygulamanin tum akisini bastan sona dogrulayan test

example_sentences.en: Write end-to-end tests for the critical user journeys.
example_sentences.tr: Kritik kullanici yolculuklari icin uctan uca testler yazin.

scenario: Lead: 'Only write E2E tests for critical paths — they're slow and expensive.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler sadece E2E test yazar, unit test ihmal eder.

definition_en: A senior developer who guides the technical direction of a team
definition_tr: Takimin teknik yonunu yonlendiren kidemli gelistirici

example_sentences.en: The tech lead reviews all architectural decisions.
example_sentences.tr: Teknik lider tum mimari kararlari inceler.

common_patterns: tech lead role — teknik lider rolu
scenario: Manager: 'The tech lead will mentor you on best practices.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tech lead ile manager rolunu karistirir.

definition_en: Reviewing code together with another developer in real-time
definition_tr: Baska bir gelistiriciyle gercek zamanli birlikte kod inceleme

example_sentences.en: Let's do a pair review on this complex PR.
example_sentences.tr: Bu karmasik PR uzerinde esli inceleme yapalim.

common_patterns: pair review session — esli inceleme oturumu
scenario: Lead: 'This PR is too complex for async review, let's pair on it.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler pair review'u zaman kaybi olarak gorur.

definition_en: A special approval to make code changes during a code freeze period
definition_tr: Kod dondurma doneminde kod degisikligi yapmak icin ozel onay

example_sentences.en: Request a code freeze exception for this critical fix.
example_sentences.tr: Bu kritik duzeltme icin kod dondurma istisnasi isteyin.

common_patterns: request an exception — istisna talep etmek
scenario: Lead: 'This fix needs a code freeze exception — get approval from the release manager.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler code freeze kuralini atlatmaya calisir.

definition_en: A quick test to verify that the most critical functions of a system work
definition_tr: Sistemin en kritik fonksiyonlarinin calistigini dogrulamak icin hizli test

example_sentences.en: Run smoke tests after every deployment.
example_sentences.tr: Her dagitimdan sonra duman testleri calistirin.

common_patterns: run smoke tests — duman testleri calistirmak
scenario: QA: 'The smoke tests passed, the deployment looks good.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler smoke test olmadan production'a deploy eder.

definition_en: An initial technical assessment, usually a phone or video call with coding questions
definition_tr: Genellikle kodlama sorulariyla telefon veya video gorusmesi seklinde ilk teknik degerlendirme

example_sentences.en: I have a technical screen with the engineering team tomorrow.
example_sentences.tr: Yarin muhendislik takimiyla teknik on elemem var.

common_patterns: pass the technical screen — teknik on elemeyi gecmek
scenario: Recruiter: 'The first step is a 45-minute technical screen.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler teknik on elemedeki basit sorulari ciddiye almaz.

definition_en: The series of steps in a company's hiring process
definition_tr: Bir sirketin ise alim surecindeki adimlar dizisi

example_sentences.en: The hiring pipeline has 5 stages: screen, coding, system design, behavioral, and offer.
example_sentences.tr: Ise alim hatti 5 asamadan olusuyor: eleme, kodlama, sistem tasarimi, davranissal ve teklif.

common_patterns: hiring pipeline stages — ise alim hatti asamalari
usage_context: Is arama ve ise alim surecinde
scenario: Recruiter: 'You're in the final stage of our hiring pipeline.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler ise alim surecinin kac adimdan olustugunu sormaz.

definition_en: A debugging method where you explain your code line by line to an inanimate object
definition_tr: Kodunuzu satirr satir cansiz bir nesneye aciklayarak hata ayiklama yontemi

example_sentences.en: Try rubber duck debugging — explain the code out loud.
example_sentences.tr: Lastik ordek hata ayiklamayi deneyin — kodu sesli aciklayin.

common_patterns: rubber duck debugging — lastik ordek hata ayiklama
scenario: Senior: 'Sometimes explaining the code to a rubber duck helps you find the bug.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler bu teknigi bilmez, sessizce koda bakar.

definition_en: Messy, tangled code that is difficult to follow and maintain
definition_tr: Takip etmesi ve bakimi zor, dagink ve karmasik kod

example_sentences.en: This function is spaghetti code, let's refactor it.
example_sentences.tr: Bu fonksiyon spagetti kod, refactor edelim.

common_patterns: avoid spaghetti code — spagetti koddan kacinmak
scenario: Reviewer: 'This is turning into spaghetti code — refactor before it gets worse.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler spagetti kodu zamaninda temizlmez.

definition_en: Dependency on a specific vendor's technology that makes switching costly
definition_tr: Degistirmeyi maliyetli kilan belirli bir saticinin teknolojisine bagimlilik

example_sentences.en: Avoid vendor lock-in by using standard APIs.
example_sentences.tr: Standart API'ler kullanarak satici bagimliliginden kacinnn.

scenario: Architect: 'Using proprietary features creates vendor lock-in.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler vendor lock-in riskini degerlendirmez.

definition_en: The ability of new software to work with older versions
definition_tr: Yeni yazilimin eski surumlerle calismma yeteneği

example_sentences.en: Maintain backward compatibility when updating the API.
example_sentences.tr: API'yi guncellerken geriye donuk uyumlulugu koruyun.

common_patterns: maintain backward compatibility — geriye uyumlulugu korumak
scenario: Lead: 'This change must be backward compatible.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler geriye uyumlulugu dusunmeden API degistirir.

definition_en: Embedding expressions or variables inside a string
definition_tr: Ifadeleri veya degiskenleri bir dizenin icine gomme

example_sentences.en: Use string interpolation instead of concatenation.
example_sentences.tr: Birlestirme yerine string interpolation kullanin.

scenario: Reviewer: 'Use template literals for string interpolation.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler + ile birlestirme yapar, template literal kullanmaz.

definition_en: Initial data loaded into a database for testing or development purposes
definition_tr: Test veya gelistirme amaciyla veritabanina yuklenen baslangic verisi

example_sentences.en: Run the seed script to populate the database with test data.
example_sentences.tr: Veritabanini test verisiyle doldurmak icin seed betigi calistirin.

scenario: Dev: 'Don't forget to run the seed after migrations.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler seed data hazirlmaz, test icin uretim verisi kullanir.

definition_en: The combination of technologies used to build an application
definition_tr: Bir uygulama olusturmak icin kullanilan teknolojilerin kombinasyonu

example_sentences.en: Our tech stack is React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
example_sentences.tr: Teknoloji yiginimiz React, Node.js ve PostgreSQL.

common_patterns: choose a tech stack — teknoloji yigini secmek
scenario: Interviewer: 'What tech stack are you most experienced with?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler tech stack secimini trend'lere gore yapar, proje ihtiyacina gore degil.

definition_en: Making a new version of software available to users
definition_tr: Yazilimin yeni bir surumunu kullanicilara sunma

example_sentences.en: We're planning a release for next Monday.
example_sentences.tr: Gelecek pazartesi icin bir surum planliyoruz.

scenario: Lead: 'Let's finalize the release notes before the deployment.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler release plani yapmadan deploy eder.

definition_en: A branch created specifically to fix a critical production bug
definition_tr: Kritik bir uretim hatasini duzeltmek icin ozel olarak olusturulan dal

example_sentences.en: Create a hotfix branch from the main branch.
example_sentences.tr: Main branch'ten bir hotfix branch olusturun.

common_patterns: create a hotfix branch — hotfix dali olusturmak
scenario: Lead: 'Create a hotfix branch, fix the bug, and merge directly to main.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler hotfix icin ayri branch acmaz, main'e direkt commit yapar.

definition_en: Testing a system under heavy load to identify performance bottlenecks
definition_tr: Performans darbozlarini belirlemek icin sistemi agir yuk altinda test etme

example_sentences.en: Run load tests before the product launch.
example_sentences.tr: Urun lansmanindan once yuk testleri calistirin.

common_patterns: perform load testing — yuk testi yapmak
load test results — yuk testi sonuclari
scenario: Lead: 'Run load tests to ensure the system handles 1000 concurrent users.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler yuk testi yapmadan production'a cikar.

definition_en: Using HTML elements according to their meaning rather than their appearance
definition_tr: HTML elemanlarini gorunuslerine degil anlamlarina gore kullanma

example_sentences.en: Use semantic HTML elements like header, nav, and main.
example_sentences.tr: header, nav ve main gibi anlamsal HTML elemanlari kullanin.

common_patterns: use semantic HTML — anlamsal HTML kullanmak
scenario: Reviewer: 'Use a button element, not a div with a click handler.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler her sey icin div kullanir.

definition_en: A tool for tracking bugs, features, and tasks in a project
definition_tr: Projede hatalari, ozellikleri ve gorevleri izlemek icin arac

example_sentences.en: Create a ticket in the issue tracker for this bug.
example_sentences.tr: Bu hata icin sorun takipcisinde bir bilet olusturun.

scenario: Lead: 'Log all bugs in the issue tracker, not in Slack.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler hatalari sozlu bildirir, issue tracker'a girmez.

definition_en: To work together with someone on a specific task
definition_tr: Belirli bir gorev uzerinde biriyle birlikte calismak

example_sentences.en: Can we pair on this debugging session?
example_sentences.tr: Bu debug oturumunda birlikte calisabilir miyiz?

common_patterns: pair on a task — gorev uzerinde birlikte calismak
scenario: Dev: 'I'm stuck, can we pair on this for 30 minutes?'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler yardim istemekten cekinir.

definition_en: To release or deploy software to users
definition_tr: Yazilimi kullanicilara yayinlamak veya deploy etmek

example_sentences.en: Let's ship this feature by end of week.
example_sentences.tr: Bu ozelligi hafta sonuna kadar yayinlayalim.

scenario: Lead: 'Ship it! We can iterate based on user feedback.'
common_mistakes: Turk gelistiriciler mukemmeliyetcilik yuzunden ship etmekte gecikir.
